/thar 'dod su zhig bzhon nas 'gro mi byed/ /rang nyid ji ltar sems can 'di dag gi/ /sdug bsngal spang zhing lam gyi bsdus byas te/ lan grang du mar bdag la 'di dag gis/ /phan pa dpag med mdzad pa ma lags sam/ /de lta'ang bdag yid mngal gyis sdug bsngal gyis/ /gzir zhing skye 'chi 'phongs pa ma 'tshal te/ /bor bar gyur na 'di las khrel bor ba/ /'jig rten gsum na gzhan pa cang mchis sam/ /de phyir byas shes drin bzo yis bskyed nas/ /dngos dang brgyud pas 'gro la phan pa spyad/ /de dag don mang bdag gis bsgrub bya zhing / /nam yang de la gnod pa rab tu spang / /bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i gsung rab la/ /yang yang blta bas blang dor mdo bzhin spyad/ /kun la nga rgyal med pas bsten bya zhing / /thos bsam ro mchog myangs pas mi ngoms bya/ /phyi dang nang gi chos 'di dag /phyogs cha dus gsum dbye ba yis/ /dpyad na bden pa 'ga' yang med/ /de phyir rmi lam lta bur blta/ /las sogs rten cing 'brel byung dang / /'ga' yang bden pa med shes nas/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyis mi tshugs shing / /myur du thams cad mkhyen pa thob/ /yun ring brten yang 'grogs pa mi brtan zhing / /cung zad tsam gyis khro ba khong nas ldang / /ro 'dzin zung ldan ltos 'gro de dag ni/ /phan ltar snang yang rtag tu bsten mi bya/ /cung zad brten yang rtag tu phan pa ster/ /yun du bsnyen yang 'grogs pas mi skyo ba'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu byi dor ma byas pa/ /phan min snang yang rgyun du bsten par bya/ /gsung rab chu gter rnam dpyod lhun po'i srub shing lung dang rigs pa'i klu dbang gis dkris nas/ /blo gros khyab 'jug stobs kyis bsrubs las legs rnyed phrin yig bdud rtsi'i thigs pa dri ma med/ /'di yis khyed kyi blo gros ro 'dzin rab tu tshim nas khyed thugs dgyes pa'i lus rtas par/ /rnam par bgyi slad 'bad de bsgrubs pa'i dge bas lus can srid pa'i mtsho las myur sgrol shog

/ces pa'i phrin yig ltos 'gro'i lo nag pa'i zla ba'i drag po'i tshes la legs par bsrings pa mig lam du 'gyur ba'i slad du/ spos cung zad dang / ka ra nyung zad hūm̐ la sbyar ba bdog dge legs su gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan la springs pa/ /'di dang phyi mar phan pa dam pa'i chos/ /de 'byung bya zhing mi dge rgyang bsrings nas/ /rtag par dge ba bsgrub la brtson bya zhing / /'khor ba'i rtsa ba gang la'ang sred bcas spang / /lam gyi rtsa ba bla mar gsol ba gdab/ /dge ba rgya chen spel phyir sems bskyed de/ /sgrib pa spang phyir de kho na nyid bsgom/ /dge gang bla med byang chub phyir bsngo 'o/ /mtshan 'dzin spang phyir rmi lam ltar shes bya/ /bdud dang bar chad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ /yon tan bskyed phyir mchog tu 'dzin pa spang / /rtogs pa spel phyir bsgrub la brtson par bya/ /zhes pa'i zhen bskul dkon mchog gsum mtshon pa'i/ /shloka gsum a wa dhū tī pas/ /sgrub brtson ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gdams/ /phag lo zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer brgyad la// // ༄༅/ /swasti pra dzābhyaḥ dge legs chu gter che las longs/ /phun tshogs dgos 'dod kun gyi dpal/ 'gro kun dga' ba'i gtsug gi rgyun/ /rdzogs sangs nor bu'i dbang por 'dud/ /yang dag sangs rgyas lam son te/ /snyan dang grags pa'i thub pa'i gsungs/ /kun la dbang 'byor bshes gnyen mchog /dag pa'i thugs mnga' khyed la 'bul/ /khyed sku khams bzang chos kyi bya ba 'phel ba'i thad nas/ gsung yig sihla dang bcas pa bskur ba bdag gi sug par phyin pas shin tu spro bar mchis shing / do gcig gsung yig rten phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa legs par thengs/ do'i gnas lugs/ slob dpon na dbon po ba grogs mched yar byon dus bskur mchis lags na'ang / gser yig pas g.yengs nas khong rnam pa dang yang phrad pa ma byung bar yi ge la sogs gang yang bskur ba ma byung lags/

nged kyang da lta la khams bzang zhing chos 'phel bar bdog skabs kyi don la/ sku khams kyi 'tsho skyong dang / bstan pa'i bya ba thugs dam 'gro ba'i don la sngar bzhin brtson pa gal che zhing / thub pa'i lam mchog bgrod pa'i slad dang / sku tshe mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir thugs long ji tsam yod par grub na shin tu legs/ yun ring par ma grub na'ang / tho rangs kyi thun la rlung bgrang ba lan stong ngam/ tha ma brgya rtsa re tsam byed pa la/ rlung cha mnyam par rgyu ba la bgrangs na yon tan che bas/ rlung gzhogs g.yon du rgyu yin 'dug na rgyu phyogs kyi brla'i steng mi rgyu ba ngos kyi rkang pas rdo rje skyil dkrungs bzhin byas pa la/ mi rgyu ba'i phyogs kyi mdzub mos mi rgyu ba'i sna bug mnan/ rgyu phyogs kyi sna bug nas rlung phyir cung zad phul la/ de nas drag tu rngub yin chung na skyar trub gcig kyang byas la/ sor mo'i rtse mo'i bar khengs pa'i tshod tsam du bkang / rgyu phyogs kyi mdzub mos rgyu phyogs kyi sna bug mnan/ rlung thub tshad du bzung la mi thub pa dang mnan bzhin pa la mi rgyu ba ngos nas btang la/ de phyogs nas lan 'ga' rgyu ru gzhug de lta bu lan 'gas mnyam rgyur 'gyur/ gyur ba dang mi tshor bar 'jam pos rgyu ba la/ sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ 'dis 'chi ba blu zhing tshe sring par rgyud mang po nas gsungs/ myong ba la'ang de bzhin snang / rlung 'gas kyang mi yongs pas zab par mchis/ rlung bsgoms pas zin yul thung na dub pa yin pas ngal gso yin bsgom dgos pa'i rtags su gda'/ 'di chos kyi skyes su 'bul zhing / yi ge mi 'khyar ba'i rten tsam du/ thugs dam mdo 'dzin la the tshe 'byar ba cig dang / bla bres legs pa bsod dbang gis the tshe 'di 'byar ba cig 'bul/ byi ba lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la/ dge legs chen pos 'gro ba 'di/ /'khor ba'i sdug bal dbugs phyung ste/

/rgyal mchog bde ba'i dga' ston la/ /mgron du gnyer de tshim byed shog /shubhaṃ// // ༄༅/ /'gro la brtse ba'i spyan yangs shing / /phun tshogs bye ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /dge legs pad tshal gsal mdzad pa/ /sgrol ma'i dpal gyis skyong gyur cig /khri dbang phyug dpal mgon lde la springs yig gi mchod brjod/ dge'o// // ༄༅/ /chos blo dpon po la na ma:shrī gu ra we/ rab rgyas thugs rje'i cha shas rdzogs/ /tshad med mkhyen pa'i 'od dkar can/ /gdul ba'i ku mud gnyen gcig po/ /zol med gus pa'i spyi bos 'dud/ /chos tshul kun tu dpag yas la/ /blo gros dga' bde rab rgyas shing / /nges don rgyal ba'i dgongs pas 'byor/ /spros pa'i mtshan spangs de don bsnyad/ /dal 'byor phun tshogs kun gyi gter/ /bsod nams dbang gis legs rnyed pa/ /snyoms las choms pos mi 'phrog par/ /dad brtson bsrungs mas legs bsrung 'tshal/ /dal 'byor phun tshogs rnyed dka'i sgron/ /skad cig rlung gis nyin bzhin 'joms/ /de ltar dran byas skye bo yi/ /bskul mas chos la nyin bzhin bskul/ /bden bzhi'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis brjod/ /gdul bya'i ngor byas gnas skabs 'gar/ /bsgoms pas nyan rang spangs rtogs rnams/ /chags med khong du chud par mdzod/ /brtson ldan dge la spro ba yis/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i chus/ /rang sems brlan bzhin theg chen sems/ /myu gu yang dang yang bskrun te/ /bsod nams 'bras bu rgyas bya zhing / /ji srid brten pa ma thob bar/ /dben par 'du 'dzin kun spangs te/ /ting 'dzin mchog la goms par mdzod/ /dus gsum dge ba ci skyes pa/ /bla med byang chub tu bsngo zhing / /phyi dang nang gi rnam g.yeng rnams/ /lta spyod zung gis zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag gzhan dge la yi rang zhing / /chos kun rang bzhin med rtogs pas/ /bde sdug nyer 'tshe ma lus pa/ /stong nyid rtogs pas gzhom par mdzod/

/tha mal rnam rtog ma lus pa/ /gzhom phyir rtog pa'i bsgom pa mchog /rdzogs pa'i gnad du bya ba'i phyir/ /sems brtan bar du bsgom par mdzod/ /spang gnyen kun rtog ma lus pa/ /dran pa'i theg pas legs bcings nas/ /rnam kun mchog gi stong pa nyid/ /sems kyi ngang du mkhyen par mdzod/ /bla ma'i man ngag 'bad rtsol gyis/ /nyi ma zla ba'i lam bkag nas/ /dus mer srog thur mi g.yo bas/ /'byung lnga'i rlung rnams dbang du bsdu/ /'byung ba dgra grogs kun shes nas/ /phan tshun mnyam po'i rlung brten cing / /steng 'og rlung la goms byas la/ /rlung gi bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /'khor lo drug tu bum pa can/ /drug gi srog rlung brtan byas nas/ /nad dang mkha' spyod 'chi ba med/ /gtum mo'i me drod sbar bar mdzod/ /phyag rgya gsum gyis 'dzag pa yi/ /bde ba bsgom zhing byang chub sems/ /'gyur ba bkag ste mi 'gyur ba'i/ /bde chen ye shes goms par mdzod/ /de las nang gi sa lam kun/ /thogs pa med par bgrod byas nas/ /spangs rtogs ma lus dbang byas te/ /bde chen rdo rje 'chang thob mdzod/ /theg pa gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /zab don snying po mdor bsdus nas/ /dpal ldan a wa dhū tī pas/ /slob ma'i mchog la gdams pa lags/ /dge bas 'gro ba thams cad dang / /khyad par lam zhugs rnal 'gyur pa/ /phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun bral nas/ /zag med dga' bde mthar phyin shog /maṅga laṃ bha wantu/ ༄༅/ /na maḥ shrī gu ru we/ 'bri gung ba bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan la'o/ yon tan rin chen du ma'i gter gyur pa/ /mchod gnas bla med bla ma mchog rnams dang / /sgrib spangs mkhyen pa rab rgyas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bden pa gnyis ldan 'gro skyabs dam pa'i chos/ /'phags pa'i lam gnas 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing / /rab dkon rab tu dang ba bskyed byed pa/ /rin chen skyabs mchog gyur pa de dag la/ /mgon bzung gsung sgrub bya phyir gus phyag 'tshal/

/kun mchog thub rnams thar pa'i rjes zhugs te/ dga' bde zag med nyid kyis mnyes bya'i phyir/ /rgyal sras kun gyi brten bya zab mo'i lam/ /mtshan med gcig tu bsgrub mdzad rgyal gyur cig /mngon sum min yang mngon sum gyur pa bzhin/ /ring na 'dug kyang nye ba'i thugs can gyis/ /mnyam bya min yang rna ba'i dpal bskyed pa/ /khyed gsung bdud rtsis bde gzhan zil gyis mnan/ /'on kyang ro brgya ldan pa'i zas mchog dang / /khyed thugs ting 'dzin dga' bar rab rgyas zhes/ /thos pas spu ldang bde ba skyes par gyur/ /yang na lha dag bag med bskul ba yis/ /bsam gtan bzhi yi bde ba myong ngam ci/ /zhes snyam bdag blo'ang 'phyang mo yug tu gyur/ /slad nas dam pa khyed la gsol ba ni/ /bde lugs kun 'byung rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang / /de las bstan 'di yun ring gnas pa yi/ /don 'di ma bskul bar yang bskul ba bzhin/ /legs par mdzad mod bdag kyang bskul bar 'tshal/ /zhes pa'i phrin yig a ba dhu tī pas/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi zla tshes sbyar ba yi/ /rten du phra ras dri med 'di 'bul lo/ /de lta'i dge bas 'gro ba sangs rgyas shog /khi si ru la gnang ba'i bkris shog/ // ༄༅/ /slob dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan la bskur ba/ /khyed kyi yi ge 'phrod/ bsam yas kyi zhig gsos snga rim tshar ba rnams blta ba dang me tog 'thor ba lo tsā bas cig yong na zhes/ dge bshes kyang gleng / thad par yang dran bskul ba'ang byung / rgya bod kyi chags tshul/ 'dun ma thams cad kyi mtha'/ mi thams cad kyi byed spyod/ sgos dbus gtsang / yang sgos sa skya pa phyi nang kun gyi tshul sngar du lhag ma med par rtogs/ khyed kyi yi ge kun gyi dngos shugs kyi don yang khong du chud/ skabs don tshe 'di'i 'dun ma bkra bkra la blta yin/ dga' ba la ngom/ mi dga' ba la lan byed/ snying mi sdug sogs na/ bsam yas chos gzhi bas/ rgyal po'i bla mchod rang drag pa 'dra ste/

tshe 'di dang phyi ma brje ma nus/ sos dal dang 'dun ma tshong byed ma nus pas thabs trugs kyi 'dun ma 'di byas pa lags/ sa skyar bsdad/ bu slob 'dzom pa'ang dga' bar gda' ste/ dar cig kyang blo bde med par nam phugs khrab gyon la blo gtad pa'i 'dun ma 'dis sdug tshe ma phyid pa lags pas dgongs 'tshal/ mdor na/ sangs rgyas bstan pa pad tshal zum/ /bstan 'dzin ston kha'i sprin ltar dengs/ /ngan rtog 'dam gyis 'jig rten gang / /mi 'dod sdug bsngal char bzhin 'bab/ /bde 'gro'i gnas na ngan 'gro yi/ /longs spyod bye ba phrag brgyas gzir/ /gcig tu phan brtson dam pa rnams/ /zhing gzhan bde bar gshegs gyur pas/ /zhing 'di stongs par gyur ba 'am/ /yang na zhing gzhan sdug bsngal kun/ /zhing 'dir lhan cig bsdus pa bzhin/ /gnas skabs 'di 'dra mngon sum na/ /skye bo mi srun bya byed mang / /de dag log pa 'ba' zhig spyod/ /'di rnams shes ldan gang su dag /dmyal bzhin ring du cis mi 'dor/ /zhes pa'i phrin yig gzigs pa'i rten du phreng ba brgya rtsa gcig bdog stag lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco brgyad la dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /dge slong bsod dbang la springs pa/ yi ge bum chu ril bu dang bcas pa 'phrod/ dus kun tu so ma gsod kyi longs spyod 'phel zer ba thos na'ang / lan chags 'khor/ las ngan 'dzad pa'i thabs yin pas/ de ltar go na/ de nyid ka lam du blangs pas chog chos nas rkyen thog tu khel ba dgos zer ba de 'di 'dra la dgongs pa yin/ chos pa kun kyang / lto 'grangs nyi ma dra ོna yang rtsal kun kyang che/ zer ba bzhin rang thog tu ma byung na chos bshad mang po gtong / byung na sran sha'u bas kyang chung / ko long gtsang btsan pas kyang dam zer ba bzhin yong pa shin tu che bar 'dug na'ang / skabs don rkyen byung na gnyen pos sleb dgos shing lam du slong dgos pa yin no/ /mi la re ma che/ lha la gsol ba thob zer ba'i tshul du/

slar yang 'tshogs pa gdan 'dren pa sogs dge ba'i bya ba la 'bad zer ba bzhin/ da dung du'ang khyed rang ji tsam sdod kyi bar la/ dkon mchog gi zhabs tog dge ba'i bya ba rim gro rnams la 'bad pa thon/ mis yus 'khur ba ma byung na/ yus btags kyang rang sbyong pa las med pas/ su'i rtsar yang yus ma bsgom/ shags ngan ma rgod/ ces pa'i blo sbyong gi tshig de la ci nus su soms/ nged dpon slob rnams kyang khams bzang por kong po phyogs kyi bsod snyoms 'khor nas byang du jo bo'i drung du sleb yod/ skyid na lha lcam 'bod du yong / /sdug na ras chung log nas yong / /zer ba'i tshul yin na'ang / stabs bde ba byung na myur du yong ba yin/ rkyen ngan lam slong gi blo sbyong zer ba lags// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge tshogs dpag yas rnyog pa rab dwangs dri med rab yangs nam mkha'i dkyil/ /byams chen tshad med rin chen las grub dmigs med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /mkhyen pa'i 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro bas shes bya'i dngos kun gsal mdzad nas/ /'gro ba'i mun sel bla med bla ma nor bu kun nas mchod/ /phun tshogs yon tan rin chen bdun la dbang 'byor zhing / /bdud dang nyon mongs mi mthun g.yul las rnam rgyal nas/ /gdul bya gling bzhir chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor los sgyur rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /de yis legs bstan dam chos dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i chu/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral ming tshig bdag nyid lung gi chos/ /gang gis goms nas skyon bral so so rang rig mchog /mngon sum gyur ba rtogs pa'i chos la'ang mgos phyag 'tshal/ /de nyid thug chud byis pa'i chos las ring du gshegs/ /thar pa don gnyer skye bo'i tshogs kyis nyen gcig po/ /lha mi'i bsod nams dam pa'i dpal gyi zhing gyur pa/

/rnam gnyis dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs la'ang bdag cag dad/ /gang gi yid la dran pa tsam gyis log blo yi/ /tshang tshing mtha' dag drungs nas nges par 'byin mdzad cing / /spros pa rtsub mo'i reg bya dang bral gsung gi dbyangs/ /'gro kun khyab bde brtag par bdag yid gnas gyur cig /thub dbang bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i rjes gshegs shing / /drang nges don gyi de nyid gzigs pa'i bsil zer can/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab nor bu'i dpal las legs bskrun pa'i/ /bshes gnyen thub bstan kunda'i gnyen rnams zhabs brtan shog /gang zhig thogs med mthu stobs mchog la dbang 'byor zhing / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin legs bsgrubs pas/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dus gsum bu bzhin legs skyong zhing / /nag po'i phyogs 'joms bstan pa bsrung mdzad rgyal gyur cig /rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin 'jig rten dge legs kun bsgrub pa/ /mi zad longs spyod dpag med gter la mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /nor skyong rnams kyis 'jig rten 'di dang bstan 'dzin rnams/ /nam du'ang 'byor pas brel pa med par legs par skyongs/ /de ltar yul khyad par can bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la mchod par brjod cing 'jig rten dge legs su bya ba'i phyir/ shis par brjod pa'i ngag sngon du bkod nas/ skabs kyi don snyan du gsol ba ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i dpal las nye bar bskrun pa'i skyes mchog /'dzam bu'i gling phal mo che'i nye bar 'tsho ba kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ bu ram shing pa'i gdung rgyud shākya'i rigs kyi chos rgyal chen po rnams kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab las lung bstan pa ltar/ bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa kun gyi phu dud du bkur/ dam pa'i chos spel ba'i bdag rkyen rgya chen po mdzad/ rgyal srid chos dang mthun par legs par bskyangs pa'i rjes su mthun par/

mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir yang sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rnam 'phrul/ rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis sku srog dang longs spyod la 'phangs pa med par dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bzhin du rjes su bsgrubs te/ thub pa chen po'i ring lugs pa/ /ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /gsungs rab rin po che'i dgongs pa phyiin ci ma log par gzigs pa'i spyan dang / bdag nyid la 'phangs pa med par gcig tu gzhan la phan par dgongs pa'i thugs rje can/ paṇḍi ta sa'i steng na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i mkhas pa rnams spyan drangs/ bstan pa'i srol chen po btsugs/ bod 'bangs thams cad bde ba la bkod/ dam pa'i chos kyi snang bas rgya mtsho'i mthar thug par khyab par mdzad/ de nyid kyi rjes su stobs kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba/ tshad med pa'i mthu stobs kyis 'dzam bu'i gling phal mo che la dbang bsgyur ba/ jing gi gan nas brtsams te/ dpung dang stobs kyis pha rol zil gyis gnon zhing / thabs mkhas pas rang sde phyogs kun tu rgyas par mdzad/ sa chen gan gyi bar gyis yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po la dbang mdzad/ khyad par rgyal bu go dan dang / se chen gan gyis mkhas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ mtha' yas pa'i shes bya dang / tshad med pa'i gsung rab la snang ba phyogs bcur rgyas pas gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i 'dren pa dam par gyur pa/ chos kyi rje khu dbon hor gyi rgyal khams su spyan drangs/ bla'i mchod gnas kyi phu dud du bkur/ gsung gi bdud rtsi gus pa'i spyi bos bkur te/ bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams la gces spras rgya chen po mdzad/ dam pa'i chos bshad sgrub kyi bdag rkyen chen po nye bar sbyar/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams khral dmag las gsum las bton nas/ bstan pa'i bya ba dang / gong ma la smon lam 'debs su bcug khrims gnyis kyis 'jig rten rnams legs par bskyangs/

de gnyis ka'i bka' srol rjes su bsgrub pa'i phyir/ ol ja du rgyal po nas brtsams te/ mi'i dbang po bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can/ sa'i bdag po rgyal po chen po zhal bzhugs pa'i bar gyis/ mi'i dbang po'i gtsug rgyan/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams bsnyen bkur rgya chen pos mchod de/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rim par bskor/ de nyid kyi rjes su mthun par/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas long stong dang sum brgya 'das pa/ 'gal ba can gyi lo la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang / rgya nag gi rtsis pa'i lugs kyis/ me pho stag kun dga'i lo shar ba'i skabs 'dir/ phul du phyin pa'i mkhyen pa dang / rnam par dag pa'i thugs kyis 'gro ba rnams zhi ba dang des pas skyong ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs gu shrī bas dbugs phyogs kyi sde snod 'dzin pa dge 'dun dang bcas pa yar lung gi sa'i char spyan drangs nas zhabs rtog rnam par dag pa bsgrubs/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i lo las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang rgya nag gi rtsis pa'i lugs kyi shing pho stag ming gzhan kun dga' can gyi rgyal gyi zla ba shar ba'i skabs mdang sang gi thad du/ rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / lo paṇa skyes mchog dam pa rnams byon zhing zhabs kyis gcags pa'i sa'i cha/ dbur g.yor gyi sa'i cha la bzhugs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan zad mi shes pa la dbang 'byor bas/ bstan pa'i gsal byed dam par gyur cing / 'gro ba rnams kyi 'dren pa bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyis bsod nams sog pa'i zhing mchog bla ma rin po che zhal rnam pa dang / mkhan slob yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa phal mo che/ g.yor po yul bzhi'i sa'i mthil/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i bskor du spyan drangs nas nyin zhag lnga'i bar du chos dang mthun pa'i zhal chas cha phra mo dang /

sman gyi btung bas nye bar mchod nas/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i 'thad/ gdugs di ring gi skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa'i bla ma dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la dro'i bsnyen cing bkur ba ja dang bcas pas nye bar mchod nas/ yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la/ 'bul ba rnam gzhag cha phra mo spyan lam du bab tsam dang / gzhan yang gang la gang 'os kyi 'bul ba cha phra mo dang bcas pa phyag tu phul nas/ dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu gser zho re'i gral 'gyed kyi dngos po dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa 'di nyid/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par bya ba dang / gong ma yon mchod chen pos gtso mdzad bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad sku khams bzang zhing phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par bgyi ba dang / rgyal khams chen po phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas pa/ khyad par mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams kun tu dam pa'i chos rgyas shing mi nyams la dge legs su bya ba dang / rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang mi gnyis pa'i mkhyen brtse dang phrin las can rnams kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs la/ khyad par bla ma bdag nyid chen po dang / bla ma chen po kun dga' blo gros pas gtso mdzad pa'i bla ma sku mched rnams kyi gtso mdzad dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gsab pa dang / drin che ba ma'i rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs shing / dad pa can rnams kyi phul ba'i longs spyod rnams kyang don yod par bya ba'i phyir dang / ma 'ongs pa na rjes su bsgrub dgos pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa yang sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul gyis rjes su bsgrub pa'i phyir/ gdan sa chen pos gtso mdzad gtsang phyogs kyi sde rnams na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i zhal zas kyis bsnyen cing bkur ba zhag lnga'i bar du bsgrubs nas yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la 'bul ba cung zad dang /

dge 'dun khri phrag bzhi la so so'i phyag tu gser zho re'i 'gyed dang / skye bo'i tshogs khri phrag gsum la'ang bsnyen cing bkur ba nas khal re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa'i sku bkal la dmigs pa'am/ mkhan po mkhas mchog zhi ba'i lhas/ bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te/ /skye bo kun la btang sems kyis/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin gsungs te/ /zhes pa'i tshul dang mthun par lag tu bzung ba'i dngos po sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyis thog drangs/ zhwa lham gyis mtha' brten pa yan chad kyi bdog pa'i dngos po ci mchis pa thams cad lhag ma lus par gtong ba'i bya ba spong dag la dmigs nas/ drung nas zhal ta byon pa bzhin dge slong ba rnam pas thog drangs/ nye gnas rnam pas phyag len la thebs bar bgyis nas bsgrubs pa lags shing / 'bul ba rnam gzhag mtshon pa re bsgrubs pa yi ge'i ngos nas brda sprod pa 'di ltar lags/ bcom ldan 'das shākya'i dbang po'i sku tshab kha ba can gyi rten gsum rnams kyi gtso bo lha dang mi'i bsod nams spel ba'i zhing dang / byin rlabs kyi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa/ jo bo rin po che rnam gnyis kyi drung du/ lwa gser ma'i 'phan re/ dkar me re/ jo bo rin po che'i drung du/ ling gi bla gos gcig /mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams su bstan pa'i thog ma'i 'byung gnas dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po na bzhugs pa/ bzo gnas ngo mtshar gyi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa'i dpal byang chub chen po'i drung du/ gan gos kyi 'phan gcig dang / gtsug lag khang rnams su mar me/ cod pan dang bcas pa re/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa lta bur grags shing / mkhas pa dag bka' drin gyis sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa/ sdom brtson chen po thub pa'i ring lugs pa mkhan po dpal ldan zhi ba'i 'tsho'i dbu thod kyi drung du/ skras kyi rten khebs gcig dang dkar me gcig

sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ru gnon du bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang / thog mar byung ba dang rang byung gi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa bkra shis khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang du/ lwa gser ma'i 'phan gcig dang / dkar me gcig dpal gung thang dang 'tshur phu'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa/ sku tshad bzo gnas kyi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa'i lha chen dpal 'bar rnam gnyis kyi drung du/ lwa gser ma'i 'phan re dang / dkar me re/ snye thang 'or dang / rwa sgreng gi gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang bka' drin gyi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa'i jo bo chen po'i sku tshab rnam gnyis kyi drung du/ lwa gser ma'i 'phan re dang / dkar me re/ kha rag thod phu na bzhugs pa/ man ngag dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa/ jo bo ga ya dha ra dang 'brog mi lo tsā ba chen po'i sku lder gyi drung du/ lwa'i 'phan re dang / dkar me re/ gsang phu ne'u thog gi gtsug lag khang chen po na bzhugs pa/ rnam par dag pa'i 'phrin las dang / bshad rgyud kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa'i lo tsā ba chen po'i sku tshab kyi drung du/ lwa gser ma'i 'phan gcig dang / dkar me gcig yar 'brog 'dab ma lung / 'dam ko khyim/ 'phan yul rin chen sgang / chul shul gru gu sgang / tsha rags lhun grub sgang rnams na bzhugs pa/ mkhas pa dang phrin las kyi sgo nas mchog gyur pa'i chos kyi rje dang / bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po'i sku lder gyi drung du dkar me re dang / 'phan re/ shar dwags la sgam po dang / phag mo gru na bzhugs pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dang / bka' brgyud kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa ni/ rje dwags po sgam po pa dang / rje khams pa'i sku tshab kyi drung du/ 'phan re dang / dkar me re/ 'bri khung dang / stag lung na bzhugs pa/ phrin las dang mos gus kyi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa/

'bri gung chos rje dang / stag lung chen po'i sku tshab kyi drung du/ 'phan re dang / mar me re/ bya yul dang / rgya ma'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa/ rnam thar dang / jo bo'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ bya yul ba chen po dang / dgyer sgom chen po'i sku tshab kyi drung du/ 'phan re dang / dkar me re/ rin chen gling dang / slob dpon dharma rā dzas sgrub pa phul du byung ba'i blo gros dang / mkhyen rab kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i dus mchod la ja rdum re dang / sku lder gyi drung du/ lwa gser ma'i 'phan re dang / dkar me re/ dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen po dang / chos rdzong na bzhugs pa'i ma hā kā la lcam dral gyi drung du stag re/ rig sngags grub pa sngags 'chang padma 'byung gnas kyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i bka' srung du mnga' gsol ba'i srung ma khyad par can chos skyong pa'i rgyal po chen po'i drung du/ gan gos kyin bza'/ ljang yul gyi gser bre gcig 'gro ba'i phan bde phun tshogs mtha' yas 'byung ba'i gter/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin chen 'phel ba'i gnas/ /rnam dag yon tan dang ba'i chu bos rab gang ba'i/ /bstan 'dzin dge 'dun rgya mtsho gus pas mchod pa dang / /skye dang skye bar rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs kyis/ /sbyin khrims bsgoms pa'i bsod nams ji snyed bsags pa dang / /skye ba 'dir yang btsas ma thag tu dbang mchog gis/ /byin brlabs nas bzung thos bsam bzlas pa gang bgyis dang / /thub pa phyogs kyi lo la khyim nas nges 'byung zhing / /skye bdag can la rdzogs par bsnyen pa nas brtsams te/ /rig byed rgya mtshor bcas pa'i lo ni phyi dang nang / /bzo dang gso ba gtan tshigs gnas la goms bgyis shing / /bka' drin nod pa'i dpal ldan bla ma nyi shu bzhi/ /bka' drin mchog gis legs skyong bshes gnyen dam pa lnga'i/

/zhabs la gus bstan thos bsam bsgom pa rnam gsum dang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bde gshegs bstan pa legs bzung zhing / dkon mchog gsum mchod 'gro la sbyin pa rnam gsum sbyin/ /bslab gsum gus brten 'gro la gnod cing bslu ba yi/ /bsam sbyor 'bad pas ring du bsring sogs las byung ba'i/ /bsod nams bgyis dang bgyid par 'gyur ba ci mchis pa'i/ /pha mas gtso dang sems can kun dang thun mongs bas/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras 'phags gzhan bstan pa 'dzin rnams dang / /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs shing / /skye dgu mtha' yas rgyal ba'i sa la gnas par shog /rgyal ba mchog gi go 'phang bla med ma thob par/ /skye dang skye bar dal 'byor mchog la dbang 'byor zhing / /rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin dal chos spyod pa legs sgrub pas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dpal la legs spyod shog /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i slad/ /'jig rten kun tu nad sogs nye bar 'tshe med cing / /nags tshal bcud sogs phun sum tshogs pas rab gang ste/ na rga med par chos bzhin bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyang / /nye bar 'tshe dang rgud dang phongs pa kun bral nas/ /gus pas rnyed dang rgya chen bkur sti dang bcas te/ /ji ltar smon bzhin phyogs rnams kun du rgyas par shog /bdag kyang skye 'dir phyi dang nang gi 'tshe med par/ /bstan pa'i snying por rtse gcig zol med gus bsten pas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan ba dam pa rab 'dzin zhing / /zung 'jug dge la rtse gcig bde dang ldan gyur cig /bdag gzhan phan pa'i don rnams yid bzhin legs grub nas/ /nam zhig tshe rabs gzhan du bgrod par 'gyur ba na/ /gnyis med bde chen 'od gsal chen po'i ngang nyid las/ /snang ba mtha' yas zhabs drung mngon sum phyin gyur cig /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu bzang zhing dga' ba der/

/pad mo dam pa rgya chen shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal ba mchog gis mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis gnas skabs der thob shog /rgyal bas tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag mi 'gyur mthu stobs dang / /dge 'dun bslab gsum dag pa'i bden dang bden tshig gis/ /bdag gis smon lam btab pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /phyogs dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis shing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde bas khyab par gyur cig /de skad smra ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes bya a wa dhū tī pa/ /thub pa'i bstan la zol med gus pa can/ /dge sbyong tshul gnas dpal ldan sa skya pa'o/ /bsam yas chos 'khor gyi 'bul yig /shu bhaṃ// // ༄/ /oṃswasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan rin chen bye ba'i tshogs kyis kun nas mdzes pa'i dpal yon can/ /dmigs med thugs rje'i mdangs rab gsal ba'i 'gying bag gar gyis rol pa can/ /dpag yas phrin las bgrang las 'das pas 'gro kun dpal du gyur pa can/ /gang gi zhabs pad mtha' yas dregs pa rnam par 'jig mdzad dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ /rgya chen rab zab bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis bya lam rab yangs par/ /shes bya ma lus mngon sum gzigs pa'i chu 'dzin stug po legs dkrigs nas/ /'gro ba'i sa gzhir phan bde'i char rgyun dus su phab pas thar pa yi/ /lo thog rgya chen nye bar bskrun mdzad rdzogs sangs sgra sgrogs la phyag 'tshal/ /de yis gdul ba'i bsam dang dus bzhin yol ba med par legs bab pa'i/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis sbu ba'i phreng can dam chos dri med bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'khor ba'i gdung pa sel ba'i slad du dus kun rgyun mi 'chad par yang / /dman dang bar ma mchog gi rgya mtshor skal pa ji bzhin 'bab gyur cig /de las byung ba'i lam bzang 'o ma'i rgyun gyis thugs kyis lus stobs rab brtas shing /

rgya chen legs gsungs dam chos snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i dar dir can/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen 'byung gnas kun nas mdzes par mdzad pa po/ /theg gsum tshogs mchog ngang pa'i tshogs kyis sa steng kun nas khyab gyur cig /mchog gsum yon tan nyid la bsdus bzhin phun tshogs 'gran zla ma mchis shing / /phyogs kun khyab pa'i snyan par grags pas kun la rab dga'i dpal ster la/ /don gyi dam pa gzigs pa'i shes rab pha rol son pa'i ting 'dzin can/ /phrin las bzang po gang la mnga' bas 'gro la dus kun gzigs gyur cig /de ltar mchod yul khyad par du 'phags pa/ spyir bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la mchod par brjod cing / khyad par bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa/ phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ bla ma rin po che zhi ba'i grong khyer mchog tu gdul bya 'dul ba'i ngor gshegs pa nyid la gsol ba 'debs pa'i ngag sngon du bkod nas/ skabs kyi don snyan du gsol ba ni/ phul du byung ba'i mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son par mdzad nas/ bstan pa'i snying po sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mngon par rtogs pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bus kun nas mdzes pa dus kun tu mi nub par 'dzin pas/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro ba phal che ba thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog la 'god par mdzad pa'i phrin las tshad med pa mnga' ba can/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun phag mo grub pa chen po de nyid kyis/ bstan pa'i dar rgyas dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po la dgongs te/ yul dbus kyi sa'i snying po me tog dang / 'bras bu du mas spud pa'i ljon pa sna tshogs mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur ba ltar 'khod cing / bya sna tshogs ka la ping ka'i sgra dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs pas gang la/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i lteng ka sna tshogs dag cing gsal bas gang ba'i kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod 'dir phyag phab nas/

rang gzhan gya ིdon gnyis phun tshogs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad de/ nyi ma shar nub lho byang thams cad yon bdag dang bu slob tu ma gyur pa med cing / ding sang gi bar du phrin las rgya chen po rgyun mi 'chad par yod pa de/ kun gyi thugs la gsal/ rje btsun rin po che de nyid zhi bar gshegs pa'i rjes nas/ 'jig rten mgon po chos rjes gdan sa mdzad pa'i skabs su/ bla ma'i lung bstan byung ba la brten nas/ 'bri khung du byon te 'gro don bskyangs/ de'i thad du/ mkhyen rabs 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro bas gdul bya'i chu skyes rgyas par mdzad cing / rnam grol gsum gyi sbrang rtsi'i dog pas 'khor ba'i rgud pa nye bar skyob la/ thub bstan dus kun gsal bar mdzad pa'i grags pa'i dri bzang 'khor yug ri bo'i pha mthar son zhing / gdul bya'i phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas/ rje spyan snga rin po che zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa des/ gdan sa rin po che 'di nyid legs par bskyangs pa nas bzung ste/ ding sang gi bar du/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen brtse'i spyan can/ phrin las thogs pa med pas gdul bya'i dpal mgon du gyur pa bzang za ram tshags su byon pa rnams kyis/ bstan pa'i dar rgyas/ gdul bya'i don rgya chen po mdzad cing / khyad par/ bla ma rin po che zhi bar gshegs pa nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ sku tshe snga mar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po nye bar bskrun pa la brten nas sku tshe 'dir/ rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang rnam par dag cing / bod kyi btsan po'i blon chen po glangs 'khams pa go cha'i brgyud/ rje spyan snga rin po che la sogs pa/ bla ma rin po che rim par byon pa'i gdung rgyud du sku 'khrungs shing / sku nas gzhon nu nas/ bstan pa rin po che'i sgor rab tu byung ba 'dul ba la rab tu byung ba mdzad nas/ thos bsam gyi bya ba rgya chen pos chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud par mdzad de/

gdan sa 'di nyid du/ chos rje gong ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa dang rjes su mthun par thugs dam gyi rim pa la yang yun ring du bzhugs shing / de rjes nas bsod nams kyi mthu chen pos/ khrims gnyis rjes su skyong bas/ chen po'i chen po rnams kyis bkur ba'i gnas mchog tu gyur pa/ ta'i si tu chen pos gtso mdzad bu slob/ mtha' rgya dang bcas pa rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ gdan sa 'di nyid du bzhugs nas/ bstan pa'i dar rgyas rgya cher spel ba/ 'gro ba mang po'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa/ gdul bya rnams kyi dpal mgon du smon pa dang mthun par bzhugs pas/ yun ring du bdag cag rnams kyi 'dren pa dam par mi bzhugs ka med du mchis pa lags na'ang / kha ni nas kyi skabs su/ gdul bya'i ngor bsnyung ba'i tshul bstan zhing / de'i thad du gu shrī ba'i drung nas gtso mdzad/ slob 'bangs rnams kyis tshogs chen po 'di nyid du zho 'gyed kyis thog drangs pa'i dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' gsung sgrog pa/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa la sogs pa'i sku rim/ sa phyogs 'di nyid kyi sman pa mkhas pa rnams spyan drangs nas/ gso ba'i gzhung dang mthun pa'i sman dpyad/ 'phral gyi bsnyung g.yog la sogs phyogs gang nas ci lcogs kyis 'bad pa cher bgyis pa lags na'ang / zhing 'di nyid kyi dngos kyi gdul bya'i don mthar son pa'am/ zhing gzhan du gdul bya che ba la dgongs pa'am/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che yang nub la nye bar gyur pa dang / bdag cag gdul byar gyur pa rnams kyi bsod nams kyi shin tu dman par gyur pa'i dbang gis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams skye 'chi dang bral yang / 'chi 'pho'i tshul ston pa dang mthun par/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi rtag par 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ mdang sang gi skabs su/ zhing 'di nyid kyi sprul pa'i sku bsdu ba mdzad nas/

zhing khams rnam par dag pa gzhan du 'gro ba'i don la gshegs shing / de'i rjes nas/ bla ma rin po che nyid la gsol ba 'debs shing / thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i thabs bsgrub pa las gzhan pa'i glags ma mchis pas/ thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i ched du/ thel shod kyi mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ rim pa dang bcas pa rnams spyan drangs nas/ bla ma rin po che nyid la gsol ba 'debs pa'i bya ba la dmigs te/ zhags bdun phrag gcig gi bar du/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud kyi cho ga rgyud sde dang mthun par bsgrub pa'i sgo nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa dang / ston pa bde bar gshegs pa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa dang / khyad par bla ma rin po che nyid la gsol ba rnam par dag pa btab cing / de dag gi thad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod pa'i yo byad nye bar sbyar ba dang / cho ga mdzad pa rnams la'ang bsnyen cing bkur ba rnam par dag pa bsgrubs nas/ cho ga legs par grub pa'i thad du/ cho ga ba rnams dang / gzhan yang gang la gang 'os kyi me tog gi dngos po spyan lam la phab pa bsgrub pa dang / thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i thabs sku 'dab kyi rim pa la dmigs te/ gsang gtol gyi skabs su gdan sa 'di nyid na bzhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen phyogs rigs nas byon pa dang bcas pa rnams la gser zho phyed re'i 'gyed dang / gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i dus su yang / gdan sa 'di nyid na bzhugs pa rnams la tsha ba'i bsnyen cing bkur bas nye bar mchod pa dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa dang / gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la gro'i bsnyen cing bkur ba/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten dang bcas pa sgrub par 'gyur ba dang / dwags la sgam po/ 'bri khung / stag lung / gung thang / rgya ma/ bya yul rnams kyis thog drangs/

dbur stod dang / skyi yor gyi sa la bzhugs pa'i chos sde rnams dang / gtsang gi sa cha la bzhugs pa'i chu zhal stong skor/ lha sde gzhung gi dgon sde rnams su'ang / mang ja'i bsnyen cing bkur ba/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten dang bcas pa bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang / khyad par/ di ring gi skabs su/ gdan sa rin po che 'di nyid na bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang / yar 'on na bzhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang / gzhan yang phyogs ris nas byon pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun skye bo'i tshog sa dang bcas pa/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i zhal zas tsha ba'i bsnyen cing bkur bas nye bar mchod nas/ dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gral 'gyed kyi dngos po dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa 'di nyid/ bla ma rin po che zhi bar gshegs pa nyid kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs la dmigs nas/ gu shrī ba'i drung nas gsung zhal ta ji ltar byon pa'i lugs bzhin/ bu slob 'brel ba rnams kyis sa nas gdung 'bul byung ba rnams dang / thel shod kyi nang so rnams nas gzhi blangs te/ gnyer chen rnam gnyis dang / sgom tshul bas 'bad pa do dam cher bgyis te/ bsam sbyor dad gus dang bcas pas bsgrubs pa lags shing / yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la/ 'bul ba me tog cung zad re bgyis pa yi ge'i ngos nas brda sprod pa 'di ltar lags/ de ltar srid gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas bla ma'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs slad/ /rgyal bas yon gnas mchog tu bsngags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la/ /mi dmigs ngang nas bsod nams bsags gang sems can kun dang thun mong du/ /bsgrubs pa'i dge bas 'dren mchog bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs pa rab rdzogs te/ /sems can kun la phan bzhed ji bzhin srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/

/gti mug mun pas ldongs pa'i 'gro 'di shes rab mchog gi snang ba yis/ /ma rig rta bcas mun gnag drungs phyung bla ma'i phrin las bzang po yis/ /rnam grol grong khyer bde ba'i 'byung gnas rga shi med par myur 'jug sogs/ /gzhan yang skye dgu'i 'di dang phyi mar phan dang bde ba'i phun tshogs gzhi/ /thub pa'i bstan pa 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i gnyen de'ang dus kun tu/ /nyes pa'i dri mas gos pa med cing de 'dzin 'gro ba'i gnyen mchog rnams/ /slan chad mi mthun g.yul las rgyal nas rnam pa kun tu zhabs brtan shog /de bzhin 'gro ba'i dga' ston slad du 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir 'bru bcu dang / /rtsi shing nags tshal phun sum tshogs shing char rgyun dus su 'bab pa dang / /kun kyang dge ba'i sems la gnas pas phun tshogs phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin/ /sa steng ma lus kun tu gang ba'i mya ngan nyer 'tshe zhi gyur cig /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu dang / da ltar yon tan gnas mchog dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu'i bden pa'i tshig gis ji skad smon lam btab pa bzhin du 'grub cing / slan chad phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis dang bde legs chen pos khyab par shog cig gdan sa phag mo gru'i spyan snga rin po che grags pa shes rab pa'i gshegs rdzongs kyi 'bul yig drung chos rje pas mdzad pa/ /shubhaṃ// // ༄༅/ /oṃ /sa skya bka' gros pa la gnang ba swasti siddhaṃ/ gang gis mkhyen pas shes bya kun gsal snang bas sna tshogs gzugs la bzhin/ /thugs rjes 'gro kun gdung ba zhi mdzad bdud rtsis skoms pa'i 'gro la bzhin/ /mdzad pas phan bde phun tshogs rgyas mdzad nyin byed zer gyis pad dmar bzhin/ /gang la mnga' ba'i zhabs pad gus 'dud mgo bos gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/

/rgyal dang de sras thugs rje'i chu gter che las byung / /zab dang rgya che'i chos sgra lhung lhung snyan sgrogs shing / /gsung rab yid bzhin nor bu'i dpal la dbang 'byor pa/ /mkhas grub chu klung dri med tshogs mchog rgyal gyur cig /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i mdzad pa gcig tu bsdus pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rim par byon pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan sa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i sde gnas mchog na nye bar bzhugs pa/ yon tan rin po che'i spyan stong gis mdzes pa'i lha'i dbang po mkhyen rab rnam par dag pa'i chos bzang 'dun sar/ legs par bshad pa'i chos kyi dga' ston rgya chen pos gdul bya'i lha tshogs mtha' yas pa'i dge ba'i yid rab tu sad par mdzad pa bka' gros pa rnams kyi snyan du zhu ba/ sku la bsnyun mi mnga' zhing chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu 'phel ba'i thad nas phrin las mchog tu mdzes pa'i srad bus/ snyan dngags rin po che'i phreng ba legs par sbrel zhing / nye bar brjod pa'i tshig snyan pa'i mdangs gsal bas phyin ci ma log pa'idon yid 'phrog pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa/ rten dri ma med pa'i ka dan gser dang bcas pas nye bar mdzes pa bdag cig gi sug par phyin pas rab tu dang ba'i yid dbyar gyi chu'i ngogs ltar 'phel bar mchis/ bdag kyang khams bzang bar bdog skabs kyi don/ sngar bzhin sku khams kyi 'tsho skyong / 'jig rten dang 'das pa'i bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas dam pa'i chos 'dzin skyong spel ba dang / gdan sa rin po che'i phun tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i bya ba la brtson pa cher mdzad par gsol zhing mchis/ bdag cag do cog der yong mchis lags pa la gong gi bde bdog dang gser yig pa'i lan gsal ba ma thos pas yong stabs ma byung zhing / ding sang yar phyogs la yongs nas/ dgun dbus phyogs la sleb pa bgyis te/ bla chen pa bzhugs dus bskur ba'i jo bo rin po che'i khri rgyab kyi cha gcig bdog pa sngar ma grub pas de sgrub kyin mtshams se sdod/

de tshar nas legs par grub pa dang / 'bod mi ma byung yang gdan sar yong pa lags pas de bar la mi mi gtong ba zhu/ legs pa'i lam gyur rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /mchog tu rgyas pas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun/ /kun tu nyer bzhi phan bde dus kun 'phel/ /'phel bas srid zhi'i rgud pa zhi gyur cig /gnas skabs gangs can sa gzhi spos kyi chu/ /mkhas grub pad mo'i phreng bas legs gtams shing / /dge legs sbrang rtsi'i bdog pas 'gro ba yi/ /rkang drug ldan pa rtag tu dga' bar shog /de skad smras pa a wa dhū tī pa/ /bstan la gus pas bstan pa'i tshul 'chang ba/ /ring na gnas kyang nye ba'i yid can gyis/ /gsol la nongs pa gang de'ang bzod mdzad rigs/ /yi ge gzigs pa'i rten du gser zho do bdog /lug gi lo zla ba drug pa'i gnam gang la yang rtser bris pa'i yi ge shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /shubhaṃ// // bla ma bzhi thog pas gtso mdzad dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpon chen dang bcas pa la gnang ba/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ mkhyen pa kun ldan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog /sdug bsngal kun sel dam chos chos kyi mchog /bstan pa legs 'dzin bsod nams zhing rab mchog /mchog gsum gang des kun tu dge legs mdzod/ /ces shis par brjod pa'i ngag sngon du brjod nas/ skabs kyi don/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gdan sa rin po che na bzhugs pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag phul du byung ba'i yon tan rin po che du mas mngon par phyug pa'i bla ma bzhi thog pas gtso mdzad pa'i yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dpon chen rnam pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun bya ba byed pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi snyan du 'bul ba ni/ da lo'i skabs su/ gong ma mi'i dbang po/ sa'i bdag po rgyal po chen pos thugs la btags nas/ slob dpon chen po kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang po'i zhal sngar/ 'ja' sa gnang sbyin/

shel gyi dam kha dang bcangs pa gnang nas/ bzhi thog tu bzhugs la bstan pa'i bya ba dang / gong ma yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa la smon lam thob gsung ba'i lugs bzhin/ thugs kyi go cha rgya cher bsnams nas bzhi thog gi gdan sar bzhugs te/ dbon po rnam pas gtso mdzad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams dang bu slob mtha' rgya dang bcas pa rnams kyi skyong bran/ lung rigs sbrel ba'i 'chad nyan/ dus kyi rim gro la sogs/ gong ma yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i sku'i rim gro dang / smon lam rnam par dag pa 'debs pa la sogs/ bya ba gang dang gang la mdzad par 'os shing / thams cad la phan pa'i chos 'jig rten gyi tshul dang mthun par 'ba' zhig mdzad pa'i sgo nas thams cad la nye ring med pa'i spyi skyong mdzad pa dang / dbon po rnam pas gtso mdzad dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rnams dang / bya las dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang / bla ma bzhi thog pa'i gsung la legs par mnyan nas/ rang 'dod dang 'then 'khyer du ma song bar thams cad thugs rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas bla ma bzhi thog pa'i zhabs tog dang / gdan sa'i spyi tshis su 'gyur ba bsgrub pa'i sgo nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rnams kyis bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba 'chad nyan sgom gsum la brtson pa/ bya las pa rnams kyis kyang so so'i zhen dang rus shing la bsnyad pa'i 'dod mos kyi bya bar ma song ba/ thams cad thugs rtse gcig cing / zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba'i bya ba kho na la 'bad pa gal che zhes pa'i zhu ba snyan du 'bul ba'i rten/ mang ja zhu ba la dge slong bsod nams dbang phyug btad pa lags shing / bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten nam/ bzhi thog tu bzhugs pa'i ja zhal gyi rten mtshon par gan ja sig cig dang / gzhung lam sig cig bdog /phan bde gang la rag las pa/ /bstan dang de 'dzin gyur pa kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar cher 'phel zhing / /dpal dang 'byor pas brgyan par shog

/'gro ba 'di dag sdug bsngal mtshor bying las/ /thabs mkhas byams pa'i gru bzhon la brten zhing / /gcig tu brtse ba'i thabs kyis legs bskyod nas/ /rdzogs sangs rin chen gling du phyin gyur cig /gnas skabs kun tu bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang / /mi 'bral thos bsam bsgrub la rab brtson zhing / /bde legs rgya mtsho'i dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /bla ma'i phrin las ji bzhin 'jug gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /na mo budaddhā ya/ gang gi mkhyen brtses zag med yon tan kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pas bya lam yangs pa bzhin/ /dpe zla bral bas rang nyid rang gi dper/ /dgod par snyam sems bla med bla mar 'dud/ /blo gros mchog la mnyam pa'ang ma mchis na/ /lhag par gyur pa 'gro na lta ci smos/ /de slad grags pas 'dzin pa kun khyab pa'i/ /yon tan dpag yas nor bu'i rgyal mtshan mchog /bdag yid dang ba'i khang bzang rtser bkod de/ /mkhas pa'i bsti gnas gtsug lag khang chen de/ /kun gyis bstod cing bkur bar bya ba'i phyir/ /yun du gsal bar ring nas gsol bar bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med/ /dam pa khyed kyi thos bsam bsgom pa'i tshul/ /bsnyel ba med par sgrub la rab brtson pa/ /rnam par dkar ba'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /spros pa'i phrin yig bdud rtsi'i bsil zer gyis/ /bdag blo dga' ba'i ku mud rab rgyas pas/ /yid bde'i ze'u 'bru kun nas bsal ba'i mthus/ /phrin yig kunda'i dga' ston 'di bskrun to/ /slad nas thub bstan nyin mor byed pa yi/ /dpal las sdom brtson chu skyes dbang po khyod/ /bdag blo'i ku mud dpal la 'gran bzhin du/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs par gsol bar 'tshal/ /dbyar skyes rkang drug ldan pa bdag nyid kyang / /gsung yig rta bdun zer gyis reg pa'i mthus/ /rab tu brtson pa'i 'dab gnyis rab bskyod nas/ /mkhas pa'i bsti gnas pad tshal gtug par bgyid/ /ces pa spre'u lo zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes brgyad la bla ma mnyam med grags rgyal la'o/

/yon tan rin chen kun gyis gang ba'i mdzod/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyal mtshan ches gsal bas/ /don gnyis rnam par dag pa'i dpal yon can/ /phrin las bzang ldan gang de rgyal gyur cig /ces bla ma shar ba la'o// // ༄/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ rnam dag khrims kyi yid bzhin nor bus 'byor/ /mkhyen brtse ting 'dzin dam pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes/ /phrin las bzang pos gdul bya'i 'gro ba rnams/ /byang chub rtse mor phyin mdzad gang de rgyal/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dbang po de nyid kyi zhal snga nas gsung yig snyad ngag rin po che'i rgyan bkra rten rnam par dag pa'i cod paṇa gyis mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan rab tu dkar ba'i thugs kyi phyag gis bdag blo dang ba'i khang bzang rtser gsal bar mdzad pas yid bde'i mdzes pa'i khyad par sna tshogs gsal ba/ g.yal ba'i sku la mtshan gyis nye bar spras pa bzhin/ skabs don/ bstan pa'i slad du sku khams rin po che'i 'tsho skyong la brtson pa mdzad pa gal che zhing / spyan gyis lcogs na 'dul ba'i ṭī kā la 'phro cig yod pa dang / nag po pa dang / kun spyod kyi ṭī kā la sogs pa thob pa yang 'ga' re mchis shing / gzhan yang mdo mangs kyi 'phro 'dra ba dang bcas pa'i than thun sngar der mnga' ba dang / mi mnga' ba yang ci rigs zhu rgyu than thun mchis pa rten 'brel sgrig thabs ji ltar gnang gsung glengs nas bgyid pa'i rtsis lags pa dgongs nas/ dbyar chos la bo dong du bzhugs pa cig yod mchi lags pas/ da ston 'di/ gong gi kha skad 'dra la brtags nas zhu ba rim pas bskur ba lags/ zhal ta gda' na'ang rim pa bzhin gnang ba zhu/ spyan sngar gyi bzhin las ma mchis shing / de la gnod par gda' na bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po'i bar chad du 'gyur bas zhu spobs mi nus lags/ shes pa gzegs pa'i rten tsam du bzang ras kyi rten khebs gcig 'bul/ nyer lnga la dge/ mkhan chen byang rtse la'o// // ༄༅/ /dus sum rgyal ba'i gdung tshab khyung po rnal 'byor pa'i/

/phrin las bsgrub mdzad sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi rtser/ /dpe bral mngon rtogs yid bzhin nor bu legs bkod de/ /'gro la dpag yas 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs legs par mchod/ /bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi dpal gyis ches cher mtho ba bstan pa'i snying po sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i skyes bu dam pa rin po che tshul khrims mgon po'i zhal sngar phul ba/ sku khams bzang zhing thugs dam gyi ngang las gdul bya'i don mi bsnyel ba'i thad nas/ bdag cag la gsung yig gser zho'i gnang sbyin dang bcas pa bskur ba legs par thengs pas shin tu spro zhing / jar bsgyur te tshim par longs spyad mchis lags/ bdag cag kyang snyom las su ma gyur tsam bdog skabs kyi zhu ba la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che ba rnams dus kyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du byon zhing sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rjes khyed nyid kyi phrin las gdul bya la 'jug pa'i dus su mchis pas/ snyigs ma'i sems can rnams kyi tshul gyis g.yel ba ring du spangs nas bstan pa rin po che'i slad du yun du bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel du gdan zhig 'bul bar mchis pas dngos po la mtshengs pa ma mchis na'ang rten 'brel sgrig pa'i slad du sleb ma thag gdan du bting nas 'khor ba ma stong kyi bar du bzhugs nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las bsgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan po dgongs pa dang / de'i mthun rkyen du rgyal ba rgyal sras rnams la'ang gsol ba gdab pa/ chos skyong rnams la'ang bka' bsgo ba ci nas kyang mdzad par zhu/ mchog gsum mthu dpal bsam mi khyab pa dang / /bka' srung mthu stobs lha dang drang srong sogs/ /bden smra'i tshig dang bdag gi lhag bsam rnams/ /dag pa'i mthu dang smon bzhin 'grub gyur cig /sa ga'i zla ba'i dga' ba'i tshes la phul ba dge legs mchog tu gyur cig

stag tshang ba bla ma khyung po la gnang ba'o// // ༄༅/ bde ba can pa rnams la gnang ba3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>/oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ lung dang rigs pa'i sgra dbyangs rgyun mi 'chad par sgrog pa'i dga' ston/ mkhas pa'i skye bo du ma'i yid rab tu dwangs zhing / gdul bya'i blo gros kyi rna ba'i dbang po kun nas tshim par mdzad pa'i chos grwa chen po bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i bla ma gdan sa pas gtso mdzad pa'i yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i snyan du/ skabs don nye bar brda sprod pa ni/ mdang sang gi skabs su mdzes mi mdzes ci rigs byung ba de nyid kyi thugs ngal bar mi 'gyur bar/ bla ma gdan sa pas zhal ta byon pa'i lugs bzhin/ rang nyid kyi'ang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don 'grub par byed pa'i ched dang / de las bstan pa rin po che 'phel bas/ sems can rnams la phan par 'gyur ba'i don du/ kha sing nas ji ltar go gyon pa bzhin spyir bstan pa'i bya ba 'chad nyan/ sgos da lo dbyar chos kyi thad du/ 'chad nyan la brtson par 'gyur ba'i brtson 'grus rnam pa gsum la brtson par chen po mdzad pa gal che/ mdang sang mdzad sgo chen po byung yod par gda' ba'i 'brel sogs kyi mtshon par/ ja gzhung lam sig cig dang mdze gcig bdog snron gyi zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la dge bar gyur cig dge legs chur byung dpag yas yon tan 'dab stong ldan/ /thugs rje'i lo 'dab phrin las du ma'i grib bsil can/ /sa gsum bla ma thub dbang sngon med chu skyes phreng / /'gro ba kun gyi gtsug na rtag par mdzes gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /phun tshogs yon tan kun gyi gter/ /mtha' yas dri ma 'khrud pa'i chu/ /phan bde'i snang ba bskyed pa'i sgron/ /bla med bla ma rgyal gyur cig /tshul khrims dag pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /gdul bya'i blo mun rab sel ba'i/

/bshes gnyen mchog la ring du bsnyad/ /ces dam pa dbon po la'o/ /shubhaṃ// // ༄༅/ /skabs 'dir/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/ skabs don gyi brda sprod chu klung gi sgra snyan du gsol bar zhu 'tshal/ zhu skabs na/ lo rgyus kyi don nye bar bsdus pa'i dbang du bgyis na/ bkra shis shing bka' drin mi brjed pa'i don du skyabs kyi mchod brjod/ mchod yul gyi che ba dbyung ba'i don du tshogs pa'i yon tan can gyi nye ba dang 'dus tshul gyi sgo nas 'brel tshogs/ byas shes dang drin gzo'i slad du bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus/ dgos ched rtogs pa'i don du skabs kyi don nye bar mtshon pa dang lngas snyan du gsol ba las/ skyabs kyi mchod brjod la'ang / mchog dman gyi rim pa/ rgyu 'bras kyi rim pa/ bshad pa'i rim pa/ dgos pa'i rim pa la sogs pa mang du mchis pa las/ mchog dman ni rgyu 'bras kyi rim pas gsol na/ thub bstan nyin mor mdzad pa'i rta bdun bdag po/ /thugs rje'i chu klung 'gyed pa'i yid bzhin rgya mtsho/ /legs bshad sgra snyan sgrog pa'i dri za'i glu dbyangs/ /phan bde'i char rgyun 'bebs pa'i chu 'dzin dbang po/ /gdul bya'i dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dbang gi rgyal po/ /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i mkha' dbyings blo bur dri ma'i sprin bral yangs pa/ de nyid thugs su chud pa'i ye shes ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rtogs pa ste/ de dag zung 'jug spangs rtogs chos sku/ /chos sku'i bdag rkyen mchog gis legs bskrun/ /sar gnas 'gro ba mtshan dpe 'bar bas/ /theg chen chos sgrogs longs spyod rdzogs sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku gang gi mthu las/ /thun mong mchog gi gdul bya rnams la/ /rang rang bsam bzhin legs par sprul bas/ /mkha' dang 'gro ba ji srid gnas par/

/phan dang bde mdzad sprul pa'i sku ste/ /sku gsum zung 'jug 'brel ba'i sangs rgyas/ /'phags pa'i shes rab dag pa'i me yis/ /las nyon tshang tshing bsregs pa'i rtogs pa/ /so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes/ /yan lag brgyad dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa/ /de dag ston byed lung gi chos te/ /lung rtogs bsgrub pa'i bdag nyid dam chos/ /nang gi gzigs pa dag pa'i rgyal sras/ /myang 'das zhi ba'i grong gshegs nyan thos/ /byis pa'i sa las 'das pa'i dge 'dun/ /de ltar skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gis kun gyi thod bzhin gus pas bsten pa'i skyabs gnas dam par bzhugs pa lags/ skyabs gsum de dag gi phrin las nye bar sgrub byed rten gsum mchod pa'i sprin dang bcas pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhing mchog rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa bzhugs pa bsam las 'das pa/ khyad par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul/ chos rgyal chen po'i dgongs pa'i dpal las 'khrungs shing / bod 'bangs yongs kyi smon lam dag pa'i dpal las bskrun pa'i/ rgyal ba rnams kyi rnam par 'phrul ba/ lo paṇa skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ bkod pa dang bzo gnas kyi sgo nas brgya byin lha'i dbang po'i bzhugs gnas dang tshul mtshungs pa lta bur gyur pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po rnams na yang / thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs las nye bar bskrun zhing / 'gro la rab tu dang ba'i dpal bskyed pa/ thub dbang nyid dang tshul mtshungs pa lta bur gyur pas/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa kun gyis blta bas chog mi shes pa'i yon tan dang / gdul bya'i rgyud la sgrib pa sbyong zhing / phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal bskyed pa'i byin rlabs kyis mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i/ jo bo byang chub chen pos thog mdzad pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog rnams kyi drung na/

dad can rnams kyi bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu dang / bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu'i tshogs kyis nye bar mchod pa dang bcas pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par bzhugs shing / de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs sam 'khor na/ mthu stobs kyis brgya byin gyi dpal yang zil gyis gnon par nus pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis sna tshogs cir yang sprul pas rig sngags 'chang rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang dam las mi 'da' bar/ gtsug lag khang chen po chos bzhin du skyong zhing / nag po'i phyogs rnams thams cad la mkhas pas tshar gcod la/ bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar gces par mdzad pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i phrin las rjes su skyong ba'i chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags par bzhugs pa lags/ de dag gi chab 'og tu mchod yul du spyan drangs pa rnams kyi che ba'i yon tan phyogs tsam nye bar mtshon pa/ mchog dang thun mong gi yon tan/ gtso bo dang phal ba'i yon tan/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i go rim gyis yon tan gyis snyan du gsol/ skyabs gsum de dag dang mdzad pa'i phrin las la tha dad mi mnga' ba'i bdag nyid bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i rkang 'thung / mkhyen pa rnam par dag pa'i yal 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas shing / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'bras bu phun tshogs kyis spung la/ rnam par dag pa'i phrin las kyi grib bsil gyis/ gdul bya'i las nyon gyi tsha gdung bsil zhing / rnam grol gyi 'dod dgu'i dpal gyis gdul bya'i re 'dod bskong bar mdzad pa/ chos kyi rje rin po che'i drung nas/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus/ gdan gyi thog mar bzhugs shing / de nyid kyi bka' 'khor na/

rnam par dag pa'i tshogs gnyis dang / phun sum tshogs pa'i rigs mchog gi rgya mtsho chen po'i dpal las 'khrungs shing / dri ma med pa'i tshul khrims kyi dbyibs rab tu mdzes la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi kha dog gis rnam par bkra zhing rgya chen mkhyen pa'i gzi 'od phyogs bcur rgyas pas gdul bya'i ma rig pa'i mun pa drungs nas 'byin zhing / phan bde'i phrin las kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pas gdul bya'i re 'dod yid bzhin bskong bar mdzad pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ bla ma rin po che pa/ zhal rnam pa'i drung nas thog mdzad/ rab tu yangs pa'i blo gros kyi nam mkhar/ mang du gsan pa'i sprin tshogs stug po dkrigs te/ lung dang rigs pa'i 'brug sgra zab mo bsgrags pas/ 'gro ba ma rig pa'i gnyid las slong zhing / legs par bshad pa'i char gyis gdul bya'i phyogs kun tu khyab pas/ bde legs kyi 'dzin ma'i khyon kun tu bstan pa'i lo thog kun tu rgyas pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu phun tshogs bskrun par mdzad pa'i chu 'dzin dbang po/ mkhan slob yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyis gral gyi thog drangs/ dal 'byor gyi chu gter chen por/ tshul khrims dag pa'i gru bo che bcas te nges par 'byung ba'i rlung shugs kyis bskyod nas/ 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dbus nas legs bshad nor bu'i tshogs blangs te/ thar pa don gnyer gyi gdul bya la rnam grol gyi 'dod dgu stsol bar mdzad pa/ 'dul ba'i sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun/ rab yangs shes bya'i dri med nam mkhar/ ji snyed mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas shing / khyad par sna tshogs yang yang ston pa'i 'od stong phro bas/ mkhas gzhan rgyu skar zil gyis mnan te/ myang 'das bde ba'i gling bzhir mngon par phyogs pa/ mngon pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun/ zab rgyas mdo sde'i gsung rab/ rigs can kun gyi lam mchog ston byed/

brtson pas dus ring sbyangs pa'i thugs can/ drang nges rnam par 'byed pa'i blo dang ldan pas/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gsal byed mchog tu gyur pa'i mdo sde'i sde snod 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun/ mchog gi rgyal ba'i grong khyer chen por/ 'bad med myur bar 'jug pa'i them skas/ spang dka' ba'i dri ma myur 'khrud chu rgyun/ 'bad med bde chen bgrod pa'i theg pa/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ston pa'i gsang lam/ theg mchog bde blag gshegs pa'i brtson ldan/ rigs 'dzin sngags kyi dge 'dun te/ sde snod kyi phye ba'i dge 'dun rnam pa bzhi'am/ srid las nges par 'byung ba'i thugs can/ zhi bde'i lam nas gshegs pa'i 'gron po/ rang bde don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pas/ myang 'das 'brog dgon mthar son nyan thos kyi dge 'dun/ kun la phan par bzhed pa'i thugs kyis/ /srid par kun tu gnas pa'i brtse ldan/ /rgyal ba'i lam chen gshegs pa'i sems dpa'/ /thabs dman gyis gnon pa'i mkhyen ldan/ /sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa'i ded dpon/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun te/ /theg pa'i sgo nas phye ba'i dge 'dun sde gnyis sam/ thar pa'i lam nas gshegs pa'i bshes gnyen/ rigs can gsum gyi lam ston sgron ma/ /gsung rab sna tshogs bzhed don sgrub brtson/ /gdul bya sna tshogs 'dul ba'i tshul ldan/ /thun mong theg pa'i yon tan gyis mdzes pa theg pa thun mong gi dge 'dun/ phyi rol spros pa'i bya ba spangs te/ /gsang ba nang gi thabs la brtson pas/ /bde stong zung 'jug lam nas gshegs pa/ /mthar thug myur du bgrod pa'i skal ldan/ gdul bya dbang rnon mchog gi rigs can/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i dge 'dun te/ phyi nang gi sgo nas phye ba'i dge 'dun rnam gnyis kyis gral gyi bzhi legs par bzung bas/ bla sgo dang po dge 'dun sde gnyis gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par bzhugs pa lags/ de'i rjes nas mi dbang gsung gi gangs rir gnas shing /

dal 'byor rnam par dag pa'i ri dwags dbang po/ khrims gnyis legs par skyong ba'i ral pas brjid pa/ mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis mche sder rgyas shing / rang sde bde la 'god pa'i nga ro rgyas pas/ 'gran zla'i ri dwags zil gyis gnon pa'i/ mi dbang bka' dang bsod nams kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i nang blon rin chen rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i glang po/ rang sde chos bzhin skyong ba'i khur gyis brjid la/ mthu dang bsod nams kyi yan lag bdun mnyam par gnas pa'i ming che ba rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan pas/ bla sgo bar pa rjes bdag rgyal po'i zhal skyin rnams kyang phun sum tshogs par bzhugs pa lags/ de dag gi chab 'og nas/ skyes thob blo gros mchog gi gzugs mdzes pa 'bad pas ring du sbyangs pa'i rgyan ldan/ bsams bzhin 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rtsal mnga'/ ngo mtshar bsam yas sprul pa'i 'phrul can/ phun tshogs gnas su phyin pa'i bzhon pa/ sna tshogs bzo gnas sbyangs pa'i rig shes mkhas rnams dang / phan 'dod brtse ba'i thag gru yangs shing / des shing 'dzangs pa'i rlan gyis dul la/ yan lag brgyad la mkhas pa'i myu gus/ 'gro ba'i nad sel 'bras bu 'byin mdzad/ 'gro ba kun gyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur/ gso rigs gnas la dbang 'byor sman pa bla med rnams te/ phyi'i rig pa'i gnas zung la mkhas pa'i dpon yon tan mkhan rnams kyis gral gyi zur nas mdzes par brgyad/ dad gus gshin pa'i zhing las 'khrungs shing / bsams bzhin sgrub pa'i dpag bsam rkang 'thung / 'bags rtsog nyes pa'i tsha gdung skyob byed/ gtsang zhing dag pa'i yal 'dab rgyas la/ yid du 'ong ba'i 'bru'i bcud kyis/ gus bya'i mchod gnas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i bya ba byed pa rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten te/ rje'u rigs bkur ba'i gnas dang / bka' bzhin bya ba sgrub pas bla sgo tha ma blon po'i zhal skyin rnams kyang phun sum tshogs par bzhugs pa lags/

de ltar bzhugs pa rnams kyi nye ba dang / 'dus tshul gyi sgo nas 'brel tshogs kyi dbang du bgyis pa'i 'brel pa la/ las dang smon lam/ rten dang brten pa'i/ tshogs dang tshogs pa can/ chos dang dam tshig gi 'brel pa'i sgo nas snyan du gsol na/ 'di ltar bzhugs pa thams cad sku tshe snga mar rnam par dag pa'i dge ba dang / dri ma med pa'i smon lam rigs mthun phyogs gcig tu btab pa la brten nas sku tshe 'dir gnas mchog bstan pa rgyas pa'i sa khad nye bar/ dpon slob/ nye du/ 'grogs bshes/ gnas yul 'dra bar 'khrungs pas skyes thob kyi 'brel pa zab cing / rten sa gzhi'i phyogs gcig na brten pas rten dang brten pa'i 'brel ba/ tshogs pa gcig tu 'dus pa'i sgo nas tshogs pa dang tshogs pa can/ mchod bya mchod byed du gyur pa'i sgo nas yon dang mchod gnas/ chos bstan bya dang ston pa por gyur pa'i sgo nas chos kyi 'brel pa/ dam bca' dang bcas yul gcig pa'i sgo nas dam tshig gi 'brel pa zab par bzhugs pa'i nang nas/ skabs 'dir las dang smon lam gyis gzhi bzung / chos dang dam tshig gtso bor byas nas yon dang mchod gnas su gyur pas 'brel pa'i sgo nas mchog tu gyur par bzhugs pa lags/ tshogs lugs la/ ma dag 'khor ba/ dag pa rnam byang / bde sdug gi longs spyod/ chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba/ ngan 'gro dang bde 'gro'i 'gro bar tshogs tshul la sogs pa mang du mchis pa las/ tshogs pa rnams kyang yang rab/ gnas khyad par can dri med bstan pa'i 'byung gnas lha mi'i gtsug lag khang gi dbus su/ rmad byung bsod nams spel ba'i thabs mchog rgya chen chos 'khor bskor ba'i bya ba la tshogs pas tshogs lugs mchog tu gyur par gda' lags/ de ltar tshogs pa'i dbus su byas shes drin gzo bskyed pa'i slad du bka' drin che ba'i lor rgyus zur tsam bsnyad na/ gzhi skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus dang / rgyan dam pa chos 'byung gi lo rgyus dang gnyis su gleng bar gda' ba las/

gzhi skye bo mi chos kyi lo rgyus la/ snod bcud 'jig chags so/ rje'i gdung rabs/ 'bangs kyi mi rabs/ byas pa lag rigs kyi sgo nas gleng bar gda' la/ snod kyi 'jig rten la/ rten 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor chags tshul/ brten pa khams gsum pa'i chags tshul/ khams gsum la/ spyir stong gsum gyi 'jig rten chags tshul/ khyad par gling bzhi ri rab kyi chags tshul/ dgos 'dzam bu gling pa'i chags tshul/ bye brag yul chen po bcu drug gi chags tshul/ khyad par mnga' ris bod kyi chags tshul/ nang gses dbur g.yor gnyis kyi chags tshul/ yang bsgos g.yor po yul bzhi'i chags tshul/ nye ba dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshul gyi sgo nas gleng bar rigs par gda' zhing / rje'i gdung rabs la/ rgyal po la snga ba mang pos bkur ba'i gdung rabs/ rgya gar gyi chos rgyal so so'i byung tshul khyad par bod kyi rgyal rabs/ 'bangs kyi mi rabs la/ rgyal rabs so so'i zhang blon/ yul so so'i mi rabs/ yul gyis bcad la/ spyi sgos so so'i yul gyi dbye ba dang gyes mdo/ byas pa la ris la/ rang rang gi che ba'i lag rjes sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gleng bar gda' na'ang / yab tu dge zhing yum du btsun la/ yul la dge bcu tshang zhing gnyen 'grogs 'bangs rnams bskyangs nas dgra dang mi mthun phyogs btul ba/ 'di dang phyi ma'i dgos pa nye bar bsgrub pa la tshang zhing / skabs su ma bab pas rgyas par snyan du mi gsol/ rgyan dam pa chos 'byung gi lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis na/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul/ bstan pa dam chos kyi rnam gzhag 'dren pa bshes gnyen gyi che ba la sogs pa mang zhig nas gleng bar gda' na'ang / bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis na/ spyir khams gsum pa'i sems can la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bka' drin che zhing / bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang lnga'am/ sangs rgyas stong dang sems dpa' gnyis/

mi mjed kyi 'jig rten pa la/ ston pa shākya'i rgyal po/ bka' 'khor lo rnam pa gsum la/ thub pa'i rgyal tshab 'od srung chen pos gtso mdzad pa'i dgra bcom pa chen po rnams kyis/ bsdu ba rim pa gsum du mdzad de/ bka' la sgro skur gyi dri ma dang bral bar mdzad pas bka' drin che zhing / de las kyang 'dul ba'i sde snod la nye bar 'khor/ mdo sde'i sde snod la kun dga' bo/ mngon pa'i sde snod la 'od srung chen po/ theg chen gyi sde snod rnams la rgyal tshab chen po byams pa dang / spyan ras gzigs dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams dang / mdo rgyud du mar lung bstan pa'i rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub rnams bka' drin che/ bsdus pa'i rjes su bka'i dgongs pa 'grel pa las/ bka' spyi'i dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa la/ thub pas rang bzhin med pa'i lta ba ji bzhin gzigs par lung bstan zhing / mtha' bral dbu ma'i de kho na nyid gtan la 'bebs pa klu sgrub yab sras/ sems tsam gyi lta ba gtso bor ston zhing / mdo sde sna tshogs 'grel par lung bstan thob pa/ mngon pa'i sde snod gtan la 'bebs pa thogs med sku mched rgol ba ngan pa bzlog par lung bstan zhing / gtan tshigs rigs pa'i de nyid gsal bar byed pa phyogs glang chos grags/ ston pa'i bslab pa gces spras su 'dzin pa'i mchog 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i de nyid gsal bar mdzad pa 'od ldan rnams gnyis te/ 'jig rten gyi rgyan drug gam mchog brgyad du grags pa de rnams bka' drin che/ khyad par rgyud sde du ma'i dgongs pa gsal bar mdzad pa la/ sems dpa' chen po gsum dang grub chen brgyad/ shākya bshes gnyen dang kun dga' snying po la sogs pa rnams dang / mkhas grub de rnams kyi rjes 'brang paṇḍ-i ta chen po chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams bka' drin che/ mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams pa la/

thog mtha' bar gsum du chos kyi sgron me gsal bar mdzad pas/ rgyal mes dbon pa rnam pa gsum dang / de rnams kyi bla'i mchod gnas rgya gar gyi mkhas pa li byin/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ sngags 'chang padma 'byung gnas/ slob dpon chen po ka ma la shī la/ shī lend+ra bo dhi la sogs pa'i paṇḍi ta mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams dang / 'thon mi sam bho ṭa/ sad mi mi bdun/ ka lcog zhang gsum la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyis dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char phyogs kun tu phab ste/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du khyab cing / rje 'bangs kun grol mchog gi lam du 'khrid par mdzad pas bka' drin che/ khyad par bstan pa'i mjug 'dir/ thog mar bka' drin che ba bstan pa'i me ro ches cher rgyas mdzad bla chen mkhan brgyud rnams dang / gzhan yang 'phags mas lung bstan thob pa'i skyes mchog bstan pa nyin mor mdzad pa'i sgron ma/ jo bo chen po dang / lo chen yab sras/ bar du bka' drin che ba rgya chen mkhyen pa mnga' ba'i spyan ldan/ rnam dag bstan pa spel ba'i phrin las can/ rngog lo tsā ba khu dbon dang / tha mar bka' drin che ba/ shes bya gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen/ mtha' yas pas gdul bya 'dul ba'i phrin las can chos rje khu dbon te/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dam pa de rnams rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bka' drin che ba lags shing / khyad par bshad dka' dang / sgrub rgyud so so rang rang la brgyud pa rim par byon pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa/ bstan pa'i gsal byed/ chos kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa rnams bka' drin che/ sgos so so rang rang la dal 'byor nye bar bskrun pa'i pham/ thar pa'i grong du 'jug pa'i mkhan slob/ zab mo'i de nyid ston mdzad bla ma rnams bka' drin che/ de ltar brtse ba'i thugs kyis rgya chen bsod nams spel ba'i slad du mchod cing bkur ba'i yul du byon pa rnams sbyin pa'i bdag po la bka' drin che ba lags/

dgos ched rtogs pa'i ched du skabs kyi don nye bar mtshon pa'i dbang du bgyis na/ chos kyi rje'i zhal snga nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams la phu dud du bya ba dang / dad pa can gyis phul ba'i phyag rdzas kyi dngos po don yod par bya ba'i ched du/ mdang sang gi skabs rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rgya nag gi rtsis pa'i rtsis las byung ba'i lo gsar ba shar ma thag pa/ zla ba shar ba/ nyi ma byang du bgrod cing / drag gza' dang sa bdag gi nyes pa dang bral la/ phur bu dang / pa sangs nyi ma la ma nub pa'i dus khyad par can la bab pa'i skabs 'dir/ dbus phyogs kyi sa'i cha la bzhugs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan zad mi shes pa la dbang 'byor pas/ bstan pa'i gsal byed dam par gyur cing / 'gro ba rnams kyi 'dren pa bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi bsod nams sogs pa'i zhing mchog bla ma rin po che pa zhal rnam pa dang / mkhan slob yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa phal mo che/ g.yor po yul bzhi'i sa yi mthil/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por spyan drangs nas/ nyin zhag bcu'i bar du chos dang mthun pa'i zhal zas cha phra mo dang / sman gyi btung bas nye bar mchod nas/ bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po rjes su bsgrubs pa'i thad/ gdugs di ring skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa'i bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la dro'i bsnyen cing bkur ba ja dang bcas pas nye bar mchod nas/ yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la 'bul ba rnam gzhag cha phra mo spyan lam la bab tsam dang / gzhan yang gang la gang 'os kyi 'bul ba cha phra mo dang bcas pa phyag tu phul nas/ dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu gser zho re non pa'i gral 'gyed kyi dngos po dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa 'di nyid/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par bya ba dang /

gong ma yon tan mchod chen pos gtso mdzad bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad sku khams bzang zhing phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par bgyi ba dang / rgyal khams chen po phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la/ khyad par mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams kun tu dam pa'i chos rgyas shing mi nyams la dge legs su bya ba dang / rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang mi gnyis pa'i mkhyen brtse dang / phrin las can rnams kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs la/ khyad par bla ma bdag nyid chen po pa dang / bla ma chen po kun dga' blo gros pas gtso mdzad pa'i bla ma sku mched rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin bsab pa dang / dri che ba ma'i rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / ma 'ongs pa na rjes su bsgrub dgos pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa yang sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul gyis rjes su bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir dang / na ning gi skabs su gdan sa chen pos gtso mdzad gtsang phyogs kyi chos sde rnams na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la/ chos dang mthun pa'i zhal zas kyis bsnyen cing bkur ba zhag lnga'i bar du bsgrubs nas/ yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la 'bul ba cung zad dang / dge 'dun khri phrag bzhi la so so'i phyag tu gser zho re'i gral 'gyed dang skye bo'i tshogs khri phrag gsum la'ang bsnyen cing bkur ba nas khal re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa'i sku skal la dmigs pa'am/ mkhan po mkhas mchog zhi ba'i lhas/ bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te/ /skye bo kun la btang sems kyis/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin gsungs te/ /zhes pa'i tshul dang mthun par/ lag tu bzung ba'i dngos po sku gsung thugs kyis thog drangs/ zhwa lham gyis mtha' brten pa yan chad kyi bdog pa'i dngos po ci mchis pa thams cad lhag ma ma lus par gtong ba'i bya ba spong dag la dmigs nas/

drung nas zhal ta ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ dge slong pa rnam pas phyag len la thebs par bgyis nas bsgrubs par gda' lags/ slad ma bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa skye dgu kun gyi phan bde'i sgron ma yun du gnas shing phyogs bcur rgyas la bstan pa dam pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rnams kyang yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing / skye dgu'i tshogs chen po'ang bde skyid kyi dpal la rgyun mi 'chad par longs spyod pa'i sgo nas dge zhing bkra shis pa'i bya ba 'di lta bu la yang yang 'du 'tshog bgyid par smon zhing / smon pa 'grub par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rnams kyis gtor ma'i byin rlabs/ theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa bka' gnang bar 'tshal zhing / 'bul ba rnam gzhag cha phra mo bsgrubs pa yi ge'i ngos nas brda sprod pa la'ang gsan par zhu// bsam yas su chos 'khor mdzad pa'i mos pa mdzad pa'o// //bkra shis/ ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zag mchog la brten nas dge ba bsgrubs nas de mi zad cing spel ba'i phyir/ byang chub tu bsngo ba'i tshul ni tshogs 'khor dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod la sogs pa dang 'brel ba yin nas sbyin bdag zur pa yod na/ khyed kyi bla ma'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i don du thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs la brten nas dge ba khyad par can bsgrubs pa de byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi bas mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i gtso bo dang / bla ma'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang tha mi dad pa brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'am/ mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong gi srung ma thams cad kyang bsngo ba'i dpang por bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon nas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i dge rtsa thams cad bla ma dam pa'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sems can thams cad kyi don du dbul snyam pa dang /

chos thams cad snang yang bden pas stong pa thabs shes dbyer med du shes pas rjes zlos byed cing / rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang mthun 'gyur gsung bar zhu byas la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag gis bsgrubs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang / gzhan yang dus gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa thams cad bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /phul bas thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du rdzogs par gyur cig ces pa'am/ dbul bar bgyi'o/ /stong pa nyid dang mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen por bzhes su gsol/ zhes lan gsum dang / bla ma dam pa gang na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyang gzhal med khang gi rang bzhin du gyur cig sems can thams cad kyang lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du gyur nas zag pa med pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba la longs spyod par gyur cig bdag kyang skye ba thams cad du bla ma dam pas rjes su 'dzin zhing / stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po dbyer med pa'i lam la gnas par gyur cig rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang du gyur cig der ma phyin gyi bar du yang bla ma dam pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /dus gzhan du phal cher 'dra ba las khyad par ba'i tshig kun bzhag nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems thams cad dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa lta bu dang / dbul bar bgyi'o'i rjes la/ thugs brtse bar dgongs te bzhes su gsol zhes pa dang / bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i ded dpon chen po mdzad du gsol zhes pa lta bu gang 'dod dang / gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang na bzhugs pa'i zhing /

rdo ba dang tsher ma gcong rong la sogs pa'i nyes par ma gyur cig baiḍūrya dang gser la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du gnas par gyur cig sems can 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug las grol bar gyur nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud kun tu brlan par gyur cig bdag kyang skye ba thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par gyur cig nam du'ang mi mnyes pa byed par ma gyur cig dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' dang mi 'bral zhing / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bslab pa la slob par gyur cig byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni/ /zhes sogs sbyar/ yang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i don du/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / zhes sogs sbyar na'ang rung bas/ de rnams skabs su 'phrod pa'i rjes la/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos las byung ba'i tshigs bcad kyi bsngo ba smon lam bsnan la rgyas par bya'o// // ༄༅/ /skabs 'dir/ skabs don brda sbyor ba'i lo rgyus tshig 'ga' gleng bar zhu 'tshal/ zhu skabs na/ tshogs gnyis dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i ston pa sangs rgyas/ sgrib gnyis mun pa sel ba'i bstan pa dam chos/ bden gnyis mngar rtsis 'byor pa'i tshogs mchod pad ma/ skyabs bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi mgon skyabs dam par bzhugs pa lags/ de dag gi rnam 'phrul mtshon pa'i rten gsum yang / dgos 'dod sgrub byed dpag bsam sdong po/ gus pas brten na 'khor ba'i gdung skyob/ bkod mdzes mchod sprin yul 'dab rgyas pa de spyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rab 'byams na bsam gyis mi khyab/ khyad par du'ang / mkhas mchog klu dbang brten pa'i bsti gnas/ dpal 'byor chu bo 'du ba'i rgya mtsho/ chos grwa chen po 'di nyid na'ang cha tshang la 'o mi brgyal bar bzhugs pa lags/

dkon mchog de dag dang mdzad pa'i phrin las tha dad mi mnga' bar gyur pa/ thub bstan gangs ri skyong ba'i seng chen/ bslab gsum ral pas brjid pa'i gdong lnga/ phyi rgol wa skyes 'dzoms pa'i stobs ldan/ drung nas dge 'dun 'dus pa'i dbus na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa gza' skar gyis bskor ba ltar sku gnyan par bzhugs pa lags/ bka' 'khor na dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyang / drag po'i mthu rtsal gyis bdud sde'i spa bkong / mkhyen brtse'i nus pas bstan pa'i tshogs srung / bstan 'dzin gang zag bu bzhin du skyong ba de bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gang na gnas pa na srung zhing skyob par mdzad pa rten 'brel gyi che ba lags/ drung gi phrin las rnam par dkar ba la brten nas 'dus shing tshogs pa'i dge 'dun/ mang thos nor bus mdzes pa'i klu dbang / bslab gsum rgyan gyis spras pa'i lto 'gro slob dpon pas dbu mdzad sde snod 'dzin pa mdo sde'i spyod pa'i dge 'dun gdan mang zhal rags su bzhugs shing / sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun yang / dbang bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'khrungs pa'i pad tshal/ rim gnyis 'dab ma rgyas pa'i sdong po/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i mngar rtsis skal ldan gdul bya'i bung ba sdud pa'i slob dpon sngags pa rnams sku mnyen par bzhugs pa lags/ de ltar na bla sgo dang po zur pa tsam/ bla sgo bar pa sa bdag rgyal po chen po'i rigs rgyud/ 'od gsal lha las chad pa'i gdung rnams so/ /bla sgo tha chung thabs kyi zhang blon/ rje pa'am zhang pa rnams dang bcas te bkur bar 'os pa'i dbus sde rnam pa gnyis sam/ bla sgo rim pa gsum gdan 'dzom pas gral gyi bzhi bzung / bsod nams kyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho zhing / khrims gnyis kyi bya ba chos bzhin du skyong ba'i dpon chen pas gung mnan/ rig pa'i gnas lnga sbyangs pa'i mkhas chen/ bzo gnas bco brgyad shes pa'i shes ldan/
