yon tan mkhan po rnams kyis zur brgyan/ dad sogs nor gyis phyug pa'i 'byor ldan/ dpa' mdzangs gos kyis brgyan pa'i ya rabs/ zhabs tog sgrub pa rnams kyis mtha' brten nas/ tshogs pa phun sum tshogs par bzhugs shing / 'di ltar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang spyi 'brel rgya che rnam dag las dang smon lam/ sgos 'brel zab mo rnam dag chos dang dam tshig gis 'brel pa zab/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i bka' sar/ dkar po dge ba'i las la tshogs pas ni tshogs lugs bzang / tshogs pa la brten pa lo rgyus 'byung ba lags na'ang / mi chos bzhi'i lo rgyus de rab tu byung ba rnams kyi spang byar gda' bas mi gsol/ lha chos rgyan gyi lo rgyus la'ang / ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul/ bstan pa dam chos kyi dar tshul/ bstan 'dzin sde pa'i gyes mdo la sogs pa gleng sgo mang na'ang / mkhas mchog nyi ma'i drung na/ blun po me khyer gyi 'od mi gsal bas zhib rgyas mi zhu zhing / don med rnam g.yeng gi phyag dar khrod nas/ gang zin long gtam sa rdul blangs te/ mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dbus su dor bas ni tshul dang mi mthun/ snyan dngags rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas/ sdeb legs me tog gi chun po blangs te/ mkhas tshogs thugs 'dzin pa'i lo rgyus ni bdag gis mi spobs/ 'on kyang gleng bar 'os shing gleng na/ byas shes drin gzo skye ba bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus zur tsam gleng bar zhu 'tshal/ de la'ang spyir khams gsum gyi sems can dug gsum gyi nad kyis gzir ba rnams la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bslab gsum gyi sman gyis gso bar mdzad pa rnams bka' drin che zhing / sgos bskal bzang gi sems can ma rig pa'i mun khrod du zhugs pa rnams la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sgron ma stong / bye brag mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon par 'khyams pa rnams la yang dag pa'i lam phyin ci ma log par ston par mdzad pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bka' drin che/

ston pa de'i gdul bya rnams la bka' bsdud par mdzad pa dgra bcom pa chos kyi spyan ldan rnams sam/ bka'i dgongs 'grel mkhan po paṇa grub rim par byon pa rnams bka' drin che ba lags/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams la thogs med sku mched kyis chos mngon nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis shes bya'i pad ma kha 'byed/ phyogs glang chos grags kyis yang dag rigs pa'i mtshon chas rgol ba ngan pa'i g.yul bzlog klu sgrub yab sras kyis zab lam dbu ma'i rdo rjes mthar 'dzin gyi brag ri brnyil/ bram ze rnam gnyis kyis 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i gling nas blang dor gyi nor bu blangs pas na bka' drin che/ bod gangs can gyi khrod pa rnams la/ dang por lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sku ring la dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la dam pa chos kyi srol btod/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas bka' drin che/ bar du a mes bla chen po mkhan brgyud dang bcas pas bstan pa'i nyams pa gsos pas bka' drin che/ mthar rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dang / chos brgyud bzang rim par byon pa rnams lhag par yang bka' drin che ba lags/ so so rang rang la bla ma dang pha ma'i bar du bka' drin che/ mchod yul du byon pa rnams sbyin bdag la bka' drin che ba lags/ skabs don skabs dang sbyar/ de dag gi 'khor du nongs pa mchis na bzod pa mdzad par zhu zhing / drung nas bka' bsgo ba mdzad nas gtor ma'i byin rlabs mdo bsngo ba dang bcas pa bka' gnang bar zhu 'tshal/ phyin chad kyi dbang du bgyis par thal na'ang / gong ma rnams sku khams bzang po'i skyabs 'og nas chos ldan gyi bya ba 'di lta bu la 'tshog pa'i smon lam gnang bar zhu// //shes bya kun la gang zhig mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs shing / /lus pa med pa'i 'gro la gcig tu brtse ba can/

/thub pa'i dbang po bdag gi gtsug tu legs bsten gyi/ /'bral ba med par 'gro bas bdud rtsi thob gyur cig /gang du gsan pa'i chu yis khyed thugs legs gtams shing / /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i bsam 'byor 'jam pa'i gzhon nu bzhin/ /rtogs pa'i dpal thob khyu mchog nang du seng ge ltar/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gang de yun du zhabs brtan shog /lhun po'i gtsug na khyed sku'i dkyil 'khor las/ /phan bde'i 'od mang dman pa'i pad tshal du/ /ltos med rtsol ba'i dri ma sgrib bral zhes/ /snyan pa'i dri bzang sbrang rtsir bcas gyur to/ /de mtshon lha rdzas mdog mang zhing / /rin chen bkod legs khang bzang tshogs/ /snyan tshig mu tig dra bas spras/ /mig lam yid kyi dga' ston gyur/ /bdag kyang drang srong chen po'i gling zhugs te/ /blo gsal ngur tshogs mkhas mang bzhad rnams dang / /lhan cig bstan la brtse ba'i skad 'byin zhing / /blo gros 'dab rgyas 'dab ma gos par mchis/ /zab cing rgya che rdo rje'i mdzod bzhag ste/ /mtha' drug rgyas btab rgyud kyi dgongs don nor/ /bla ma'i man ngag lde mig mi ldan zhing / /mngon shes mig bral rnams kyis rnyed dka' mod/ /'jam dbyangs rjes bzung rje btsun bla ma dang / /'grel bshad bstan bcos mthong thos mi dman phyir/ /nyes chen med mod byis pa'i blo yi skyon/ /mchis na'ang mkhas pa'i spyan mdzes don yod 'gyur/ /da dung legs par dpyad nas spel 'os zhes/ /bka' stsal mod kyang mkha' lding mkhar bgrod bzhin/ /'dab chags gzhan yang 'gro zhes mkhas pa'i srol/ /bslab gsum brtson pas 'byed la ngal med de/ /khyed kyang phan bde yid bzhin nor bu'i gter/ /thub bstan bstan 'dzin klu dbang la las phyir/ /lhan cig zhabs brten char sdod 'gro ba la'ang / /dam pa'i chos char yun du dbab par gsol/ /rnam g.yeng rnyed bkur brgya phrag ldan na yang / /'ching ba med bzhin gzhan phan gtsor gzigs pas/

/gnas sam nye bar 'khor kyang don gnyis la/ /g.yel ba med phyir kho bo'i don grub gyur/ /rnam mang sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i nyes pa la/ /dka' blo btang nas zol med brtul zhugs bzung / /khengs bral ldom bu'i spyod pas gnas 'dod phyir/ /zab mo'i gdams pas 'di na bsrung ba mdzod/ /ma brjod dgongs dang ma gzigs ma mchis mod/ /gzigs pa sgrib med yi ge'i rten tsam du/ /sdig med phra tshogs snal ma'i rgyu las byung / /chos dang dras drub mdzes pa cha cig 'bul/ /rnam gnon lo yi thub zla 'jig rten tshes/ /gang la babs tshe mkhas pa'i bsti gnas mchog /sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas phul ba ste/ /da dung 'bel pa'i bka' 'chid phreng du spro// //bla ma gzhon nu seng ge la'o// /shubhaṃ// ༄༅/ /lung chos kyi bshad gsar gyi mos pa yin/ tshad ma'i gcig yod pa rtsad bcad nas bri'o// skabs 'dir 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus nas cung zad cig snyan gsan par zhu 'tshal/ zhu skabs na/ theg pa kun tu 'jug pa'i rigs can rgya mtshor/ sbyor bzhi khyab 'jug stobs kyis bsrubs pas/ legs skyes mkhyen gsum nor bu'i dpal gyis/ rab mdzes rgyal yum lha yi dbang phyug rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / spangs rtogs phrin las phun tshogs mtshon byed/ dri med sku gsum 'byor pa rab rgyas/ skyabs gnas mthar thug sangs rgyas dkon mchog gang zhig chags pa bral ba 'gog pa'i bden pa/ gang gis chags pa bral byed lam bden nyid de/ bden gnyis zung 'jug dam chos rin chen/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal rtogs pa ji lta mkhyen pa/ chos dbyings 'gro la khyab par rtogs pa ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i/ mkhyen pa gnyis ldan phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs kyi mchog ste/ theg pa chen po'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi rgyan dam par bzhugs pa lags/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi nye bar mtshon byed/

dkon mchog gi rten rgyal ba'i zhing rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam par bzhugs pa bsam gyis mi khyab la/ khyad par gtsug lag khang ngam/ chos sde'am/ bla brang ngam/ gzims khang ngam/ sde chen po 'di nyid na'ang / bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dbang gi rgyal po la/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ skye dgu chos bzhin skyong zhing bstan pa nye bar skyong ba'i chos skyong srung ma'i gzi 'od kyi dpal dang bcas te gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags par bzhugs pa lags/ dkon mchog gsum gyi phrin las rgya mtsho'i dpal las nye bar bskrun pa/ dri med thugs kyi chu skyes gnas lnga rig pa'i 'dab stong rgyas shing / legs bshad ze'u 'bru'i phreng ba lung rigs nyi ma'i 'od kyis gsal bar mdzad pas/ blo gsal bung ba'i yid rab 'phrog cing / 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog tu gyur pa/ bla ma'am mkhan po'am/ slob dpon pa'i drung nas gdan gyi thog ma la bzhugs pa lags/ de'i chab 'og nas bslab gsum gangs ri'i spoo la gnas bcas shing / phyi nang mkhyen pa'i dpal rtsal rgyas la/ brda sprod rig pa'i mche sder rnon pos/ phas rgol glang po'i glad pa 'gems pa'i/ bshes gnyen ri dwags rgyal po'i tshogs kyis gral gyi thog drangs/ sdom gsum dag pa'i dkyil 'khor mdo dang rgyud sde'i 'od dkar dra bas mdzes shing / dge legs bsil ba'i zer gyis bsod nams kun da'i tshal rab gsal bar mdzad pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun mdo sngags kyi cha 'dzin bdud rtsi'i cha shas can rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung / mthu stobs kyi snang byed bsod nams kyi shing rtas drangs te/ chab 'og gling bzhir khrims gnyis kyi nyi 'od kyis khyab par mdzad pa/ che ge mos gtso mdzad pa'am/ mi chen po nyi ma'i bdag po rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan/

phra zhing gsal ba dang byams pa dang brtse ba'i blo'i rgyal mtshan bzo dang gso ba la mkhas pa'i yid bzhin nor bus brgyan te/ gdul bya la dga' ba dang bde ba'i dpal ster ba'i yon tan mkhan po rnams kyis gral gyi zur nas mdzes par brgyan/ lhag bsam dag pa'i chu gtsang sbyor ba phun tshogs kyi pad mas brgyan te/ zhal zas 'o ma'i ro brgya ldan pas mchod yul ngur pa'i tshogs rnams dgyes pa bskyed pa'i bya ba byed pa'am/ sbyin bdag zur pa yod na/ sbyin pa'i bdag po dang bcas pas gral gyi mtha' brten nas lhun po gser ris bskor ba ltar mdzes shing phun sum tshogs par bzhugs pa lags/ tshogs pa la brten nas 'brel par 'byung ba las/ 'brel pa'i dbang du bgyis na/ spyi 'brel khyab che ba las dang smon lam/ sgos 'brel chos dam tshig gis sbrel ba'i 'brel pa gnyis las/ 'dir bzhugs thams cad dkar po dge ba'i sa bon gyis bskyed/ smon lam dri ma med pa'i rlan gyis brlan te/ bsod nams spel ba'i bya ba la tshogs pa gcig pas 'brel pa shin tu zab/ 'brel pa las kyang tshogs pa 'byung bas tshogs lcags kyi dbang du bgyis na/ ma dag pa 'khor ba'i sems can/ rigs mthun las 'bras kyi longs spyod la 'dus shing tshogs/ myang 'das 'phags pa'i gang zag rnam grol bde ba'i longs spyod la 'dus shing tshogs pa las/ 'dir rnam grol bde ba'i longs spyod zag med dga' bde'i dpal bskyed pa'i thabs la tshogs pas tshogs pa yang shin tu bzang / tshogs pa las lo rgyus gleng bas/ lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis na/ mi chos kyi lo rgyus/ 'khor dang longs spyod mthu dang chab srid 'dzom pa gcig la 'du bar gda' na/ rgyas par mi zhu/ rgyan dam pa lha chos kyi lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis na/ spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can srid gsum las kyi 'ching bas bcings pa rnams la gsum gsal bar bstan pas/ theg gsum myang 'das la 'god par mdzad pa'i/

dus gsum sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams bka' drin che/ khyad par bskal bzang 'di la sangs rgyas stong ngam stong dang lnga/ dug gsum las mi mjed pa'i 'jig rten 'di la shākya'i rgyal po/ sgos 'dzam bu gling pa la bka' drin che ba bka' bsdu ba po rnams sam/ bka'i dgongs pa 'grel pa rgyan drug gam mchog brgyad la sogs pa bka' drin che/ mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams la/ dang por bka' drin che ba rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum/ de'i mchod gnas lo paṇa skyes mchog dam pa rnams dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su dang por bka' drin che ba/ jo bo yab sras dang / lo chen rin chen bzang po dpon slob rnams sam/ bla chen mkhan rgyud dang bcas pa rnams bka' drin che/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i srog legs par bskyangs pas bka' drin che ba lags/ khyad par chos rgyud 'di pa la dang por/ thub pa'i dbang phyug gis gdul bya'i blo dang mthun par yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa la sogs gsal bar mdzad/ de'i 'og tu rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rje btsun byams pas/ yum don mngon rtogs brgyad du rnam par phye zhing / de rjes thogs med sku mched 'phags pa grol ba'i sde/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po rnams kyis don phyin ci ma log par gsal bar mdzad pas de rnams bka' drin che/ kha ba can gyi khrod 'dir/ dang por mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dpon slob/ ka cog zhang gsum la sogs dang / bar du jo bo yab sras/ lo chen rin chen bzang po la sogs/ mthar rngog yab sras/ bka' rgyud dang bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par bdag blo pad ma'i tshal du legs bshad tsha zer yang yang spros pas/ tshig don ge sar gsal bar mdzad pas/ mkhan po'am/ bla ma'am/ slob dpon la sogs bka' drin che ba lags/ dgos pa skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ bdag cag gi phyogs nas skye ba snga mar bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba bsags pa'i mthu las/

tshe 'dir dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i sgor rab tu byung nas/ yid dal du ma bsdad par/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i snying po/ rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i yum don/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa la thos bsam lo sbrel bgyis shing / de dag gi tshig gi don gyi cha blo la cung zad lon pa rnams da lo dbyar ram dgun chos kyi thad du 'chad par zhu ba'i sngon du/ gdugs de ring gi skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa'i bla ma yod na bla mas dbu mdzad/ med na yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la'ang tsha ba'am/ dro'am/ mang ja'i bsnyen bkur bas nye bar mchod nas/ yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la'ang 'bul ba me tog gi dngos po spyan lam du bab pa dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ mched po gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir ram/ bla ma slob dpon gyi bka' drin bsab pa'am/ dam pa chos kyi che ba dbyung ba'am/ rang nyid kyi yang gnas skabs kyi 'bad pa don yod par bya ba'i phyir ram/ bdag cag chos 'chad pa'i rnam gzhag la dmigs nas/ bsam sbyor dad gus dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa lags/ slad ma phyis 'byung gi dbang du bgyis na/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing sems can la bde skyid dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i thad nas/ dge zhing bkra shis pa'i bya ba 'di lta bu la 'tshog par smon zhing / bla ma'am/ mkhan po'am/ slob dpon pa'i drung nas/ bka' bsgo ba mdzad nas zhes sam/ de dag smos dgos pa med na/ dge 'dun rnams kyis gtor ma'i byin rlabs/ theg pa chen po'i mdo/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo ba dang bcas pa thugs la 'dogs pa dang / 'bul ba'i yi ge la'ang gsan par zhu lags// // ༄/ /skabs 'dir skabs don brda sprod pa'i tshig 'ga' snyan du 'bul bar zhu 'tshal/ zhu skabs na/

phun tshogs 'od stong rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ gsung rab char rgyun 'bebs pa'i klu dbang / sgrib gnyis tshang tshing bsreg pa'i sgron ma/ bslab gsum nor gyis gang ba'i bang mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / skyabs mchog dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum/ lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug na kun gyi cod pan ltar mchod gnas dam par bzhugs pa lags/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog rigs can dge legs spel ba'i zhing rab/ ngo mtshar bung ba 'du ba'i pad tshal/ byin rlabs bsil zer phro ba'i zla ba/ spyir rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams rgya mtsho bgrang las 'das la/ khyad par 'bru bcud rnam dag rgyas pa'i sa gzhi/ dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'du ba'i ri ljongs/ skyes mchog rim par byon pa'i bsti gnas/ gnas gzhi khyad par can 'di nyid na'ang / bla ma dam pa rin po che'i sku tshab dge legs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bas thog drangs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams kyi drung na/ lha rdzas mchod sprin lta bu'i mchod rdzas rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis spras te/ mthu stobs kyi dpal gyis brtan pa bsrung zhing / bstan 'dzin gyi phyi bzhin phrin las bsgrub pa'i dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa ches khyad par du 'phags par bzhugs pa lags/ de dag gi phrin las nor bu'i dpal las grub cing / legs bshad kyi 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro bas/ gdul bya'i ma rig pa sel la/ rnam dag thar lam gsal ba'i nyin byed/ bla ma dam pa'i drung nas gdan gyi thog ma la bzhugs pa lags/ de nyid kyi rjes su mthun par gsung rab nam mkha'i lam nas rgyu zhing / bslab gsum dag pa'i 'od dkar phreng ldan/ nyes gsum tsha gdung 'phrog pa'i bsil byed dbang po/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ches mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyis thog drangs/ bsod nams sbrang rtsi'i dog pa spel zhing /

tshul khrims dag pa'i 'dab stong rgyas la/ lung rtogs bung ba'i tshogs rab bsdud mdzad mdo sngags 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun chu skyes dbang po rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung / lhag dad gangs ri dag pa'i khrod na/ mthu rtsal mchog gi stobs kyis rtsen zhing / thabs shes rab kyi mche sder rnon pos phas rgol glang po'i glad pa 'gems byed mi che drag rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan/ bzo rigs sogs gnas dpal gyis phyug pa/ gdul bya dga' ba'i dga' ston 'gyed pa'i dpon yon tan mkhan po rnams kyis gral gyi zur nas mdzes par brgyan/ khrel ldan gyi gos can gtong ba'i nor ldan/ rang sde'i dpal can yon bdag pa rnams kyis gral gyi khor yug mdzes par byas/ sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas/ zhabs thog tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i phyag bde ba rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten nas/ 'di ltar tshogs pa phun sum tshogs par bzhugs pa lags/ 'di ltar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang / spyi 'brel las dag pa'i sa gzhir dri med smon lam gyi ku mud rgyas pa/ yon dang mchod gnas kyi phreng bar spel bas 'brel ba zab cing / khyad par bla ma dam pa rim par byon pa rnams sbyin bdag pas so so rang rang gi sde rnams su spyan drangs/ bla'i mchod gnas dam par bkur zhing / yon mchod rnams chos dam tshig gi 'brel zab mos sbrel bas 'brel zab par bzhugs pa lags/ tshogs lugs la mang zhig mchis na'ang / skabs su bab pa bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa la brten nas/ yon mchod 'brel mchis rnams dang / 'dir 'tshogs kun yul dus kun tu/ bkra shis shing chos 'phel ba'i bya ba dang / rab tu gnas pa'i zhal sro dang / dam pa'i chos 'chad pa'i dga' ston la tshogs pas na tshogs pa shin tu bzang / bka' drin che ba'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du bgyis na/ 'khor bar gnas pa'i skye 'gro yongs rnams la/ rnam dag thar pa'i grong du bsdud mdzad dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kun la bka' drin che/

khyad par bskal pa bzang po la sangs rgyas stong / mi mjed 'jig rten khams pa la shākya'i rgyal po/ yang sgos 'dzam bu gling pa la bka' sdud pa po rnams dang / rgyan drug mchog brgyad bka' drin che ba lags/ bod khams yongs la bka' drin che ba'i dbang du bgyis na/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su rgyal mes dbon rnam pa gsum dang / de dag gi bla'i mchod gnas lo paṇa skyes mchog rnams kyis bka' ba cher mdzad bod mun pa'i smag rum/ dam pa'i chos kyi nyi mas snang bar mdzad nas/ dge ba bcu'i lam la bkod pas bka' drin che/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / de nyid kyi bka' yis spyan drangs par/ jo bo chen po rje lha cig lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po la sogs pas stod nas bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing / lo tshong / 'bring gsum gyis mdo smad nas bslab pa mnos/ bstan pa'i dar rgyas rim pa bzhin du spel bas bka' drin che ba lags/ chos brgyud 'di pa la drug pa rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste rim par byon pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams bka' drin che/ sgos so so lus bskyed pa'i pha ma/ thar lam ston pa'i slob dpon/ dge legs bskrun pa'i grogs mched/ mchod yul du byon pa rnams sbyin pa'i bdag po la bka' drin che/ skabs don shes par bya ba'o/ /zhes pa se lung sgang du lha'i rab gnas dang / dbon po rdo rje dpal bzang gis brtag gnyis bshad gsar dus dwags por chos rjes mdzad pa'o// // ༄༅/ /khyed kyis dus las 'das pa'i don du/ dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ skye bo'i sbyin gtong rgya che ba bsgrubs nas/ de'i dge ba rnam mkhyen du bsngo ba'i cho ga don du gnyer ba shin tu legs shing / brgyad stong par/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs mkhas pas yongs su bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa 'di ni bsngo ba chen po lags so zhes gsungs te/

de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab yin la/ thabs mkhas pa ni sems can gyis sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du bsngo ba'i 'dun pa yin zhing / de gnyis kyi dge ba bsngo ba na rgyal ba rgyal sras dge 'dun rnams kyi spyan sngar bsngos pas dpang po dang mthun gyur gyi byed pas smon lam 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod pas 'di bzhin mos pa gyis/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhugs par bsgom/ de dag dang da ltar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi spyan sngar dus las 'das pa rang gis bsags pa dang da ltar dus las 'das pa'i don du khyed rnams kyis sbyin gtong byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la brten nas dus las 'das pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyis mthar thug sangs rgyas thob/ gnas skabs dal 'byor thob nas lam sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi/ mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par bsngo/ de'ang bsngo bya'i dge rtsa/ ched du bya ba rnam mkhyen/ der dge ba bsngo ba dang bcas pa'i cho ga don dam pa spros bral/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam pa gyis la lad mo mdzod cig dge 'dun rnams kyis mthun 'gyur gsung bar zhu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dus las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bya ba la dgongs su gsol/ dus las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bya bas dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams dang / 'brel pa shul na mchis pas khong gi don du byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa de dag thams cad dus las 'das pa ming 'di zhes bya ba'i rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su 'jug par gyur cig rjes su zhugs nas rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig myur du sangs rgya bar gyur cig ces lan gsum byas la de'i rjes su/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du skye ba kun tu dal 'byor rnam par dag pa'i mi lus thob par gyur cig

yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig thabs snying rje chen po dang shes rab zung du 'brel bar gyur cig pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi bar gyur cig mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i stobs dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthu la brten nas ji ltar bsngos shing smon lam btab pa de kho na bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig des gshin po'i don du bsngo ba grub/ da khyed rnam pas dus las 'das pa'i don du dge ba bsags pas thob pa'i bsod nams bsngo ba yin pas/ dge ba 'di'i mthus khyed rang rnams sangs rgyas thob/ gnas skabs tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i don du bsngo snyam pa gyis la lad mo gyis shig phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi dge ba ci mchis pa/ /'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i shes rab kyis/ /yod med la sogs dmigs pa'i dug spangs te/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das la mi smon par/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur thog shog /gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthus bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams sku khams bzang bar gyur cig sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig mthun rkyen chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin 'grub par gyur cig sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par gyur cig mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /sogs bya'o/

/gshin bsngo bsdus pa dbon po rdo rje dpal bzang gi don du dwags por chos rjes mdzad pa'o// // ༄༅/ /swasti/ chos dbyings dag pa'i dpag bsam rkang 'thung / don kun gzigs pa'i lo 'dab rgyas shing / thugs rje'i grib bsil bsam las 'das pas/ 'gro kun gdung ba'i tsha ba zhi mdzad/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / srid zhi'i nad kun sel ba'i rtsi sman/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan mchog tu bzhugs shing / de dag gi thugs rjes bskrun pa'i phrin las/ gdul bya dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin chen/ ngo mtshar dang ba bskyed pa'i rten gsum/ sna tshogs rgyal ba'i zhing na bzhugs pa/ nam mkha'i khams ltar bgrang las 'das la/ khyad par dpal 'byor chu bo 'du ba'i rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub klu'i dbang po'i bsti gnas/ bsod nams lo thog bskrun pa'i sa gzhi/ dam chos sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i mdun sa/ chos dan bde chen nam/ chos grwa chen po'am/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ bla brang ngam/ gzims khang yid 'ong bsti gnas 'di nyid na'ang / ngo mtshar dpal gyi gzi yis brjid cing / byin rlabs bsil zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i rten gsum rnam dag 'od dkar can la/ sna tshogs mchod pa'i ri bong mtshan mas legs par spras te/ bka' sdod mthu ldan rgyu skar phreng ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ kun las khyad par 'phags par bzhugs pa'i skyabs kyi 'og nas/ 'khor ba'i chu gter sgrol ba'i ded dpon/ mkhyen brtse nor gyis gang ba'i bang mdzod/ legs bshad 'brug stong sgrog pa'i chu 'dzin/ slob dpon chen po'am/ bla ma'am/ mkhan chen pa'am/ slob dpon pa'am/ mkhan po ba rnam pas gral gyi dbu mdzad/ bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i seng ge/ thub bstan ral pa'i khur gyis brjid cing / lung dang rigs pa'i mche sder rnon pos/ phas rgol glang po'i dregs pa 'joms pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam pas gral gyi thog drangs shing /

tshogs gnyis dpal 'byor bskrun pa'i zhing mchog thub bstan des pas srung ba'i sdom brtson/ gdul bya dge la 'god pa'i dbang phyug dge 'dun sde gnyis sam/ bla sgo gsum ci rigs gdan mngon par 'dzom pas gral gyi gzhi bzung / bsod nams bang rim mdzes pa'i lhun po/ thabs shes 'chi med dbang po'i bsti gnas/ rnam dag khrims kyi dpal gyis mtho ba'i/ gong mas mngags pa'i gser yig pa'am/ dpon chen pa'am/ nang chen pa la sogs pa skabs dang sbyar bas gtso mdzad pa rnams kyis sam/ mi che ba rnams kyis gung mnan/ sngon sbyangs blo gros nyin mor byed pas/ sna tshogs rig pa'i 'od stong 'phros te/ bzo sman rtsis sogs 'du byed snang bas/ dad can dang ba'i chu skyes bskrun mdzad/ thun mong gi yon tan can rnams kyis gral gyi zur nas mdzes par brgyan/ rab dang bsil ba'i zer gyis phye ba'i/ dag cing gtsang ba'i lag gi ku mud/ phun tshogs yid 'ong zhal zas ze'u 'brus/ mchod yul dgyes pa'i thugs rab 'phrog mdzad de/ bya ba byed pa rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten nas/ 'di ltar tshogs pa phun sum tshogs par bzhugs shing / 'di ltar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang rab dkar las kyi rin chen phreng mdzes/ smon lam dag pa'i srad bus brgyus te/ chos dang dam tshig dag pas sbrel bas 'brel pa zab/ bdag gzhan rgyud kyi rnam dag sa gzhir/ tshogs gnyis rgya chen lo thog bskrun pas/ don gnyis 'bras bu smin par byed pa'i tshogs la 'tshogs pas tshogs pa bzang / lo rgyus/ thog mtha' med pa'i 'khor bar gnas pa'i/ /'gro la thar pa'i lam mchog bstan nas/ /myang 'das mchog gi grong du bsdud mdzad/ /thub dbang sras bcas dri med bstan pa/ /de 'dzin skyong dang spel bar mdzad pa/ /'gro ba kun la bka' drin che/ /skabs don nye bar mtshon pa'i dbang du bgyi na/ gdugs de ring gi skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur ba'i bla ma dang /

dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rnams dang / skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i zhal zas sam/ ja dang bu ram mam/ mang ja'i bsnyen cing bkur bas nye bar mchod nas/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten nam/ yul mchog tu gyur pa la/ 'bul ba/ me tog gi dngos po rnam par dag pa dang bcas pa'am/ dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu'am skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gral 'gyed kyi dngos po dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can yongs su rdzogs shing / bstan pa rin po che dar ba dang / sems can la bde da dpag tu med pa 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir ram/ khyad par 'gro ba rnams kyi skyabs gnas/ bla ma dam pa che ge mo'i dus kyi mchod pa la dmigs nas/ nang so chen po'am/ bla brang chen po nas sam/ ming che ge mos sam/ sngar nas ji ltar bsgrubs pa'i srol bzhin du/ bsam sbyor dad gus dang bcas pas bsgrubs par gda' na/ shin tu rjes su yi rang zhing dge/ slad ma phyis 'byung bstan pa dar/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i thad du/ dge zhing bkra shis pa'i bya ba 'di lta bu la 'tshog par smon/ gtor ma'i byin rlabs/ theg pa chen po'i mdo dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam mkhyen du bsngo ba dang bcas pa rim pa bzhin mdzad par zhu/ thog mar gtor ma'i byin rlabs mdzad par zhu/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba bgyid/ bsngo ba 'grub pa'i dpang por/ bla ma yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig snyam pa'am/ bla ma gong ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur cig snyam pas/ bsngo ba'i lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/

/zhes pa'am/ 'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing / zhes sogs sam/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /zhes sam/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed ces sam/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /zhes sam/ bsod nams 'di yis/ zhes sam/ sbyin pa rgya chen gyur pa/ zhes sogs gsum gsum dang / thams cad kyi rjes su/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /gtsug lag khang rnams sogs dang / sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ces sogs dang / gzhan yang skye ba 'di nyid du/ /sogs dang / bsod nams stobs chen 'di yis ni sogs dang / de ltar byang chub ma thob bar/ /rigs mtho gzugs bzang longs spyod che/ /shes rab phun tshogs dbang phyug ldan/ /nad med shin tu tshe ring ba/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan shog /ces dang / rgyal po sbyin bdag nyid dang ni/ /sogs dang / thams cad kyi rjes su/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs sogs sam/ bla med bla ma'i thugs rje sogs/ /bden stobs brjod/ mol ba dang bsngo ba drung chos kyi rje pas gnyal stod du mdzad pa'o// // ༈ phun tshogs yon tan mchog gi nor lha/ mkhyen gsum yon tan 'byor pa'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur bas/ mkhyen rab thugs rje phun sum tshogs pa'i nor la dbang 'byor pa rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / ta dben kun legs pa phyag phyir yod pa'i don du/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dam par bzhugs/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi rten spyir rgyal ba'i zhing na bzhugs pa bsam gyis mi khyab la/ khyad par dge legs du ma'i 'byung gnas/ gnas 'di nyid na'ang / bde b.ragashegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams kyi drung na/ rnam dag yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin phung du mas spras pa/ mthu ldan dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa ches mchog tu gyur par bzhugs pa'i skyabs kyi 'og nas/

dge legs rin chen gling du khrid pa'i ded dpon/ mkhyen brtse nor bu'i dpal la dbang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis gral gyi thog ma mdzad/ bsod nams lo thog bskrun pa'i zhing mchog dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung / bsod nams dang mthu stobs kyi dpal gyis gzhan las mngon par mtho ba'i mi che ba rnams kyis gral gyi gung mnan/ phyi rol sna tshogs rig pa'i rgyan gyis kun nas mdzes pa'i yon tan can rnams kyis gral gyi zur nas mdzes par brgyan/ tshul bzhin zhabs thog bsgrubs pas mchod yul dgyes pa bskyed pa'i bya ba byed pa rnams kyis gral gyi mtha' brten te 'di ltar bzhugs pa thams cad phun sum tshogs par bzhugs pa lags/ 'di ltar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang spyi 'brel smon lam/ sgos 'brel thub bstan rnam par dag pa'i 'brel pas sbrel bas 'brel pa zab/ phun tshogs nye bar bskrun pa'i thabs khyad par can la 'tshogs pa bzang / de ltar 'brel tshogs la brten nas gleng sgo dang / bla sgo ci rigs su cha tshang / lo rgyus la mi chos dang / lha chos gnyis las/ gleng bar gda' na'ang / mi chos kyi lo rgyus rab tu byung ba'i spang byar gda' bas zhu mi 'tshal/ lha chos kyi lo rgyus bde bar gshegs pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang / de dag gi bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dang bcas pa 'gro ba yongs la bka' drin che/ dgos don gyi dbang du bgyis na/ gdugs de ring gi skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa'i bla ma dang / yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la/chos dang mthun pa'i zhal zas kyi'am/ mang ja'i bsnyen cing bkur bas nye bar mchod nas/ bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten rnam par dag pa dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bstan pa rin po che dar ba dang / sems can la bde skyid dpag tu med pa 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir ram/

rang gzhan gyi rgyud la dge legs rgya chen po nye bar bskrun pa'i thabs mchog la dmigs nas che ge mos bsam sbyor dad gus dang bcas pas bsgrubs par gda' na shin tu rjes su yi rang / slad ma phyis 'byung bstan pa dar/ sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i thad du dge zhing bkra shis pa'i bya ba 'di lta bu la 'tshog par smon zhing / gtor ma'i byin rlabs/ theg pa chen po'i mdo/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam mkhyen du bsngo ba dang bcas pa/ rim pa bzhin mdzad par zhu/ thog mar gtor ma la/ bsngo ba mdzad par zhu/ phyogs bcu la sogs pa'i mthar/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /la sogs lan gsum/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gi mthu la brten nas/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig bstan pa 'dzin pa thams cad sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring bar gyur cig sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par gyur cig khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi'am/ sbyin bdag dang dmigs yul so so yin na sbyin bdag dmigs yul dang bcas pa'i rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig bsam sbyor thams cad chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /la sogs brjod pa'i mthar bdag cag smon lam du btab pa 'grub par shog dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis bdag cag smon lam du btab pa de kho na bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig gzhan tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa la sogs brjod/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /zhes sam/ rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi mthu bo pa/ /zhes sogs kyis bsngo/ dus mchod yin nas bla ma che ba yin na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

ces mgor gzhug skye bo phal pa yin na dmigs pa'i yul gyis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad ces sbyar/ dge bshes phal pa yin na/ bstan 'dzin gyi mjug tu dmigs pa'i yul gyi lam gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig ces gzhug gshin don yin nas/ bla ma ches che ba yin na/ skabs don gyi dbang du bgyis na'i 'og tu/ yon tan rin po che'i dpal gyis gdul bya'i dgos 'dod ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i bla ma chen po'i zhal snga nas/ bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed dam par gyur cing yon tan rin po che'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho la/ gdul bya'i dgos 'dod ma lus pa rdzogs par mdzad pas shin tu sku gces pa lags na'ang / bsnyun gyi rkyen gyis thebs bdog par gda' ba'i thad du/ zhabs thog gso sman/ sku'i rim gro la sogs pa phun sum tshogs par bgyis bdog par gda' na'ang / zhing khams gzhan du gdul bya rgya che bar dgongs nas zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan gda' zhing / de'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs la dmigs te/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang rab tu gdan drangs nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa zhag 'di tsam yun ring du'am rnam par dag pa bsgrubs pa dang / gshegs rdzongs kyi rim pa la dmigs te/ 'di dang 'di zhes bya bar dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur 'di 'dra bar bsgrubs pa dang / da dung du'ang 'di dang 'di 'dra ba bsgrub par 'gyur ba'am/ de tsam ma lcogs na yang / sngar yang dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ skye bo'i sbyin gtong la sogs pa rgya cher bsgrubs pa dang / da dung du yang bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang / khyad par de ring gi skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa la sogs sbyar ba'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa che ge mo'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs la dmigs nas/ che ge mo bsam sbyor dad gus dang zhes sogs sbyar/

bsngo ba dus mchod kyi dang 'dra/ yang bla ma chen po min pa'i sde dpon rnam dge bshes 'bring po shi ba yin na/ slob dpon nam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen che ge mo kun gyi phyogs nas thugs rgyud yon tan thams cad phun sum tshogs shing bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba la brtson pa shin tu gces par bdog pa lags/ kha sing nas kyi skabs su bsnyung nad drag pos thebs shing / de'i thad du sman dpyad rim gro bsnyung gsol la sogs gang gi sgo nas re ma shor bar bsgrubs su zin na yang / khong pa rang gi smon lam gyi 'phen pa yongs su rdzogs pa la brten nas/ sku gshegs gda' zhing / khong pa'i thugs rgyud la tshogs gnyis spel zhing / 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir cho ga rnam par dag pa bsgrubs pa dang / mthun rkyen bsod nams sogs pa'i bya ba la dmigs nas sngar yang dge 'dun gong nas sbyar ba'i mjug tu che ge mo'i thugs rgyud la tshogs gnyis rgya chen spel ba'i thabs la dmigs nas che ge mos bsgrub sogs bya/ 'di'i bsngo ba la bstan 'dzin gyi rjes la khyad par slob dpon nam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i sa lam gyi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig gnas skabs kun tu'ang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig bzhed dgu chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig de'i rjes su sems can sogs sbyar/ phal pa yin na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'dus byas mi rtag par gsungs pa'i rigs pa'i rnam pa de nyid/ che ge mo'i steng du mngon par gyur nas mi rtag par song gda' zhing / de'i rgyud la 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyong ba la dmigs nas/ bla ma slob dpon chos kyi 'brel pa yod pa rnams kyi drung du'ang /

cha rkyen gyi dngos po phul nas thugs dam la 'dogs par/ mthun rkyen bsod nams spel ba mnyam du sbrags pa'i dge rtsa la dmigs nas 'gyed yongs su gtong ba rnams la chang zan gyi 'gyed dang / bgo dar ram/ bgo ras sam/ 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur ram/ skye bo'i sbyin gtong yul lugs dang mthun par bsgrubs gda' zhing / rjes kyi dge rtsar dmigs nas dge 'dun gyi 'brel yod dang / skye bo'i tshogs la bsnyen bkur sngar yang ci 'grub bsgrubs shing / da dung yang bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang / khyad par de ring gi skabs su sogs sbyar ba'i mjug tu/ 'di nyid che ge mo'i rgyud la sgrib gnyis sbyangs shing tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs la dmigs nas che ge mos bsgrubs sogs sbyar/ bsngo ba bde zhing skyid par gyur cig gi rjes su/ khyad par du yang tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba rigs drug dang khams gsum gang du skyes sam skye bar 'gyur ba'i las can zhig yin na'ang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyi bzhin du rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su 'jug par gyur cig myur du sangs rgya bar gyur cig sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar skye ba kun tu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal 'byor la longs spyod par gyur cig dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ci bsams chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig ces sbyar/ yul 'ga' rer bsngo ba gong 'og gam/ gson gshin gyi bsngo ba zhu zer na/ gson po'i spyi dang 'dra ba la gshin bsngo gtso bar zhu na/ gshin bsngo gong / gson bsngo 'og tu bya zhing / gson chog gtso bor zhu na de las bzlog par bya zhing / gshin bsngo ni khyed kyis dus las 'das pa'i don du bsod nams bsags pa rnams rnam mkhyen du bsngo ba 'dod par 'dug na/ slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas/ spyod 'jug las/

dngos sam yang na brgyud kyang rung / /sems can don la gzhan mi spyod/ /sems can kho na'i don gyi phyir/ /thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsngo bya'i dge rtsa tshe las 'das pa'i don du bsngo/ sngo byed kyi bsod nams bsags pa dang / tshe las 'das pa rang yod dus na bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad yin/ bsngo sa mthar thug sangs rgyas/ gnas skabs 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid phun sum tshogs par bsngo/ bsngo ba'i cho ga thabs shes zung 'brel gyi bsam pas bzung ba'i tshul gyis 'di bzhin du sgoms/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ tshe las 'das pa rang yang 'dug par mos nas bsngo ba byed/ de'i grogs khyed kyis byed par mos la lad mo gyis/ dgongs su gsol gyi mthar/ bdag gis tshe las 'das pa'i don du/ sangs rgyas kyi rten la mchod pa phul/ chos gsung bsgrags/ gzungs sngags bzlas brjod byas/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ skye bo la sbyin gtong bgyis pa'i dge ba rnams dang / tshe las 'das pa rang gis bsgrubs shing / bsgrub par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad phyi bzhin du sogs gong dang sbyar la/ mthar/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /sogs lan gsum brjod pa'i mjug tu/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i bsngo ba bya'o/ /rab ston la gzhan gyi nang rten lta bu yin na/ bla ma che ge mo'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen che ge mo'i dgongs pa'i don nam/ phal pa yin na/ che ge mo'i rgyud la tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bya ba'i don du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs sam/ chos bris pa yin na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che lta bu bzhengs su gsol zhing / de dag gi bzo'i bya ba legs par rdzogs pa'i thad nas/ gza' tshes skar ma/ sbyor ba byed pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dzom pa'i thad du bzang po drug dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/

rab tu gnas pa legs par bsgrubs shing / de'i skabs su/ dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub shing mchod pa dang / sku gzugs kyi mnga' dbul ba la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma/ cho ga mdzad pa rnams la bsnyen bkur 'bul ba rnam par dag pa bsgrubs shing / khyad par da lta'i skabs su/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams sogs/ 'di nyid rab tu gnas pa legs pa bsgrubs pa'i dga' ston la dmigs nas che ge mos sogs sbyar/ bsngo ba gson bsngo dang 'dra// //oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ phun tshogs mkhyen pa'i 'od zer rnam par gsal/ /tshad med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas/ /dpag yas phrin las bzang po'i dpal mnga' ba/ /rgyal ba rta bdun bdag pos dge legs mdzod/ /thugs rje'i stobs mnga' bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /dkon mchog rin chen bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dkar phyogs legs skyong srung ma'i stobs/ gang yin de yis khyed srid brtan gyur cig /gong ma la bskur ba'i mchod brjod// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ gang zhig dge 'os mchod pa'i gzhir gyur cing / /nyin byed 'od 'dra sku yi dpal 'bar bas/ /lus can nyes pa'i tshang tshing mthar byed pa'i/ /rje btsun bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gong ma la// // ༄༅/ /gdod nas spros pa kun las rnam grol yang / /skal bzhin gdul bya sna tshogs don mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma gnyis med ye shes zhabs/ /gus pa'i yid kyis rgyun du brten par spro/ /yang / 'gro ba kun gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas mchog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i dpal gyis sa steng kun/ /brgyan par gyur cing de mthu dpag med pas/ /'gro ba'i rgud pa drungs nas 'byin gyur cig /mkhan chen bu ston pa la// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ gang gis 'gro ba mi zad sdug bsngal rnams/ /kun tu bsal slad 'khor ba spong bar mi mdzad la/ /lam mngon mdzad pas 'khor ba'i 'chi ba ma lus pa/

/drungs nas phyung zhing chos kun mngon mkhyen la phyag 'tshal/ /bla chen tri shrī kun rgyal la// // ༈ gang zhig dran pas sdug bsngal kun sel zhing / /'chi med tshe yi dpal dang rnam grol gyi/ /gtan gyi bde ba mchog tu stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan tshe dpag med pas dge legs mdzod/ /tha hu la// // ༈ phun tshogs mtshan dpa'i dpal gyis rab mdzes shing / /srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag zhi mdzad de/ /mchog tu bde ba'i 'bras bu stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan sgrol mas khyed la dge legs mdzod/ /hong thu la// // ༈ gur kum mdog can mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /gti mug mun pa'i tshogs kun 'joms mdzad la/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i ye shes stsol mdzad pa'i/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis khyed la dge legs mdzod/ /rgyal bu la// // ༈ gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer dra bas rab mdzes la/ /thugs rje'i rgyun gyis 'gro ba'i gdung ba zhi mdzad cing / /kun la phan dang bde ba'i 'bras bu stsol mdzad pa'i/ /'jig rten dbang po'i thugs rje rtag tu 'jug gyur cig /a khro la// //phrin las drag pos bdud rnams tshar gcod cing / /thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro rnams rjes bzung nas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa kun tu rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs 'jug gyur cig /swon ji dbon po la// // ༄/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang sku'i mdzes pas 'gro ba kun gyi yid 'phrog can/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gsal bar khyab/ /mkhyen pa'i thugs kyi shes bya kun gyi de nyid gzigs/ /sa gsum bla ma 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan gus pas mchod/ /de yi gsung rab zhi 'gog chags bral dam pa'i chos/ /'gro ba'i gdung ba ma lus zhi byed bdud rtsi mchog /de nyid thugs chud slob dang mi slob slob ma'i tshogs/ /tshogs kyi mchog gyur chos dang dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/

/dge legs kun 'byung 'gro ba kun gyi nyer mtsho'i gzhi/ /mkhyen brtse'i yon tan dpag yas nor la dbang 'byor pa/ /'gro ba'i ded dpon bstan 'dzin 'di dag zhabs brtan shog /lo tsā ba byang rtse er bskos pa'i 'bul yig go/ //༄༅/ /oṃ swasti/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs bkra shis phun tshogs rnam rgyal rtser/ /yon tan rab rgyas bkra shis nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ /tshad med thugs rje'i bkra shis ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo/ /bla ma mchog gi bkra shis rnam par rgyal gyur cig /bsod nams ye shes phun tshogs mchog gis legs bskrun zhing / /sgrib kun nyer zhi phun tshogs dpal gyi rnam par 'byor/ /shes bya kun mkhyen phun tshogs dpal gyis lham me ba/ /dpag yas phrin las phun tshogs rgyal bas bkra shis mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes rgya mtsho'i dpal las legs 'ongs shing / /lung dang rtogs pa rgya mtsho'i chu rgyun grangs med pas/ /'gro ba'i gdung ba rgya mtsho lta bu drungs 'byin pa'i/ /dam chos rin chen rgya mtshos dus kun dge legs mdzod/ /rdzogs sangs bstan pa rin chen nor la dbang 'byor zhing / /bslab gsum rnam dag rin chen rgyan gyis kun nas mdzes/ /'gro kun thar pa'i rin chen gling du 'khrid mdzad cing / /kun la phan bde'i rin chen mchog stsol zhing mchog rgyal/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thabs chen mchog gi dpal las byung / /dpe zla ma mchis mthu stobs mchog gis bdud kyi dpung / /rnam par 'joms mkhas dngos grub mchog gis dkar po'i phyogs/ /rnam kun rgyas mdzad srung ma mchog gis bkra shis mdzod// // ༄/ /mkhyen gsum yon tan du ma'i dpal la dbang 'byor ba rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / skyabs dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas dam par bzhugs/ de'i rten gsum spyir rgyal ba'i zhing na bsam gyis mi khyab pa la/

khyad par gnas 'di nyid na'ang rten gsum mchod pa dang bcas pa phun sum tshogs par bzhugs pa'i skyabs kyi 'og nas yon tan du ma'i rgyan gyis nye bar mdzes pa che ge'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis dbu mdzad/ sdom brtson mdo sngags rig pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams kyis gral gyi gzhi bzung / dpon yon tan mkhan po rnams kyis zur brgyan/ bya ba byed pas mtha' brten pa 'di ltar tshogs pa phun tshogs tshogs par bzhugs pa thams cad 'brel pa zab tshogs lugs dge/ lo rgyus sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa dang / bstan 'dzin rnams bka' drin che/ skabs don/ 'di ltar mngon du gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa'am/ nged dpon slob pa'am/ 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams la dro/ ja bu ram gyis bsnyen cing bkur ba/ 'bul ba gral 'gyed dam/ gang la gang 'os kyi 'bul ba phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa 'di nyid nged dpon slob kyi bshad len nam/ bsod nams sogs pa'i bya bam/ che ge mo'i dus mchod dam/ gson dge la dmigs nas che ges bsgrub par gda' na shin tu rjes su yi rang / slad ma bstan pa dar ba'i thad nas bkra shis pa'i bya ba 'di lta bu la 'tshog par smon/ dge 'dun rnams kyis gtor ma'i byin rlabs theg pa chen po'i mdo/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam mkhyen du bsngo ba rnams rim pas mdzad par zhu/ bsngo ba ni/ khyed kyis dge ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs pa rjes su yi rang / de rnam mkhyen du bsngos pas mi zad cing gong nas gong du 'phel te/ mdor/ ji ltar rgya mtsho chu thigs che nang lhung / /rgya mtsho ma skams bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces gsungs/ ji ltar bsngo na/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /zhes byams pas gsungs pa ltar 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul gyis bsngo 'tshal bas/

mdun du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar da lta'i dge bas thog drangs dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i dge ba kun rnam mkhyen thob pa'i don du bsngo/ de yang bsngo bya/ sngo byed/ ched du bya ba kun don dam du med/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu yin snyam pa gyis la lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs sam/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun sogs sam/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /la sogs kyi rjes la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di'i mthu la brten nas bla ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig bstan 'dzin dam pa rnams sku tshe ring zhing phrin las 'phel bar gyur cig sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par gyur cig khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag po'i phyi nang gi bar gcod mtha' dag nye bar zhi bar gyur cig bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang / /dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos pa de bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces 'di bsod nams mtshan can gsung / gtam bshad bsdus pa bsngo ba dang bcas pa'o// // ༄/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ phrin yig nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ /na mo lo kod ta ra sarba dzñā ya/ rab mdzes bkod legs nor bu'i dra ba yis/ /rab spras yid 'ong khang bzang ches bkra ba/ /gang gis mnar med me nang 'drar gzigs shing / /gzhan phyir dbu yang gtong pa de la 'dud/ /de yis legs gsungs dus gsum dge ba'i chos/ /nyes bral lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de sgrub brtson ldan bsod nams zhing gyur cing / /dge legs 'phel byed gang de'ang spyi bos bkur/

/chos tshul sna tshogs mang du thos kyang lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mthar ma son/ /bla ma'i man ngag rab zab ldan yang rtse gcig ting 'dzin sgrub la g.yel/ /'khor 'das de nyid legs par shes kyang blang dor gnas la 'khrul pa can/ /gzhan la gcig tu phan sems ldan yang phan med bdag gis 'di skad smra/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gang gi mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis khyab/ /ma ltar brtse ba'i thugs rjes 'gro la rnam dag rigs pa'i lam ston pa/ /bkra shis bla med mi zad gter gyur sde bdun yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /rgyal mtshan ches cher 'gro la gsal mdzad lung dang rigs pa'i mthar son zhing / /rnam dag bslab gsum rab rgyas lus drims sde snod ral pa'i khur gyis brjid/ /sgrub dang sun 'byin mche ba cher bsgrad rnam dag rigs pa'i nga ro yis/ /pha rol rgol ba glang po'i glad 'gems blo gsal ri dwags skyong la brtson/ /smra ba'i seng ge 'jigs med de la ring nas don 'di gsol bar bgyi/ /gang zhig bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yang / /yang dag sgrub pa'i mchod pas dben gyur la/ la la bstan la zhugs kyang de sun 'byin/ /'byin byed lta bu'i bshes gnyen de dag 'das/ /'das dang ma 'ongs mkhyen pa'i rgyal ba yang / /yang dag dbyings su btang snyoms bzhugs par mdzad/ /mdzad pa'i phrin las dus kyi dbang gis yol/ /yol bas bsgribs ltar de nyid ma mthong bas/ /rang rigs rang bzhin log par brtags gyur te/ /phrag dog 'gran dang nga rgyal dbang gyur cing / /bdag gzhan gnod pa du mas kun gzir ba'i/ /sbrul gdug lta bu'i 'gro bas skal ngan gyur/ /rang gis chos tshul zab mo ma rtogs shing / /shes bya'i gnas la blo gros ma byang yang / /gzhan du mkhas pa lta bu'i tshul 'chang ba'i/ /ne tso 'di yis 'gro mang bsdus pa mtshar/ /de phyir 'gro ba rnams kyi mig gyur pa'i/ /mkhas pa de dag khrel zhing thugs sun te/

/zhing khams gzhan du gshegs par gyur pa 'am/ /de las kha cig nags tshal brten pa bzhin/ /de slad bdag kyang thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /bsod nams dbang gis bslab gsum legs bzung ste/ /rab zab mdo rgyud bstan bcos legs sbyangs shing / /zab mo'i don la 'jigs med gdeng ldan yang / /ma rungs spyod pas bdag nyid gdungs gyur cing / /phal cher chos min spyod cing chos ldan rnams/ /kun gyis brnyas shing rnyed dang bkur stis dben/ /log spyod de dag kun gyis mchod cing bkur/ /dge legs spyod cing chos ltar sgrub pa dkon/ /sgrub pa de la kun gyis dpyas pa byed/ /dge ba byed pa kun gyis 'bad nas 'gog /skyon med mkhas pa skyon gyi dri mas dgod/ /phal cher chos dang chos min mi shes la/ /shes rlom de dag blang dor gnas la 'khrul/ /'dul ba pa rnams brtul zhugs rnams kyis khengs/ /lung smra de dag lung don sgrub la g.yel/ /rigs pa smra rnams mi rigs spyod pa ston/ /ting nge 'dzin pa 'jig rten bya bas brel/ /chos 'dod dam pa rnams dang phrad pa dkon/ /phrad pa de dag bshes gnyen skyon la rtog /de phyir thub bstan 'od zer stong ldan pa/ /log par lta ba'i chu 'dzin gyis bsgribs shing / /rtsod pa'i dus kyi nub ri'i mthar ltung bas/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams stobs dang ldan gyur cing / /rgyal ba nyid kyis gdul dka' sems can yang / /re shig btang snyoms bya bar gsungs phyir dang / /mngon shes mig bral rnams kyis gzhan gyi don/ /mngon sum bya bar ma gnang de yi phyir/ /bdag kyang drang srong rnams kyis bsten pa'i gnas/ /gzhan don byang chub bsgrub par 'gyur ba'i slad/ /rgyal sras 'phags pa rnams kyi gsung bzhin du/ /thos bsam bsgom la yang dag gnas par spro/ /de skad smras pa ji bzhin thogs med dang / /zhi ba'i lha dang klu sgrub yab sras sogs/ /sngon gyi mkhas grub dam pa de dag gi

/gzhung bzang rnams dang rgyal ba'i gsung rab las/ /ji skad gsungs pa rnam dpyod mtshungs med pa/ /sde snod 'dzin pa khyod kyis dgongs min nam/ /'on kyang gsung rab la lar snyigs ma'i dus/ /dam chos 'dzin pa phan yon che bar gsungs/ /bstan pa'i bya ba bshes gnyen kun gyis 'khur/ /yin phyir rang rang nus pa ji lta bar/ /srog la bab kyang dam pa'i chos srung ba/ /dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ma lags sam/ /de phyir bdag kyang ci nus bstan pa bsrung / /de ltar khyed kyang 'bral med brtson pa dang / /lan brgyar 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba la/ /log par sgrub pa'i dgra bo zil gnon mdzod/ /skal ngan skye bos smod par mi 'gyur ba/ /gang na'ang yod min me yi tsha ba bzhin/ /de ltar mkhyen pas mi mthun phyogs kun la/ /ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa brtan par mdzod/ /rang rang blo dang mthun par ma gyur pas/ /bdag la'ang mi rigs smra ba mang yod mod/ /shes bzhin dpyad pas las rnams sde snod las/ /gnang bkag rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin ci nus kyis/ /legs par bsgrubs pa'i dpang por rgyal ba dang / /rgyal sras mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel bstan bcos bcas/ /de dag brdzun na las de'ang brdzun pa dang / /de dag bden na las de'ang bden pa lags/ /rang gi rtogs tshul ji bzhin mdo tsam du/ /dam pa khyed la dang bas smra lags na/ /'khyog po'i yid can 'ga' zhig khrel na yang / /dam pa khyed dang khyod 'dra dgyes par 'gyur/ /'di la nongs gang mkhas la bzod par gsol/ /mi mkhas rnams kyis don 'di'ang dpyad par dka'/ /'dir 'bad dge bas bshes gnyen dam pa khyed/ /'phrin yig 'di yis kun nas dgyes gyur cig /rnam dpyod blo yi ded dpon mchog gis gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gling nas blangs/ /lung rigs chos kyis byi dor legs bsgrubs dri med mchog gi srad bur brgyus/ /phal cher rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis bkod pas kun nas mdzes byas pa'i/

/'phrin yig nor bu'i phreng ba 'di ni khyed thugs dgyes pa'i slad du 'bul/ /zhes pa gzigs pa'i rten du da lan rten khebs legs pa cig 'bul/ phyis myur du mjal nas gsung gleng bar bgyid/ dpa' bo'i lo bya dbo zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la sbyar ba/ skye ba kun tu bstan la legs zhugs tshul khrims gtsang ma'i gos gyon zhing / /rnam dag lung gi tshangs skud legs bcings dri med rigs pa'i ku sha 'chang / /thos bsam bsgom pa'i gsang sngags rab zlos 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i sreg lugs spyod/ /mi dge rgyang bsring rgyal sras dam pa'i drang srong mchog tu 'gyur bar smon/ /dge'o/ /rgya ma rin po che bkra shis rgyal mtshan la mdzad/ /༄/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gsung 'jam pa'i dbyangs snyan 'di ni sgra snyan ma lags 'gro ba'i mun sel sgron ma ste/ /mdzes shing zhi ba'i spyan yangs 'di 'dra spyan ras ma lags 'gro ba'i 'tsho byed bdud rtsi mchog /gang gi phyag nas rdo rje 'di yang rdo rje ma lags bdud dpung tha 'jig byed chu/ /rigs kyi gtso bo rnam pa gsum 'di lha mchog ma lags bdag gi spyi bo'i cod pan lags/ /dge slong chos smra bas/ rtag tu nyes pa'i mtsho chen skems kyang tshul khrims gtsang ma'i chab kyis brlan/ /dul ba'i spyod pas dang bar mdzad kyang phas rgol skye bo skrag pa bskyed/ /lung rigs 'od stong rnam par 'phro yang blo gsal ku mud tshal rab dbye/ /rnam dpyod spobs pa'i rlung lugs ldan yang khengs pa'i g.yo med de la bsnyad/ /dri med blo gros spyan mnga' ba/ /phrin las bzang po can de'i sku/ /bsnyun med bde ba'i gos gyon zhing / /nor bdun rgyan gyis brgyan to zhes/ /phrin yig pho nya'i ngag gis bsgrags/ /de yis bdag yid rangs pa'i ltas/ /bde ba'i ba dan legs blangs te/ /sems rgyud pho rang rtse mor bkod/ /slad nas snyan du gsol ba ni/

/bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i dpal/ /yun du gsal bar 'gyur ba'i slad/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rlung shugs kyis/ /rigs min chu 'dzin dengs pa dang / /legs bshad dga' ston phun tshogs kyis/ /gdul bya'i rgud pa kun bsal nas/ /rgyal ba'i bzhed pa kun sgrub pas/ /yun du 'tshe ba'i don gnyer mdzod/ /'tshal pa'i blo bzangs dpon dge slong la spring pa/ /khrims ldan yun ring 'tsho ba dang / /bsod nams phun tshogs spel ba dang / /las 'bras stong pa'i tshul shes pas/ /rang gzhan rtag tu bde bar mdzod/ /smon lam rdo rje la// // ༄/ /dka' ba bzhi pa la springs pa/ dge zhing yun ring 'tsho ba dang / /shes rab rnam gsum 'phel ba dang / /gzhan phan phun tshogs 'grub pa dang / /gnod pa mtha' dag zil mnan mdzod/ /'tshal pa la// // ༄/ /slob dpon grags pa bshes gnyen la springs pa/ gang la rten na dge legs 'phel/ /mkhas pa'i 'dun sar spobs pa skye/ /gzhan gyis 'phrog par mi nus pa'i/ /thos bsam nor gyis phyug par mdzod/ /'tshal pa rin po che// // ༈ slob dpon shākya rdo rje la springs pa/ 'di dang phyi mar phan pa ni/ /dam chos gcig pu lags pas na/ /'khor ba'i bde la ma chags par/ /bdag gis spyad cing gzhan la'ang sbyin/ /phrin yig yid bzhin nor bu 'o/ /bkra shis bde legs ldan par shog /'tshal pa// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ na mo gu ra we/ na mo ratpan tra yā ya/ dge legs chur 'byung yon tan dpag med 'dab stong rgyas/ /dpag med thugs rje'i ge sar dpag med phyogs kun gsal/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsis gdul bya'i bung ba tshim mdzad pa/ /dpag med bla ma rab tu gus pas spyi bos mchod/ /bsod nams ye shes dri med chu gter legs zhugs shing / /ji snyed ji bzhin legs par gzigs pa'i spyan stong ldan/ /'gog lam mthar son a mo li khra'i khrir bzhugs te/ /gdul bya'i lha tshogs chos kyi sgra yis tshim mdzad 'dud/ /gang zhig bsten na nyes pa'i tsha gdung kun sel zhing /

/gdul bya'i sa gzhir phan bde'i myu gu bskrun pa dang / /bsod nams dpal gyis 'phags pa'i rgya mtshor legs 'jug pa/ /gdul bya'i lha tshogs chos kyi sgra yis tshim mdzad 'dud/ /dam chos chu bo chen po bzhi gus pas bkur/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs par gnas bcas shing / /dri med thugs kyi gdengs ka'i gtsug na mkhyen pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor bus legs sprad dam chos phud sgra sgrogs/ /dge 'dun rin chen klu dbang tshogs bcas gus pas mchod/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje nam mkha'i khyon las legs byung zhing / /rnam 'phrul du ma'i glog khreng phyogs kun rab gsal ba/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ 'brug sgra mi zad cher bsgrags pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad chos skyong char sprin dbang pos dge legs mdzod/ /grub pa'i bka' bzhin chos 'khor skyong bar zhal bzhes nas/ /myur mgyogs mthu rtsal phrin las drag pos mi mthun phyogs/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs ma lus 'joms mdzad mthu bo che/ /gnod sbyin pa'i dpa' brtan rdo rje bdud 'dul rgyal gyur cig /de ltar yul khyad par du 'phags pa bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa la mchod par brjod cing shis par brjod pa'i gang sngon du bkod nas/ skabs kyi don snyan du gsol ba ni/ phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang / kha ba can gyi rgyal khams rnams la phan gdags par bya ba'i slad du/ sngon gyi chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje chen po'i dpal las nye bar bskrun pa bod mun pa'i smag rum dang 'dra bar bstan pa rin po che 'od gsal bar mdzad pas thub pa'i dbang po gnyis pa lta bur gyur cing / 'dzam bu'i gling la mnga' mdzad pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bur gyur pa rnams kyis gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur cing /

ding sang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid/ spyir bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing / chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang gnyis su ma mchis pa yon tan bgrang las 'das pa rnams mnga' ba'i khri srong lde'u btsan zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa la brten nas/ gong ma mi'i dbang po yon mchod kyis gtso mdzad/ chos dang zang zing gi dpal dang bcas te zhabs brtan pa dang / sems can ma lus pa'i bde skyid 'phel ba'i slad du/ byi ba lo nas brtsams te/ gtsug lag khang chen po skor bcas kyi gso nam la zhugs te/ ji ltar mnos pa'i lugs bzhin/ slob dpon shes rab dpal ba dpon slob rnams kyis lag len la thebs par bgyis te/ zhig gsos kyi dngos po rnams kyang bzo rig pa kho na'i phyogs su legs par btang nas spre'u lo'i bar du gtsug lag khang rnams kyi zhabs tog legs par bgyis shing / khyad par sngar ma grub pa rnams kyi zhig gsos bgyid pa'i 'dun pa yod pa'i thad du/ thog mar yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yon tan du ma'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba'i dpal bla ma sangs rgyas grags pas sngon gyi chos rgyal chenapo de nyid kyi gdung rgyud gu ge spu rangs kyi btsan po yab yum blon po dang bcas pa rnams kyi snyan du gtsug lag khang chen po'i bsnyen pa brjod cing dge bskul mdzad pa la brten nas/ btsan po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / bla ma sangs rgyas grags pa nyid dang bcas pa rnams kyis sman gser gyi 'bul ba rgya cher bskur byung pa dang / de'i rjes la gong ma yon mchod mi'i dbang po sa'i bdag po chen pos kyang nged la gnang sbyin chen po thugs la btabs pa dang / bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa slob dpon chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan dang /

khrims gnyis kyi bya bas rgyal khams legs par skyong ba dpon chen pas gtso mdzad nye gnas rnam pas kyang ka ru ma bzang po gnang ba dang / yon tan rin po che'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba gdul bya'i gtsug na yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur ches cher gsal ba rin po che pa dang / stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba lta bu slob dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan pa sku mched pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis snga phyir 'bul ba ka ru ma bzang po gnang ba dang / khyad par du'ang nye gnas chen po rin chen bzang po pas kyang ka ru ma bzang po gnang ba dang / dpon chen po dge blo ba sku mched khu dbon rnams kyis kyang ka ru ma bzang po gnang ba dang / lha rnam pas gtso mdzad gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun yon bdag dang bcas pa rnams kyis dad mos kyis kun nas slang nas gtsug lag khang chen po'i zhig gsos kyi ka ru ma mang du phul ba dang / dbus gtsang ma'i ris skor gsum/ mdo sde smad/ dwags kong la sogs kyi dad pa can gyis 'bul ba'i dngos po rnams chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir/ gtsug lag khang chen po 'di nyid kyi zhig gsos kyi phyogs su phul te/ spre'u lo zla ba dang po nas brtsams te/ bya lo'i lo gsar pa shar ba'i bar du gzhi ba nams kyis kyang gus pas lus ngag yid gsum gyis 'bad pa bgyis pas/ gtsug lag khang chen po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'gran zla dang bral ba bzhi'i gso nam legs par grub cing / de'i skabs su/ gza' dang / skar ma dang / sbyor ba dang / byed pa bzang po 'dzom pa'i thad du me tog 'thor zhing / bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba'i skabs da nang gi thad du/ zhal mngon du gyur pa rin po che pas gtso mdzad/ mkhan slob yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gdan drang bar 'os pa rnams dang / slob dpon pas gtso mdzad spyan drangs pa rnams dang / gzhir bzhugs pa lha rnam pas gtso mdzad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang /

gzhan yang gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la chos dang mthun pa'i zhal zas ja dang btung ba dang bcas pa'i bsnyen cing bkur bas nye bar mchod cing / dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu bzang sman gyi 'gyed dang / yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyis 'bul ba rnam gzhag yi ge'i ngos nas brda sprod par byed pa'i ngag 'di ltar lags/ zhes pa dang / mthar/ dge ba 'di yis bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams/ /dge legs mdzod gyur sangs rgyas grong khyer mchog bzhugs te/ /zag med bde ba'i dpal la dga' dgur spyod byed cing / /phun tshogs dpal gyis phyogs kun gsal byed shog /gzhan yang thub bstan nyi mor byed pa'i dpal/ /mi mthun gza' yis sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing / /bstan 'dzin rnams kyi dpal dang 'byor par bcas pa yis/ /nam mkha' ji srid yun du zhugs brtan 'gyur bar shog /bsam yas gso nam chen po'i dus su 'bul yig go/ // ༄/ /na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ gang gi zhabs sen dmar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis mun pa mthar mdzad cing / /yan lag mchog gi chu skyes rab mdzes pa/ /'jig rten dbang pos rtag tu skyong gyur cig /bsod nams rab rgyas chu gter che las 'ongs/ /zla ba rgyas ltar yon tan cha shas rdzogs/ /brtson pa rab rgyas phun tshogs dpal gyis brjid/ /dge legs rin chen kun nas rgyas gyur cig /blo gros rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor brtson pa mchog gi shing rtas drangs/ legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer stong gis rigs pa'i snang ba ches cher gsal bas/ blo gsal dang ba'i pad tshal rgyas par byas te thos bsam dag pa'i 'bras bu kun nas rgyas par 'gyur to/ /zhes 'phrin yig dri ma med pa rten rgya chen po dang bcas pa mngag pa'i mis legs par thengs pas yid 'phro ba 'phel zhing rjes su yi rang / skabs kyi don/ khyed rang gi khams kyi 'tsho skyong la brtson pa'i thad nas/

gnas chen du rnam 'grel rigs gter gyi 'chad nyan tshugs pa'i brtson 'grus dang 'bad pa cher byed pa gal che/ nged kyis kyang de'i mthun rkyen du gang 'gro'i rten 'brel sgrig pa yin/ yi ge'i rten phreng ba legs pa dgu tshan gcig dang / nged rang gon 'phro'i phrug phya ma gcig yod/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄/ /phun tshogs dri med sku yi cha las ni/ /nyin byed 'od zer bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /lus can blo yi pad tshal rab rgyas nas/ /sku gnyis ze'u 'bru'i rtsi yis gtam par mdzod/ /dge shes tshul rgyal la// // ༄/ /gang mtshan skad cig cig la dran tsam gyis/ /sgrib pa gnyis zhi zhi gnas las 'das nas/ /gang gis chom kun kun tu mngon sum dang / /ji bzhin rab mkhyen mkhyen pa mnga' la 'dud/ /shubhaṃ/ /snang thar pa la// // ༄/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ 'jam pa'i dpal gyis mkhyen pa'i phul/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi brtse ba'i gter/ /kun gyi mdzad mnga' kun gyi mgon/ /sa gsum bla ma rgyal gyur cig /mkhyen brtse'i phrin las phun tshogs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gang zhig gang gis chags bral dam pa'i chos/ /de 'dzin sgrub byed dge 'dun rin chen gter/ /dkon mchog dge ba'i bkra shis ding 'dir stsol/ /'gro ba'i kun tu dga' ba'i gzhi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog /mi dbang dam pa khyed kyi sku/ /lhun po bzhin du legs brtan shog /gong ma la// // ༄/ /oṃ na mo shrī gu ra we/ na ma skā rā yai/ phun tshogs rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las las/ /lha mo'i tshul gyis gdul bya rjes bzung phyir/ /'gro la lha mo'i tshul gyis mchog stsol ba'i/ /srid gsum sgrol mdzad de yis skyong gyur cig /hong tha'i tshe// // ༄/ /na maḥshrī gu ra we/ gang gi grags pa 'dzin ma'i mthar son zhing / /rgya chen mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' dpag yas las/ /phrin las chu gter lta bur mi zad pa/ /skyabs mchog bla ma'i tshogs kyis skyong gyur cig

/dge bshes blo ldan bzang po dmar khams pa la// // ༄/ /'jam pa'i ngang tshul 'jam dbyangs 'gro ba'i dpal/ /dpal gyi rjes 'gro phun tshogs dge ba'i dpal/ /dpal ldan tshogs gnyis pha rol phyin pa'i 'bras/ /'bras bu'i mchog des mchog tu dge legs mdzod/ /dge bshes byams pa dpal/ phun tshogs yon tan bdun la dbang 'byor zhing / /mthu stobs yon tan du mas mdzes pa khyed/ /nyi zla lta bur kun tu gsal ba dang / /chab srid 'dzin ma'i khyon ltar yangs par shog /ta'i si tu byang rgyal la// // ༄༅/ /gang zhig phun tshogs shar gyi ri yi rtser/ /ji lta ji snyed gzigs pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /dri med thugs rje'i 'od kyis dra ba can/ /rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon pos dge legs mdzod/ /ces gong ma'i drung du'o// // ༄/ /tshad med bzhi'i rin chen las grub cing / /phrin las rnam bzhi'i bang rim mdzes pa can/ /ye shes rnam bzhi'i dpal gyis mtho ba yi/ /rgyal ba rnam bzhi'i sku can lhun por 'dud/ /rab yangs shes bya'i nam mkha' mtha' yas par/ /lung dang rigs pa'i 'dab gshog rab bskyod nas/ /rnam grol rin chen gling du bgrod mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbang po rgyal gyur cig /don gnyis yid bzhin nor bu'i gter/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba'i slad/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum/ /rtag tu g.yel ba med par mdzod// // ༄/ /dge bshes dkon mchog seng ge la springs pa/ dkon mchog thugs rje'i rjes bsnyegs byas/ /che dben 'jig rten pha rol son/ /slob dpon a khro'i re ba bcad/ /da ni tshe 'di'i re ba gtong / /khyed kyang nyan 'chad sgom pa sogs/ /chos dang 'thun zhing rang gzhan la/ /phan pa'i bya ba rgya chen mdzod/ /bkra shis bde legs ldan par shog /nyen po ba'i dge bshes dkon seng la mdzad pa'o/ /shubhaṃ// // ༄/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ shel gyi tho shu'i dam phud kyi tshigs bcad chos rjes mdzad pa bzhugs/

bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /dpag yas yon tan kun la dbang 'byor zhing / /sa gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan mchog /dpal ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhabs la 'dud/ /tshogs gnyis rab rgyas rnam dag yid bzhin mtshor/ /dri med sku gsum 'dab stong rab rgyas shing / /dge legs ze'u 'brus rnam par sbud pa yi/ /rdzogs sangs pad tshal kun nas rgyal gyur cig /bde bar gshegs pa'i chos tshul dri ma med/ /nyes pa'i dri ma mtha' dag dag byed chu/ /rnam grol yid bzhin nor bu'i rten gyur pa/ /legs gsungs dam chos yun du gnas gyur cig /thub bstan 'dzin skyong kun nas gsal byed cing / /dus kun bsod nams mtha' yas bskrun pa'i zhing / /'gro ba kun gyi nyer mtsho'i gzhir gyur pa/ /dge 'dun rgya mtshos sa stengs brgyan gyur cig /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' yis nyer bsgos bzhin/ /thogs med mthu stobs mchog la dbang 'byor pa'i/ /bka' srung rnams kyis bdag cag skyong gyur cig /lhun po ltar brjid rngam pa'i zhal gdangs shing / /glog ltar 'khyug po'i spyan dmar mche ba gtsigs/ /thod sbrul gyis brgyan dar nag cod pan can/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog pas legs par srungs/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam bzhi dag pa yi/ /phyag gis gri thod ral gri rtse gsum bsnams/ /bai ta'i 'bras bus sgrub la mchog stsol bas/ /bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams spel gyur cig /de yi bka' nyan stsal ldan pho nya'i tshogs/ /thogs med rdzu 'phrul mchog la dbang bsgyur bas/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams mthu stobs zil mnan nas/ /de yi dpal yang dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ /dpal ldan nag po lcam dral 'khor bcas la/ /dri ma med pa'i shel las legs grub pa'i/ /kun la dbang bskur phyag rgya mchog gi phud/

/mthun pa'i mchod rdzas dam par legs 'bul gyi/ /nus pa mchog dang ldan par byin brlabs nas/ /kun la thogs med kun la dbang bsgyur zhing / /bsams pa'i don rnams yid bzhin sgrub byed pa'i/ /dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsal ba dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /longs spyod dbang phyug mthu stobs rab rgyas shing / /de yi dpal gyis bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams/ /rab rgyas 'jig rten kun tu bde legs shog /gzhan yang mi dbang sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis rab brgyan pa'i/ /mthu yis bdag sogs dpal yang dus kun tu/ /yar ngo'i zla bzhin rnam par 'phel gyur cig /de skad khyed la gsol ba 'debs byed pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog gi ring lugs pa/ /bla ma la gus grags pa byang chub dpal/ /bzang po zhes byas gus pa'i yid kyis phul/ /dge des 'gro kun rdo ja 'dzin gyur cig /shing pho stag gi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gsum la bris pa phyogs dus thams cad du bkra shis dang dge legs phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /spyan snga grags byang pa/ thel shod sbrel ba'i dus su/ tha shu spel kha'i dam phud 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad/ drung chos kyi rje pas mdzad pa/ yar lungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan pas dag par bgyis pa'o// // ༄/ /rmi lam brtag pa'i sngon 'gror/ oṃ mu rtsi li swāhā/ oṃ mo hā ni swāhā/ oṃ tan ti le swāhā/ zhes ci mang du bgrangs la/ ru ta'i chu la btab nas rmi lam 'dzin pa'i srod la khrus bya/ mtshams dam par ya ste zas dkar gsum la brten nas/ bud dha tsu ru'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig bya/ de nas las sbyor gyi dus su mi dang ye mi 'phrad cing tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rgyun gcig la bsnyen pa khri tsho gcig bya ste/ sngar bzhin sngags chus snga dro khrus byas la/ de'i nub mo dkar me mtshan thub gcig btang / sngas su khres pa gcig bcug

de la bsnyees pa'am/ gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcug pa'i sngas byas/ thub pa 'od skor re sngas mgo na bzhugs par bsgoms pa'i ngang la gnyid log cing yun ring na tho rangs kyi cha zin tsam/ de tsam ma byung na'ang nam phyed par gnyid mi log gal te gnyid byung nas rmi lam byung na'ang / rang ngam gzhan gang du skye ba rmi lam du lung bstan du gsol zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab/ 'dun pa'ang de bzhin du byas la gnyid log yang ngo mi shes pa'i rmi lam byung na/ 'di gang yin gsal por bstan du gsol le zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab/ skyar gyin skyar gyin brtags pas je gsal la 'gro/ ngag bcad dang gtsang sbra la brten pa gal che ba yin la/ the tshom med cing yid ches pas bsgom bzlas byas na nges par 'grub pa yin/ chos kyi rje pa la/ lha sras dam pa jo bo brag kha bas brag khar zhus nas mdzad pa yin la/ yar lungs pa seng rgyal gyis gus pas blangs te bris pa dge'o// // ༄/ /na mo gu ru/ char bcad pa'i man ngag la/ rdzas dang sngags gnyis/ rdzas la me tog lug ru ser po/ spang spos/ lham bkrad rnying pa/ tshwa/ mar/ rtsam pa rnams kyi dud pa btang / dngul bcad gang rung gcig bsregs la/ nam mkha' la 'phyar/ sngags ni/ oṃ ta thā da dhā na aṃ swāhā/ zhes bzlas so/ /rten 'brel byed mi ni me pho rta lo pa gcig gis byas na dge'o// //grags na sad byung nyen yod/ dge'o/ /yang mi rus mi gcig pa spyi ther pa bcu gsum gyi sen mo bregs la dud pa btang / de dag re re'i ming nas brjod nas ga ther mgo char gcod byas na'ang char 'chad do/ /dge'o/ /'jam dbyangs gu shrī chen po/ dbyar gtsang la byon dus/ chos kyi rje pa la zhus nas zhal dpod mdzad nas bris pa'i man ngag yar lungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis zhus shing zhu dag bgyis pa'o// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis phun tshogs dge legs rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs/

/ji lta ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs pa'i rba rlabs g.yo/ /rgya chen phrin las yid bzhin nor bu'i gter gyur pa/ /yon tan bgrang yas bla ma yid bzhin rgya mtshor 'dud/ /kun la phan slad byang chub chen por thugs bskyed de/ /dpag med dus su tshogs gnyis rab tu rdzogs mdzad pas/ /byang chub brnyes nas chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor te/ /'gro gnyen mchog gyur sangs rgyas skyabs kyi mchog gyur sangs rgyas skyabs kyi phul la 'dud/ /de gsung zhi ba de nyid ston byed gsung rab tshogs/ /sems kyi tha ba ma lus brlan byed dre med chus/ /'gro ba'i dri ma mtha' yas kun bkrus dam pa'i zhing / /thar pa'i lo thog legs bskrun bdud rtsi'i dpal la 'dud/ /de bcud thos bsam sgom pa'i snyim pas gus blangs nas/ /dri med 'phags blo'i ro 'dzin dbang pos legs myangs pas/ /'gro la phan bde'i dga' ston dus su bskrun mdzad pa/ /tshogs mchog dge 'dun bstan 'dzin kun nas rgyal gyur cig /gang la dpag yas mthu stobs dbang phyug spyan stong ldan/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i rnam dag ye shes rdo rje yis/ /bstan la gnod byed nag phyogs lha min g.yul 'joms pa'i/ /bstan skyong rnams kyis bstan dang bstan 'dzin rjes su skyongs/ /de ltar mchod yul khyad par du 'phags pa/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la mchod cing shis par brjod pa dang / bka' srung rnams la phrin las gsol ba'i ngag sngon du bkod nas/ skabs kyi don snyan du gsol ba ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i dpal las nye bar bskrun pa/ tshu rol mthong ba'i bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa'i mngon par rtogs pa dang / mang du gsan pa'i mkhyen pa mtha' yas pa mnga' bas/ bstan pa la zhugs pa dang / ma zhugs pa'i gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung ba dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i snying po mngon par rtogs pa'i chos rgya cher spel bas thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa rin po che gong nas gong du rgyas par mdzad pa'i slad du/

mkhyen pa'i spyan can rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun phag mo grub nyid kyis kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du phyags pheb pa nas brtsams te ji srid sku'i sprul pa ma bsdus kyi bar du/ rgyal ba'i phrin las rgya chen rgyun mi 'chad par bskyangs shing / de nyid kyi rnam par dag pa'i thugs rje dang phrin las kyis bskrun pa'i nor bu rin po che phul du byung ba'i yon tan du ma'i mdzod mnga' bas gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i skyabs mgon dam par gyur cing / chen po rnams kyi gtsug gis gus pas mchod pa'i cod pan dam pa/ rje spyan snga rin po che nas brtsams te/ de nyid kyi gdung rgyud bzang zar tshags su byon pa rnams kyis/ bar ma chad par chos kyi rgyal srid chen po la dbang mdzad cing / rnam par dag pa'i thugs kyi rgya mtsho chen po/ byang chub kyi sems kyi dba' rlabs kun tu g.yo la/ rnam par dag pa'i phrin las nor bu'i dpal gyis 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi re 'dod skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du skong bas gdul bya rnams kyi 'dren pa dam pa mdzad nas/ gdul bar bya ba'i slob bu'i tshogs rgya chen pos phyogs kun tu khyab cing / bsod nams kyi dpal rgya chen pos 'byor pa'i khyad par rgya mtsho chen po'i ngogs ltar rgya che zhing rgyun ring ba mnga' ba rnams kyang / dkon mchog gi zhabs tog chos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i bdag rkyen phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i sgo nas/ bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i rkyen 'ba' zhig tu nye bar sbyar ba'i rjes su mthun par/ sngon gyi bsod nams kyi mthu chen po'i rlung gi shugs kyis legs par brten cing / ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po'i dpal gyis nye bar bzung la/ rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims kyi 'dzin ma'i dbus kyi gzhir legs par 'khrungs pa'i rnam par dag pa'i dal 'byor gyi lhun po chen po/

shākya'i sras gau ta ma'i tshul lugs dri ma med pa'i bang rim bzhis kun nas mdzes la/ lung rigs man ngag du ma'i gtsug gis mngon par mtho zhing / byang chub kyi thugs rnam par dag pa'i gser ris yongs su bskor bas/ mi'i dbang phyug gi ri bo ches mtho ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur la phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis kun nas brjid par gyur pa'i kon ding gu shrī chang gu'i gung shākya rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ bstan pa rin po che'i bdag rkyen nye bar sbyar nas bstan pa rin po che'i gsal bar mdzad pa'i rjes su mthun zhing / stobs kyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po gong ma yab sras rim par byon pa yon mchod rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i bdag rkyen nye bar sbyar ba'i bka' srol mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir dang / bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams la phu dud du bya ba dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i mthus/ bstan pa rin po che gong nas gong du 'phel zhing mi nub par bya ba dang / gong ma mi'i dbang po yum sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa sku tshe brtan zhing chab srid rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang / khyad par du sku drin che ba yum nyid gnas skabs su sku tshe brtan zhing / rgyud la rnam par dag pa'i dge legs gong nas gong du 'phel la/ de nyid kyi mthus deng nas gzung ste tshe rabs kun tu lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor la longs spyod cing phun sum tshogs pa thams cad la dbang 'byor nas mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi phun tshogs 'byor bar bya ba'i phyir/ yum gyi sngon du bya ba'i bsod nams spel ba'i thabs la dgongs te/ dbur g.yor dang / skyi shod kyi sa cha la bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sdom brtson dam pa lung rigs smra ba dam pa'i chos kyi bka' bgro ba la dbang bar gyur pa ci mchis pa rnams spyan drangs nas/

sde snod gsum dang 'brel ba'i bka' mdo rgyud dang / grub mtha' bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bstan bcos/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa legs bshad rin po che'i za ma tog rnams kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i thad nas/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang / de rnams kyi rjes su mthun pa'i rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi spyan can/ bstan pa rin po che'i khur khyer ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams dang / lha dang mi'i mchod gnas bsod nams kyi zhing bla na med pa'i dge 'dun mdo dang sngags kyi cha 'dzin pa rnams la/ thog mar tshes dgu'i nyin par bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam pas legs par bsu zhing / tshes bcu'i nyin par/ 'dzugs ston gyi gro 'bul ba rnam gzhag grwa rgyags dang bcas pa dpon rgyal mtshan bzang pos bsgrubs pa nas bzung ste nang so nas nar ma'i zhabs tog bsnyen bkur ji ltar 'os pas nye bar mchod pa dang / gzhan yang chab 'og tu gtogs pa'i sbyin bdag dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis mang ja'i bsnyen bkur bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten dang bcas pa rgyun mi 'chad par bsgrubs te/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba legs par mthar phyin pa'i thad ga gdugs di ring gi skabs su/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam pa rnams dang / mkhan slob yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams la/ chos dang mthun pa'i zhal zas gro ja dang bcas pa'i bsnyen cing bkur bas nye bar mchod nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bka' drin gyi 'bul ba rnam gzhag spyan lam la phab pa/ slob dpon chen po pa dang / spyan snga rin po che pas gtso mdzad pa'i mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstan pa'i rtsa lag chos kyi spyan can rnams dang /
