gzhan yang dpon chen pas gtso mdzad 'bul bar 'os pa rnams la/ gang la gang 'os kyi 'bul ba rnam gzhag dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu gral 'gyed kyi dngos po/ gnang bzang po zho re dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa 'di nyid/ chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa mthar phyin pa'i dga' ston dang / thugs la btags pa so so'i rnam par dmigs te gu shrī ba'i thugs dgongs rnam par dag pas zhal la ji ltar byon pa'i lugs bzhin/ dpon rgyal mtshan bzang pos phyag len la thebs par bgyis te/ nang so 'di nyid nas bsam pa rnam par dag cing / sbyor ba gus pa'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i 'bul ba rnam gzhag yi ge'i ngos nas brda sprod par byed pa 'di ltar lags/ de ltar mchod par brjod pa dang / skabs don gsal bar smos pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /lhag bsam rnam dag gangs ri'i ngos las legs byung zhing / /'jig rten kun tu phan bde mi zad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dam chos smra rnams legs mchod dge des 'gro ba kun/ /bde phyir bla med byang chub mchog gi rgyur gyur cig /'bras bu'i mchog gang bde ba bla med sangs rgyas dang / /rgyal ba'i sras gang dpag med rdzu 'phrul cher ldan pas/ /nam mkha'i khyon kun legs par bkang ste mngon sum du/ /'gro ba rnams la theg chen chos char 'bebs par shog /gnas skabs 'gro 'di nye bar 'tshe ba kun bral nas/ /legs pa'i lam zhugs phan tshun kun nas 'gran pa ltar/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor dpag med dus ldan phun tshogs nas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bde skyid dpal la spyod par shog /rtsibs bcud lo thog sna tshogs bza' dang btung bar bcas/ /phun tshogs bgo bas rnam pa kun tu mi brel zhing / /dus rnams 'khrug med rang rang gnas skabs ji bzhin du/ /rnam par gnas pas 'gro 'di phun sum tshogs gyur cig /bdag kyang deng nas skye ba kun tu 'bad med par/ /rtag par rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi zhabs brten zhing /

/'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i 'byor pa rgya chen la/ /kun nas dbang 'byor srid zhi'i rgud pa sel byed shog /'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa/ /kun la dbang bsgyur zag med dga' bde dpag yas pa/ /blo yi lus rgyas khams gsum 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen mchog /chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog la gnas gyur cig /gnas skabs kun tu byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi rmad byung mdzad spyod dpag yas pa/ /legs par spyod pas bdag gzhan srid pa'i chu bo las/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon dam pa nyid du bdag gyur cig /'jig rten kun tu kun nas bkra shis mi zad pas/ /phyogs rnams kun tu kun nas dge zhing shis pa'i dpal/ /dus rnams kun tu kun nas rgyun mi 'chad pa yi/ /gnas skabs kun tu kun nas bde skyid ldan par shog /skyabs mchog bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs mchog rnam gsum chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa dang / /grogs mchog dge 'dun smon lam bden pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /smon mchog ji snyed smon pa ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs ma lus pa thams cad bkra shis dang bde legs chen pos 'byor bar gyur cig de ltar bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab pa'i skabs te bcu bdun pas te mthar phyin pa'o/ /dge bas byang chub myur thob shog /chu mo glang gi lo zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bcu la/ yar lungs sne gdong du chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbu btsugs nas/ nyi shu gcig gi nyin legs par grub pa bgyis pa'i dus su chos rjes mdzad pa'i 'bul yig gi dbu zhabs yin// // ༄/ /swasti/ da lo'i dbyar gnas kyi skabs su/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag rnam par dag cing dge ba'i thugs can/ yon tan rin po che'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba spyan snga nas dpon gnyer rnam gnyis kyis/ bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams la phu dud du bya ba'i slad du/

dgra bcom pa chen po kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shrī'i ring lugs pa sde snod gsum gyi dpal phun sum tshogs pas mngon par mtho ba/ mkhan chen pa zhal rnam pas gtso mdzad/ spyir lung rigs kyi dpal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' yang / khyad par du dge sbyong gi sbyangs pa'i yon tan lhur len cing / kha che'i mkhan po chen po bsod snyoms pa'i rnam par thar pa rjes su sgrub pa'i tshogs pa sde bzhi bzhugs pa rnams spyan drangs nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i thad du/ bdag cag rang sleb nas bsnyen bkur bar spro ba lags na'ang / khams ma snyoms pa de cung zad skyed tsam las ma byung pas snga mgyogs su/ da nang gi skabs/ spyan snga nas gtso mdzad mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun 'di ltar zhal mngon du gyur pa rnams la/ gdan mang ja'i bsnyen cing bkur bas nye bar mchod nas/ spyan snga nas kyi drung dang / mkhan cha zhal rnam pa dang bcas pa la bsngo ba zhu ba'i rten mtshon pa dang / gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis gtso mdzad/ mchod yul du spyan drangs pa rnams dang / dpon pas gtso mdzad spyan drang bar 'os pa dang bcas pa rnams la'ang 'bul ba cha phra mo dang / dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu gser dngul la gzhi blangs pa'i gral 'gyed cung zad dang bcas pa bsgrubs pa 'di nyid/ dge 'dun rnams chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ bstan pa dar zhing sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa'i yang don gnyis phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i ched du dmigs nas bsgrubs pa lags/ slad nas ci myur du 'jal ba lags/ zer ba mdzod/ shing mo yos kyi lo yar lung du jo dan tshogs pa sde bzhi dbyar gnas la bteg pa'i dus tshogs pa la chos rje'i sku rim mdzad dus/ mol ba'i dgos don/ chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'o//

// ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar maṇḍal 'bul du bcug la/ de nas slob dpon gyis thun mong gi bsrung 'khor brjod de/ bdud bgegs gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i srung 'khor brtan por zlos shig ces bsgo la/ dpon slob gnyis kas gsal gdab/ de rjes slob dpon gyis lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo'i rtags 'di bsgoms pas/ khams 'dus pa bar pa dang tha ma'i tshe mthong snang / thos snang gi ting nge 'dzin brtan par 'gyur la de'i tshe/ bdud kyis gzugs ston sgra brjod pa'i tshul gyis lung ston/ lha grub bsgyur ba 'byung srid cing / /de'i tshe brda 'di rnams bstan nas/ /rnam gsum rigs dbye ste/ brda bstan pas/ mthong snang thos snang yin na/ lan mi 'byung / bdud yin na ches shos kyi dbang gsum pa man chad kyi brda shes pa srid kyi/ bzhi pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'dab bya min pa'i dam tshig yin pas shes mi srid cing / brda bstan pa tsam gyis skyengs nas 'gro/ bzhi pa'i brda shes na/ yi dam yin pas dngos grub zhu/ de'ang brda 'di dag da lta rtog pa bsal ba'i phyir/ dngos su ston yang bstan dgos pa'i tshe/ lus kyi brda bcas shing ngag tu brjod par bsgom gyi/ dngos su mi ston/ ngag tu mi brjod/ de ltar byas na bdud dang po ngag la 'jug pas bar chad du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rang gi slob ma la ston na'ang srung 'khor dang bcas nas ston gyi gya tshoms su mi ston/ gzhan dus thams cad du lus kyi mi 'cha'/ ngag tu mi brjod pa lags/ de la rtsa ba'i brda bzhi 'di dag lags zhes brjod la/ ṭī ka bzhin brda dang po bcas la/ brda lnga bsdus rtse mo mnan pa dang / zhes pa de lags/ 'di ltar bcas par bsgoms la/ 'di ci'i brda yin zhes yid kyis dri/ bum dbang gi brda'o zer na/ lan thebs pas/ brda gnyis pa bcas la/ mtheb srin e la rig byed ces pa'i don lags/

'di ci yin zhes yid kyis dri sogs/ sngar gyi rigs pa sbyar la/ brda gsum pa dang bzhi pa bstan/ brda bzhi pa 'dis chog kyang / bdud che shos kyis zil gyis non nas brjed kyi dogs pa'i brjed thor/ yan lag gi brda bzhi ngag gi brda bzhi 'byung ba las/ yan lag gi brda 'dir brda byas la/ sgros dang sbyar la bshad/ de nas ngag gi brda 'dir byas la ka la sha a zhes brjod par bsgoms la/ 'di ci'i brda yin zhes yid kyis dri sogs/ sgros dang sbyar te brjod/ bar chad nges par bsrung ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sgros bzhin no/ /de nas brda 'di dag gnas skabs thams cad du gsang bar bya dgos so/ /zhes pa'i don du dam bzhag bzhis dam la 'jog par brda byas la/ ye shes gang gi sogs bzhi bdag 'jug bzhin brjod cing / spyi bo snying khar rdo rje/ lce la bdud rtsi/ yang spyi bor rdo rje rim bzhin bzhag gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pasogs dang maṇḍal phul la/ deng nas brtsams te sogs slob mas brjod do/ /brda tshig rgyud kyi phyag len bskul ba bla ma gzhon rgyal ba po'i don du btsun pa bsod nams kyis sbyar ba'o// // ༄/ /swasti/ bla ma bsgoms la gsol ba gdab/ /rgyun du 'chi ba dran par bya/ /sems can rnams la snying rje bsgom/ /chos rnams rmi lam lta bur bsam/ /mnyam gzhag dus su mi rtog pa'i/ /ting 'dzin zung 'jug ngang la bzhag /rjes la bsngo ba rgyas gdab bya/ /nam yang don med mi bya 'o/ /shubhaṃ// // ༄/ /tho rangs dang por skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ /de nas bla ma bsgoms la gsol ba gdab/ /lhar bskyed lus sbyang mnyam gzhag bsgom par bya/ /'phro tshe rlung dang lus sbyang gang 'phrod bsten/ /thun mtshams 'jog tshe bsngo bas rgyas gdab bya/ /mtshams su sngags bzlas byams dang snying rje bsgom/ /nyal khar dge ba bsngo ste nyal ba yi/ /rnal 'byor byas la 'od gsal gzung bya zhing / /mnyam rjes thams cad lta bas zin byas nas/

/gang la'ang zhen pa med pa'i tshul gyis spyad/ /'di gnyis dwags por chos kyi rje bzhugs dus/ /sgom chen pa gnyis kyis zhus nas mdzad pa'o// // ༄/ /oṃ swasti/ chos rje'i gsung rab las dge bshes rin rgyal gyi dri lan bzhugs/ bsam gyis mi khyab tshogs bsags pas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas te/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sprul pa yis/ /bsam gyis mi khyab don mdzad 'dud/ /yon tan rin chen mdzod la mnga' brnyes pas/ /thos bsam dag pa'i yid bzhin rgyal mtshan rtser/ /don zab 'dri tshig ba dan ches g.yos pa'i/ /dgos don nor bu phyogs tsam gsal bar bgyi/ /khyed kyis bskur ba'i yi ge rten gser mang ja dang bcas pa legs par thengs shing / bstan pa'i bya ba 'phel zhing thos pas shin tu spro bar mchis/ /skabs kyi don khyed rang gi khams kyi 'tsho skyong dang / /bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba la brtson pa gal che/ dang po'i sangs rgyas chos kyi dbyings la dgongs/ de la thog ma sems bskyed pa dang / lam la slob pa yod na slob pa yin pas thog ma nas sangs rgyas pa dang / thog mtha' med pa sogs 'gal bar 'gyur/ des na rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa la dgongs/ sangs rgyas sems can spyi tsam la phan tshun ltos pas/ ltos pa ma grub pa'i phyir ltos chos mi 'grub/ de phyir snga phyi dang bral/ de la dgongs nas klu sgrub kyis/ mya ngan 'das mtha' gang yin pa/ /de nyid 'khor ba'i mtha' yin te/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ gang zag gcig la ltos pa'i sems can snga/ /sangs rgyas phyi ste/ sems can gyi dri ma sbyangs pas sangs rgya ba'i phyir ro/ /sems can gyi chos nyid rang bzhin gyis dag kyang / gloo bur dri ma dang rang chas su 'byung ba lags te/ chos can dang chos nyid rang chas su 'byung ba rten 'brel lags/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso 'khor la yo ga man chad du 'jig rten pa rang kha ba bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug

gsang mtshan btags nas dkyil 'khor du bkod pa'i rigs rnams 'jig rten pa yin/ gtso bo nyid kyi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba gdul bya'i don du 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin pa rnams gtso ba dang bzang ngan med/ 'di bla med kyi rgyud na gtso che/ bla med kyi lha bsgoms rang la dman pa'i 'du shes kyis rnal 'byor man chad kyi lha la phyag mchod byed na/ mchog la mchog min du bzung bas khyad bsod du gyur/ de lta min na mchod bstod mi 'gal te/ 'byung po la mchod gtor dang / tha mal pa la'ang sbyin pa byar mi rung bar 'gyur ram/ don zhags byed dus bdag lhar bsgoms nas smyung gnas byed pa la bla ma gong mas dgag pa mdzad gda' na'ang / kun snying gis dbyings dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal sogs su lhar bsgoms nas smyung gnas byed par bshad gda'/ dgag pa 'di phung po la smod pas gdung ba'i phyir mi byed pa yin gyi gzhan la ma bkag pa 'dra lags/ lha'i gdan gyi tshangs pa sogs 'jig rten pa'i dregs pa brtul/ lag cha phrogs/ gdan du bting ba yin par bla med yo ga sogs su sngon byung gi rnam 'phrul du bshad pa dang / sprul par bshad pa gnyis ka mchis/ gzugs sku'i gzhi ma de gang la zer du gda'/ sprul mkhan la zer na chos sku yin par byams chos su bshad/ ngo bo la sangs rgyas la ltos pa'i bya grub ye shes yin par sangs rgyas kyi sa'i mdo dang / gdul bya'i snang ba yin par rgyud bla/ sku gsum grub pa sogs su bshad/ gnyis ka khas len dgos par gda'/ gdul bya'i ngor snang ba de gdul bya'i blo yin/ sprul sku sems can dus kyi gzugs phung gnas gyur pa theg bsdus su bshad/ rgyud sde bzhi'i bskyed chog la/ bya ba la byang chub kyi sems gnyis med kyi ting nge 'dzin/ sngags kyi sgra yi ge/ phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa/ lha'i gzugs bsgom pa/ lha la sems bzung nas srog rtsol sdom pa kun rdzob rnam pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin bzlas brjod med par bsam gtan gyi sngags kyi yi ge/

sgra'i gdangs tsam 'od gsal chos dbyings tsam du bsgom pa/ gzugs/ sgra/ don dam gyi lha bsgom pa/ don dam gyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis su med par bsgom pa yin par bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel pa dang bcas par bshad/ spyod rgyud kyi mngon rtags mtshan bcas mtshan med gnyis kyi dang po la stong nyid bsgom pa byang chub kyi sems dang / sngags kyi sgrar bsgom pa yi ge la dmigs pa dang / gzhi dang po rang lus lhar bskyed sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ gzhi gnyis pa mdun du lha bskyed pa phyag rgya la dmigs pa thugs khar sngags phreng bkod/ srog rtsol bsdams nas sems 'dzin pa gzugs la dmigs pa dang / mtshan med lus dang sems gzung 'dzin gyi rnam pa can kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu thos bsam gyis gtan la phab nas mtshan med du sbyor bar rnam snang mngon byang rgyud 'grel sogs su bshad/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi mngon rtogs/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog ste/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / de mi nus pa'i slob mas/ rnal 'byor/ rjes su rnal 'byor/ shin tu rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor chen po bzhi dang / slob dpon gyis rnal 'byor bsgoms/ de'i thugs kar dkyil 'khor bsgoms nas tshig bzlas dang / rdor bzlas byed pa yo ga'i rgyud dang / kun snying gi 'grel pa sogs su bshad/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi mngon rtogs/ skye gnas bzhi dang mthun par rdo rje bzhi chog yan lag drug bsnyen bsgrub bzhi/ lhag mos gsum/ rnal 'byor bzhis bskyed nas bzlas pa sogs rjes spyod nyams len bskyed rim dang / lam 'bras/ sbyor drug rim lnga/ sgyu ma gsum la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa rnams bla med kyi rgyud sde 'grel pa tha dad rnams su bshad cing / rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag rnams na'ang zhib par yod pas dgongs/ bya spyod la bdag bskyed med par ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas gong ma rnams bzhed na'ang /

rgya gar gyi slob dpon mang po dang / rgyud rang las kyang bdag bskyed bshad pa mang po gda' zhing / ye shes rdo rje'i rgyud mar 'gyur du yang / bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa dang / /zhes pa la/ snyems pa byed pa dang zhes par bsgyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid gsum yul du'ang bshad/ dbu ma snang bar yang 'byung bas sems tsam kho nar yang ma nges/ kun byang gi chos der rtogs pas brtags pa'i cha kun btags/ sems tsam bltar na sems sems byung rdzas grub/ dbu ma ltar na gnyis med kyi rang rig gzhan dbang de dag la kun btags kyis stong pa yongs grub ste/ 'di rnams theg bsdus/ dbus mtha'/ sa sde/ kun las btus/ dbu ma rgyan dang / snang ba/ yum 'grel rnams nas bshad/ phar phyin gyi sa lam bgrod kyang mthar sngags mngon du mi byed pa mi srid pas phyi nang gnyis ka'i lam gyis sangs rgya ste/ de lta min na lam gyi rnam pa thams cad mngon du ma byas pas rnam mkhyen min par 'gyur zhing / sngags dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsung bar bshad pas so/ /theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i mngon pa'i sde snod du gtogs pa'i mdo sde rmad du byung ba dang / gtan la dbab pa'i sde yin par kun las btus su bshad pa 'di la/ mngon du'i phyir dang zil gnon dang / /yang yang rtogs phyir mngon pa'i chos/ /zhes pa'i mtshan nyid can rnams mngon pa yin pas/ bdag med dang chos nyid gtso bor ston pa dkon rtsegs sogs mngon pa'i mdor gsal bar gda'/ chos sku rtag pa yin pa de la/ rgyud blar/ spangs pas chos sku ci ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes pa ltar rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ba med pas rtag pa/ rtogs pa chos sku yang 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ mnyam pa nyid du rtogs phyir rtag /ces pa ltar lags/ sems 'khrul pa'i gzhi dang rgyu gang yin zhes pa la gzhi yul la byas na dbyings la 'khrul/ rgyu la byas na thog ma med pa nas bden par zhen pa'i ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis 'khrul lo/

/bye brag smra ba'i grub mtha' bzung bar snang ba rdul phran cha med/ 'dzin pa tshogs drug bzung 'dzin thug phrad du bden par 'dod par phyi rol don grub ye shes snying po'i 'grel pa sogs su bshad/ mdo sde pa/ shes pa la bzung bar snang bshes pa yin gyi phyi'i don min la/ 'dzin pa rang rig cing 'dzin pa la rnam pa gtod byed phyi yin/ gzung rnam rig pas don rig par rnam 'grel nges sogs su bshad/ sems tsam rnam bden pas sna tshogs su snang ba shes pa yin pas rang rig gi rig byar 'dod/ rnam brdzun pas 'khrul shes la snang gi/ rang rig la sna tshogs kyi snang ba mi snang bar/ rnam 'grel dang / dbu ma rgyan sogs su bshad/ dbu ma la rang rgyud pa/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bur snang yang mi bden/ snang ba'i chos nyid ye shes dam pa'i yul du bden par 'dod/ thal 'gyur bas bden pa gnyis kyang tha snyad du 'jog gi/ gnas lugs la gnyis chos thams cad ma grub pas spros bral brjod med du 'dod par dbu ma rgyan dang / snang ba/ bden gnyis/ rigs tshogs dang / de'i 'grel pa zla grags kyis mdzad pa sogs su bshad/ bden gnyis la bye brag smra bas mdzod nas 'byung ba ltar bcom pa dang / blos bzhigs na ma grub pa kun rdzob/ bcom mam bzhigs kyang mi 'dor ba don dam/ mdo sde pas snang ba la don du 'dzin pa sogs 'khrul snang kun rdzob ste/ snang ba ltar don byed mi nus pa'i phyir yul yul can 'jig rten kun rdzob tu ji ltar snang bzhin 'dzin pa don dam ste/ yul yul can gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sems tsam pas kun btags gzhan dbang kun rdzob/ yongs grub don dam/ dbu ma rang rgyud pas 'khrul pa la snang ba kun rdzob/ 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi yul don dam/ thal 'gyur bas/ snang phyin chad gnyis snang las 'os med pas kun rdzob/ chos nyid don dam/ des na 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag snang med yin cing /

so so rang gis rig pas yul snang bar mi 'gyur te/ spros pa med pa'i phyir zhes 'dod do/ /bde gshegs snying po mtshan nyid pa chos sku'am byang chub/ de 'bras bur yod pas rnam byang gi khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can te/ 'di la sangs rgyas kyi rigs zhes kyang bya/ 'di dang sems can gyi de bzhin nyid ngo bo gcig kyang sems can gyi rigs min te/ 'khor ba pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyu mi byed pa'i phyir/ 'di la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yod tshul la/ mngon 'gyur ram sa bon gang du yod ce na/ mngon du gyur na byang chub yin pas sgrib bral du 'gyur zhing / gloo bur dri ma can yang ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi chos ci snyed pa'i rigs sam sa bon tshang bar yod pa la dgongs nas/ ci ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /zhes gsungs shing / mya ngan 'das chen nas kyang / rigs kyi bu sems can thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yod do zhes gsungs te/ sems can thams cad la yang dag par dgos pa mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu med pas don de'i phyir/ nges mdo sde 'di la tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsungs so/ /thog ma yod la da lta med/ /thog ma med la da lta yod/ /dus gsum srid pa'i chos thams cad/ /de lta bu yi gnas med do/ /rigs kyi bu srid pa zhes bya ba la rnam pa gsum ste/ ma 'ongs pa'i srid pa dang / da ltar gyi srid pa dang / 'das pa'i srid pa'o/ /de la sems can thams cad ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yod pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la da ltar kun nas nyon mongs pa rnams yod pas de'i phyir da lta mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu med do/

/sems can gang 'das pa'i dus na nyon mongs pa bcad pa yod pa'i phyir/ da ltar sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin mthong ste/ de lta bas na ngas rtag tu sems can la sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yod ces gsungs so/ /log sred can la sogs pa dge ba'i chos spong yang sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin dge ba de ma 'ongs pa'i dus na yod par 'gyur ba'i phyir log sred can la sogs pa la'ang sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ log sred can gdon mi za bar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes dang / byang sar/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po 'di dag ni lhag pa'i bsam pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnam par smin pa 'thob bo/ /de yan chad nas byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs pa'i bar du ni/ de dag gong nas gong du rnam par dag par 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / ma rdzogs par ni lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa'i sa yan chad sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na yang de dag dang ldan par yod do/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang sems can la bde gshegs snying po yod de/ 'bras bu chos sku ni mtshon byed yod pas khyab/ rnam par byang ba na yang 'gyur ba med pa'i de bzhin nyid dang dbyer med sku gsum 'byung rung gi rigs yod pa'i phyir/ rgyud blar/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes dang / thogs med zhabs kyis/ sems can phung po'i nang na sangs rgyas ye shes gnas/ /de ni rang bzhin gnyis med phyir na dri ma med/ /sangs rgyas rigs la 'bras bur nye bar btags nas ni/ /lus can thams cad sangs rgyas snying por brjod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /snying po med pa'i 'gro ba ni/ /khams gloo bur dri mas ma dag pa ste/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/

/sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes dang / khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu/ /ming gsum gyis ni bstan pa nyid/ /ces gsungs/ dbyings de ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba yin par/ kun btus su/ de bzhin nyid ngo bo nyid kyi dge bar gsungs pa dang / rgyud bla'i mdo rnams nas kyang dge bar gsungs te/ rang bzhin gyi mya ngan las 'das pa yin pas so/ /sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi sa bon thams cad tshang bar yod pas yon tan thams cad tshang bar bzhag ste/ rgyu tshang na de'i 'bras bu tshang bar yod pa bzhin no/ /mngon 'gyur du med pas med na/ rjang gi sa bon la yang myu gu med par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar phal cher las kyang gang gi phyir gang la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mtha' dag rjes su ma bzhugs pa'i sems can de ni sems can gyi rigs ni 'ga' yang med do/ /'on kyang 'du shes kyi 'dzin pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mi mngon/ 'du shes kyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba las ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rang byung gi ye shes thog pa med pa rab tu 'byung ngo / /zhes so/ /'di la sogs pa'i lung bka' tha ma'i mdo rnams na shin tu mang bar bzhugs so/ /dpyod ldan bshes gnyen dag gis dris pa'i lan/ zab mo'i mdo rgyud de 'grel 'grel bshad byas/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed rnams kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ /phyogs tsam gsal bar bkod nas springs pa ste/ /nang gi dbye ba rnams dang de yi lung / /'di yis mtshon nas mdo rgyud bstan bcos la/ /legs par gzigs shing snga ma'i mun sprul gyis/ /ma sbags gzur gnas blo yis dpyod par mdzod/ /de ltar mdo rgyud rgya chen dgongs pa'i don/ /phyogs tsam smra ba'ang a wa dhū tī pa/ /bsod nams nyid de de las dge thob pas/ /'gro bas thub dbang dgongs pa legs rtogs shog /ces pa'i yi ge mi 'khyar ba'i rten du ther gon ma dkar po cig bdog

bya'i lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la skyi shod kyi sa char bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄/ chos rje'i gsung rab las bla ma 'jam rin gyi dris lan no/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las kun/ /nyid kyi gcig tu bsdus bzhin nyid/ /mchog gsum rtsa ba bla med mchog /rab dad bsam pas bdag kyang dad/ /mang thos dge slong bsam gtan pas/ /gang blo'i dri ma 'jam pa yis/ /dpal gyi thugs rje'i chus bkrus nas/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang rin chen lam/ /bsgrub brtson thos ldan de la springs/ /khyod blo gangs ri'i ngos yangs las/ /'phrin yig 'bab chu phreng ba'i rgyun/ /rgyan mang lhung lhung snyan sgrogs pas/ /bdag blo dge ba'i shang shong gang / /dga' ba'i myu gu legs bskyed de/ /tshig dang don gyi 'dab rgyas shing / /lung don ze'u 'bru phreng mdzes pa'i/ /phrin lan pad tshal 'di bskur ro/ /thub bstan nyin byed dpal 'grib la/ /mi srun skye bos 'jig rten 'tshe/ /bstan 'dzin phal che'ang chos min spyod/ /tshul bzhin spyod pa'ang kun gyis brnyas/ /zhes pa'i tshul 'di thub pa yis/ /snyigs dus 'byung bar gsal bar gsungs/ /'di las dpags te thar 'dod rnams/ /bag ldan lam la brtson par rigs/ /bdag kyang rgyal sras tshul zhugs kyis/ /snying rje bsam pa ma dag cing / /rang gi bsam pa'i mthar son pas/ /gzhan don sangs rgyas bsgrun brtson te/ /'di yang gsung rab rgya mtsho las/ /gsungs pa'i don dang 'gal ba med/ /snying rje'i bsam pa ma dag par/ /lus 'di btang bar mi bya ste/ bsam pa mnyam pas de btang bya/ /zhes gsungs me tog zla mdzes sogs/ /bsam pa mnyam la dgongs pa ste/ /de lta min na las dang po'i/ /byang chub sems dpa'ang sems min 'gyur/ /gzhan yang thogs med spyan ldan pa/ /sar zhugs rgyal sras rgyal ba rnams/ /da lta btang snyoms bzhugs pa'i phyir/ /dam pa min par thal bar 'gyur/ /lha yi rgyal pos char phab kyang /

/sa bon mi rung mi 'khrung ltar/ /zhe na tshul 'dir gzhan la'ang mtshungs/ /mdor na chos bzhin legs spyad na/ /chos pa phal che'ang de la gshe/ /chos min spyad na rang la sdig /'jam pos 'jam por mi nus la/ /rtsub na rtsub mo lhag par 'phel/ /de phyir snyigs dus spyod pa dka'/ /zhes pa'i yi ge'i rten tsam du/ /phreng ba brgya rtsa cig bdog pas/ /'chad sogs bstan pa'i bya ba bsgrub pa yang / /gzhan dang gzhan gyi ched du mi bsam par/ /ltos bral rnam mkhyen kho na'i don bsams te/ /nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par 'bad 'tshal lo/ /bde ba can gyi gdan sa pa/ /bla ma 'jam rin gyi dri lan/ /chos kyi rje rin po che'i gsung rab/ yar lungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi yi dam du bya zhing spel bar bya ba zhus dag go/ //bla ma 'jam rin gyi dri lan gzhan gcig yod pa'ang btsal nas 'dir bzhug go/ ༄/ /chos rje'i gsung rab las/ rgya ba kun bzang la gdams pa/ slob dpon kun dga' bzang po la springs pa/ khyod khams bzang zhing bstan pa'i bya ba la brtson pa'i thad nas nged la yi ge rten gser srang phyed dang bcas pa bskur bar 'phrod pas spro/ da dung yang khams kyi 'tsho skyong dang / chos kyi bya ba la brtson pa mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la/ /dang ba'i sems kyis gsol ba gdab/ /rang lus lha ru bsgom pa yis/ /tha mal rnam rtog spang bar bya/ /sgo gsum gnad la phab pa yi/ /lus ngag yid gsum chab la dbab/ /spros pa'i 'gyu ba bcad nas ni/ /mi rtog ye shes bsgom par bya/ /de tshe rnam rtogs 'phros pa na/ /rtog pa nyid la gtad pas spong / /dran rtog gang shar dran pa yis/ /legs par bzung la de la gtad/ /bying na rig pa'i ngar bskyed la/ /gsal rig ngang la bzhag par bya/ /de yis zhi lhag zung du 'brel/ /so so rang rig ye shes 'char/ /rjes thob bsngo bas rgyas btab ste/ /chos kun rmi lam lta bur bsam/ /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje bskyed/

/de yis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /sems kyi chos can chos nyid bzhi yi tshul/ de yi dri ma sbyong byed lam gyi chos/ /de yis sgrib bral spangs rtogs 'bras bu ste/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum gnas lugs mdor bsdus pa'o/ /da lan yi ge'i rten du zhwa sbrel zung cig yod/ /glang lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig la bris/ chos kyi rje rin po che'i gsung rab las/ yar lung pa seng ge la mtshan gyi yi dam du bya ba'i chos bsam gling yang dben du bris shing dag par bgyis pa dge'o// // ༄༅/ /chos rje'i gsung rab thor bu ba bzhugs so/ oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig srid zhi'i dpal 'byor chus gter gyis rgyas g.yo med dbyar skyes rigs 'khrigs shing / /srid gsum gdug pa'i nyes tshogs gdung ba zhi mdzad sngon med chu bsil legs bkod pas/ /lus can dri med dge ba'i yal 'dab phun tshogs gsar pa rnam par rgyas mdzad pa/ /gcig tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsi'i btung ba ster mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang gi sku ni 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi mdang 'phrog dmar ser mdangs rab gsal bas mdzes pa ni/ /khyod thugs ye shes nyi ma 'char kha'i dmar ba'i nyi 'od lhag par 'khrul pa bskyed byed cing / /khyod gsung drug cu'i dbyangs ni khyod mthus byed po'i mgrin pa phrogs te byed po smra ba ngal gso bzhin/ /khyod thugs nam mkha' yis kyang mtshon bya min pas kun gyi mkhyen pa legs bsdus zas gtsang sras la 'dud/ /gang gis yon tan cha shas mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pa'i dpal/ /byams pa'i ri bong gar gyis legs rol thugs rje'i bdud rtsi'i 'od kyis 'gro ba'i rab rib sel/ /srid gsum kun gyi bde ba'i dpal gcig phrin las 'od dkar phyogs bcur rab spro ba'i/ /kun gyi kun dga' bskyed pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ku mud gnyen des 'gro ba'i rab rib 'phrog gyur cig

/de yis legs gsungs mtha' dang bral ba'i lus can kun gyi sred pa'i nad rnams ldog byed cing / /phyi nang dngos kun rnam par gsal ba'i 'od brgya'i zer gyis kun nas rmongs pa'i mun nag 'jil/ /gang gi yid mtshor dge ba dri med 'dab brgya rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i dpal rab ster/ /dam chos nyin mor byed pa'i 'od kyis skyes dgu kun gyi phan bde rnam par gsal gyur cig /gang zhig zhi dang dul sogs rtag tu brtson pa'i dge ba'i 'dren byed kyis drangs pas/ /nyes tshogs nyam nga'i g.yang sa stug po'i mthar son bag yod bsam gtan khang par gnas/ /rang nyid nye bar zhi ba thob kyang sems can don la brtson par rab tu zhugs gyur pa/ /theg pa che chung dge 'dun rnams kyis 'gro ba kun gyi rgud pa rtsad nas 'phrog gyur cig /de las byung ba'i bsod nams mthu yis sangs rgyas rnams ni rab dgyes shing / /chos kyang rtag tu nub pa med par phyogs bcu kun tu dar ba dang / /dge 'dun rnams ni yon tan rin chen du ma'i nor gyis phyug gyur te/ /mchog gsum dri med dge ba'i snang bas 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas par shog /ces pa ma gcig pa'i gshegs rdzongs sgrub dus kyi'o// // ༄༅/ /spyan snga grags byang ba'i zhu lan/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin rnam dag rab yangs dpag bsam nam mkha'i khams/ /rnam dag ye shes nyi gzhon gang gis blo bur dri ma'i sprin tshogs bral/ /'gro ba kun gyi phan bde dpag med rnam pa kun tu go byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor ltar 'gro ba'i re skong bla med bla ma rgyal gyur cig /tshogs gnyis rab rgyas rab rgyas dpal gzhan zil gnon cing / /mkhyen pa phun tshogs phun tshogs kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /brtse chen tshad med tshad med 'gro ba'i gtsug gi brgyan/ /mchog gi skyabs mchog skyabs mchog gtso bo rgyal bar 'dud/ /de yis legs gsung legs gsung dus gsum dge ba can/

/des bskrun dri bral dri ma bral byed dam pa'i chos/ /chos kyi mchog gyur mchog tu thar ba'i thabs gcig pu/ /ston pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin gyis mchod rgyas gyur cig /bslab gsum ri sul rab tu yangs par gnas bcas te/ /mi dge'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i tshogs rnams rgyang srings nas/ /dri med lam gyi gsang sngags bzlas brjod rtag zlos pa/ /'phags tshogs dge 'dun sngon med drang srong spyi bos bkur/ /gang gi rnam 'phrul nyan rang rgyal sras gang gis bskal pa bye bar yang / /bsam dang brjod pa'i yul las 'das pas 'khor bar 'khor ba'i 'gro 'di yi/ /phung khams skye mched dri ma'i dra ba yun rings dus nas bsags pa gang / /legs par sbyangs nas rgyal bar sgrub mdzad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /gang thugs ring du sbyangs pas rab gsal nyin mor byed pa'i dpal 'phrog cing / /yon tan rin chen brjod las 'das pas yid bzhin nor bu'ang zil mnan te/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rab tu brtan par legs 'dzin 'gro ba'i phan bde'i gter/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan bstan 'dzin khyed rnams zhabs brtan shog /dge ba 'di yis mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /rigs gzugs 'byor ldan skyes pa nyid gyur te/ /gnas skabs chos kyi bde la longs spyad nas/ /rdzogs sangs yon tan rgya mtshor myur 'jug shog /gzhan yang 'gro la gcig tu phan pa'i gter/ /thub pa'i bstan pa nyin mor byed pa'i dpal/ /mi mthun chu 'dzin stug pos mi sgrib par/ /rnam pa kun tu phyogs kun gsal gyur cig /thub bstan rin chen gang gi phyag son pa/ /mkhyen brtse'i spyan ldan legs bshad dpal ster ba'i/ /bshes gnyen ded dpon dam pa gang dag kyang / /bkur stir byas te yun rings zhabs brtan shog /skye dgu gang gi phyi nang nyer 'tshe rnams/ /phan tshun skyengs pa lta bur phyir son te/ /dge ba'i blo dang phan tshun byams pa'i sems/

/lhan cig 'gran pa bzhin du 'khod par shog /ces pa ma gcig pa'i cho ga'i dus kyi'o// // ༄/ spyan lnga grags byang pa'i zhu lan/ /rnam par dag pa'i thugs kyi bang mdzod yon tan rin po che'i nor gyis phyug pa la brten nas skye dgu ma lus pa'i sgo gsum gyi dbul ba sel bar mdzad pa spyan snga ba sku mtshams dam po la bzhugs bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i thad nas gsung yig rten gser theg dang / /slob dpon seng ge rgyal mtshan la zhal ta mdzad nas dri ba rnams zur du bkol ba dang bcas pa 'phrod pas shin tu spro bar mchis shing / yang dag lam la nges gnas pas/ /dri ma yang dag nges sel bas/ /brtson pa mchog gis rtag gnas nas/ /gzhan la'ang de bzhin 'doms mdzad gsol/ /de las bsod nams bla med pa/ /'byung 'gyur dus kun rmi 'dra bar/ /shes nas rgya chen sems can la/ /bsngo ba theg chen lam du gsungs/ /lū hi pa'i mchod 'phreng bla ma gong ma'i de btsal nas bskur ba zhu/ mngon rtogs de'i bar du 'dzud pa lags/ dri ba rnams phal che ba ngo sprod na gsal bar bdog na'ang / go bde ba cig yar lung du sdod kyi bar byas nas mngon rtogs dang lhan du spring pa lags/ tshes bcu la dge'o// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag skye dgu'i 'dren pa dam pa/ rin po che pa'i zhal snga nas rnam par dkar ba'i thugs kyis kun nas blangs te/ slob dpon seng rgyal ba la gsung yig rten gser thig bla gos/ ja zhib brdungs dang bcas pa bskur ba gsung yig bzhin 'phrod pas shin tu spro/ skabs kyi don spyir sku khams kyi 'tsho skyong thugs dam la brtson par mdzad par zhu zhing / khyad par kha sing nas gsung glengs byung pa bzhin thugs dam de snga dgoong ma chag pa'i ngang nas/ bar skabs su/ rgyud bla ma dang / brtag gnyis kyi gzigs rtog ma chag par mdzad nas/ skabs la bab pa na tshogs chos dang /

lkog chos su ci nas kyang gsung ba'i 'dun pa mdzad pas/ de lta dbus gtsang gi chos 'jig rten gnyis kyi dad pa 'bul sar yod pa 'dis bstan pa rin po che dang / bstan 'dzin rnams la phan pa chen por 'gyur zhing / khyad par du gsung gleng pa bzhin/ thel du'ang 'chad nyan pa go ma 'gags tsam re byung na mkhas pa'i rnam dbyer 'gyur zhing / phyogs kyi bu slob po ti slob 'dod rnams slob gnyer la grwa sa gzhan du 'gro ba'i rtsol ba mi dgos shing / de kar yon tan bcad pas 'phral phugs zhen che zhing / gdan sa'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur bas/ slob gnyer 'os pa dang tshar ba rnams la zhal ta bdag rkyen phyogs du ma nas mdzad pa la sogs slob dpon la ji ltar bsnyel bskul bskur ba bzhin dgongs pa dang / khrigs la khel ba gal che/ bdag cag kyang bag la gnas shing / 'gor ci chung byas nas myur por dbus phyogs su phebs pa bgyid pa lags/ yon tan rin chen bye ba'i mdzod mnga' zhing / /shes bya dpag med gzigs pa'i spyan yangs pa/ /kun la bde legs stsol ba'i phrin las can/ /mtshungs med bla ma rnams kyis byin brlabs mdzod/ /spangs rtogs phrin las mthar thug sangs rgyas phul/ /srid zhi'i dri ma kun 'khru dam chos chu/ /bstan pa legs 'dzin skyong mdzad 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis gsol/ /'jig rten 'di dag dge legs phun tshogs kyis/ /legs par bkang nas 'gro ba'i rgyud pa kun/ /nam yang mi mthong sgra yang mi thos par/ /bde ba mi nyams rgyun mi 'chad par shog /yi ge gzigs pa'i rten du bdag cag gi gyon wa cig bdog sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu la chos rdzong nas dge bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /rab dkar dge ba'i yid kyis rab bskyod de/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams la lhag dad cing / /gcig tu yongs 'dzin dag la gus pa can/ /bshes gnyen gang de'i 'dod don kun 'grub shog

/slob dpon seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi yi ge rten dang bcas pa 'phrod/ dris lan la zhus dag cher dgos pa tsam med/ skabs don ngo sprod la dbang po btub pas der blta rtog byas pas khrol/ lū hi pa'i dkyil mchog myur lam du byas nas spring ba yin/ bsngo ba'i don du ja bskur ba tshim par longs spyad nas bsngo ba rgyas pa dang / bde ba can gyi smin lam yang bgyis bdog mi dge dpag med 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ma rig las/ /'byung ba'i gnyen po bdag med kyi/ /shes rab bsgom pa mchog yin la/ /de yi ngang nas bsngo bar bya/ /rtse gcig pa yi yang dang yang / /nges shes brtan pa'i 'dun pa yis/ /bde ba can du smon pa ni/ /the tshom med par 'grub pa yin/ /tshes bcu bzhi la bris// // ༄༅/ /gang gi mkhyen rabs nam mkha'i khyon ltar dpag yas shing / /brtse ba'i thugs rje chu bo'i rgyun ltar zad mi mnga'/ /dge legs phrin las 'od stong can ltar phyogs bcur gsal/ /skye dgu'i skyabs gyur dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs mchod do/ /shes bya mtha' dag mngon sum gzigs kyang mngon sum ngo bos ma gzigs shing / /'gro ba kun la bu ltar brtse yang bdud dpung ma lus brlag mdzad pa/ /phrin las rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad kyang gdul bya dus la 'dul mdzad cing / /tshad med yon tan bla med brnyes kyang kun la tshad mar gyur pa rgyal/ /slar yang thub pa'i bstan pa nyin mor byed pa nam du'ang nub pa mi mnga' zhing / /'gro ba'i phan bde pad mo'i tshal rnams nam yang zum par mi 'gyur la/ /bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen dge legs snang ba 'gro bas yang yang bsten byas nas/ /mngon mtho'i lam zhugs thar pa'i grong du 'gro kun bde blag bgrod par shog /gnas skabs kun tu bshes gnyen dam pa las/ /zab cing rgya che'i gzhung lugs nyan byed cing / /chos kyi don rtogs dga' ston dang ldan pas/ /'gro la chos sbyin dri med ster gyur cig

/ces pa dpang lo tsā ba er bzhugs su gsol ba'i 'bul yig go/ // ༄༅/ /gang zhig dge legs du ma'i dpal las rab grub cing / /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od pad mo'i gnyen las rab 'gong la/ /thugs kyi mkhyen pa shes bya'i mtha' la rab 'khyud pa/ /mnyam med de ni chos dang dge 'dun gus pas mchod/ /ces pas bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan pa'i nang rten 'jam dbyangs rab gnas kyi'o// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ /dkar phibs la gtogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ nye gnas/ dbon skya/ gnyer pa/ bza' ba/ bya ba byed mi/ phyi nang gi 'gron po che chung dang / 'grim 'grul ba rnams la springs pa/ bla ma dam pa 'phags pa bzhugs pa'i dus na/ sha spel mang po 'dren pa'i srol med par 'dug cing / de'i don la bca' khrims kyi bka' shog kyang yod par 'dug na'ang / dus phyis dus kyi bde dog la brten pa dang / gzhan gyi mig 'dran gyi stobs kyis/ sha spel mang po 'dren pa cig byung 'dug 'di bzhin byas na/ sems can mang po la dngos su gnod cing / lang kar gshegs pa las/ dri nga 'phags pa min pas bsnyen/ /mi bsnyen par yang byed pa de/ /sha ni sha za rnams kyis zas/ /zar mi rung bar thub chen gsung / /zhes pa dang / khe yi phyir ni sems can gsod/ /sha yi phyir ni nor sbyin byed/ /de dag gnyis ka sdig las can/ /'o dod 'bod la sogs par 'tshed/ /gang gis thub pa'i tshig 'das te/ /bsam pa ngan pas sha za na/ /'jig rten gnyis ni gzhig pa'i phyir/ /shākya'i bstan las brtul zhugs blang / /shin tu mi zad dmyal bar yang / /sdig gi las can de dag 'dong / /ma rungs 'o dod 'bod tshogs su/ /sha za de dag btso bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs nyes dmigs kyang mang du gsungs pa dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gzims khang du sha dmar po 'grim pa 'di shin tu yang mi rigs par 'dug pas/ da phyin chad 'gron po gal can/

mi che chung gang la'ang / che ba la chung sha lhu gnyis spel dang / byin la lhu re bas mtho ba ma 'dren/ phogs 'gron chas kyang / las sha khog pa re tsam dang / mar thud la gyis/ rgyugs la'ang las sha dang mar thud la gyis la/ bsad sha ma 'grim/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi dus bzang gsum la/ dkar phibs lha khang dang bcas pa rnams su sha'i 'grim 'grul ma byed/ bla brang du spyod dgos rnams kyang / nyos pa dang / las sha ma gtogs sems can la 'tshe ba gang yang ma byed/ 'di rnams gong ma yon mchod kyi sku'i rim gro dang / bstan pa'i zhabs tog rang gzhan thams cad la 'di phyi thams cad du phan pa'i thabs yin pas/ bla brang gi thil zhugs byed mis do dam gyis la/ yi ge 'di la 'gal ba khyed sus kyang ma byed/ spre'u lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la chos 'khor chen por bris pa'i yi ge/ dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /dge legs chen po rnams kyi nor bu rin chen rin thang med pa ni/ /'gro ba kun la ci 'dod sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa nyid/ /snying rje 'dzum bcas dga' ba'i zol gyis sbyin la spro ba'i dpal/ /thub dbang dpag bsam 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur zhabs pad spyi bos mchod/ /bsod nams dge byed gtsang zhing bder 'os pa/ /dpal gyi gzi brjid lhun po'i dbang po bzhin/ /grags pa'i me tog thod can rnam bkra ba/ /phun sum tshogs 'dzin mchod 'os de la 'dud/ /'o ma'i mtsho la bdud rtsi'i dpal bzhin dang / /'dab brgya pa las phun tshogs sbrang rtsi bzhin/ /'gro ba'i nang du yon tan dam pa'i dpal/ /bsod nams ldan 'os tshogs mchog rnams la 'dud/ /ces pa ma gcig pa'i nang rten bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang rab gnas dus kyi'o// //gcig zhus so/ dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 144 bla ma dam pa/ gu shri chen po'i chos 'khor dus kyi bstan rtsis/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 143
